<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<androidx.constraintlayout.widget.ConstraintLayout xmlns:android="http://schemas.android.com/apk/res/android"
	xmlns:app="http://schemas.android.com/apk/res-auto"
	xmlns:tools="http://schemas.android.com/tools"
	android:id="@+id/main"
	android:layout_width="match_parent"
	android:layout_height="match_parent"
	android:background="@color/off_white_bg"
	tools:context=".MainActivity">

	<include
		android:id="@+id/top_nav_include"
		layout="@layout/include_top_nav"
		app:layout_constraintTop_toTopOf="parent"
		app:layout_constraintStart_toStartOf="parent"
		app:layout_constraintEnd_toEndOf="parent" />

	<TextView
		android:id="@+id/text_greeting"
		android:layout_width="0dp"
		android:layout_height="wrap_content"
		android:layout_marginStart="24dp"
		android:layout_marginTop="16dp"
		android:layout_marginEnd="24dp"
		android:text="@string/greeting_morning"
		android:textColor="@color/dark_text"
		android:textSize="22sp"
		android:textStyle="bold"
		app:layout_constraintEnd_toEndOf="parent"
		app:layout_constraintHorizontal_bias="0.0"
		app:layout_constraintStart_toStartOf="parent"
		app:layout_constraintTop_toBottomOf="@id/top_nav_include" />

	<LinearLayout
		android:id="@+id/card_progress"
		android:layout_width="0dp"
		android:layout_height="wrap_content"
		android:layout_marginStart="24dp"
		android:layout_marginTop="48dp"
		android:layout_marginEnd="24dp"
		android:background="@drawable/bg_card"
		android:orientation="vertical"
		app:layout_constraintEnd_toEndOf="parent"
		app:layout_constraintHorizontal_bias="0.0"
		app:layout_constraintStart_toStartOf="parent"
		app:layout_constraintTop_toBottomOf="@id/text_greeting">

		<TextView
			android:layout_width="match_parent"
			android:layout_height="wrap_content"
			android:text="@string/daily_progress"
			android:textColor="@color/dark_text"
			android:textStyle="bold" />

		<ProgressBar
			android:id="@+id/progress_daily"
			style="@android:style/Widget.ProgressBar.Horizontal"
			android:layout_width="match_parent"
			android:layout_height="wrap_content"
			android:max="100"
			android:progress="40"
			android:progressTint="@color/teal_primary" />

		<TextView
			android:id="@+id/text_progress_percent"
			android:layout_width="wrap_content"
			android:layout_height="wrap_content"
			android:text="40%"
			android:textColor="@color/dark_text" />

	</LinearLayout>

	<GridLayout
		android:id="@+id/quick_actions"
		android:layout_width="0dp"
		android:layout_height="wrap_content"
		android:layout_marginStart="24dp"
		android:layout_marginTop="24dp"
		android:layout_marginEnd="24dp"
		android:columnCount="2"
		android:rowCount="2"
		app:layout_constraintEnd_toEndOf="parent"
		app:layout_constraintHorizontal_bias="0.0"
		app:layout_constraintStart_toStartOf="parent"
		app:layout_constraintTop_toBottomOf="@id/card_progress">

		<Button
			android:id="@+id/button_my_habits"
			android:layout_width="0dp"
			android:layout_height="wrap_content"
			android:layout_columnWeight="1"
			android:layout_margin="8dp"
			android:backgroundTint="@color/teal_primary"
			android:text="@string/my_habits"
			android:textColor="@color/white" />

		<Button
			android:id="@+id/button_mood_journal"
			android:layout_width="0dp"
			android:layout_height="wrap_content"
			android:layout_columnWeight="1"
			android:layout_margin="8dp"
			android:backgroundTint="@color/peach_secondary"
			android:text="@string/mood_journal"
			android:textColor="@color/white" />

		<Button
			android:id="@+id/button_hydration"
			android:layout_width="0dp"
			android:layout_height="wrap_content"
			android:layout_columnWeight="1"
			android:layout_margin="8dp"
			android:backgroundTint="@color/sky_blue_accent"
			android:text="@string/hydration"
			android:textColor="@color/white" />

		<Button
			android:id="@+id/button_settings"
			android:layout_width="0dp"
			android:layout_height="wrap_content"
			android:layout_columnWeight="1"
			android:layout_margin="8dp"
			android:backgroundTint="@color/soft_orange_secondary"
			android:text="@string/settings"
			android:textColor="@color/white" />

	</GridLayout>

	<TextView
		android:id="@+id/text_quote"
		android:layout_width="0dp"
		android:layout_height="wrap_content"
		android:layout_marginStart="24dp"
		android:layout_marginEnd="24dp"
		android:layout_marginBottom="72dp"
		android:gravity="center"
		android:text="@string/quote_placeholder"
		android:textColor="@color/dark_text"
		app:layout_constraintBottom_toTopOf="@id/bottom_nav_include"
		app:layout_constraintEnd_toEndOf="parent"
		app:layout_constraintHorizontal_bias="0.0"
		app:layout_constraintStart_toStartOf="parent" />

	<include
		android:id="@+id/bottom_nav_include"
		layout="@layout/include_bottom_nav"
		app:layout_constraintStart_toStartOf="parent"
		app:layout_constraintEnd_toEndOf="parent"
		app:layout_constraintBottom_toBottomOf="parent" />

</androidx.constraintlayout.widget.ConstraintLayout>

import android.os.Bundle;
import android.view.LayoutInflater;
import android.view.View;
import android.view.ViewGroup;
import android.widget.EditText;
import android.widget.CheckBox;
import android.widget.TextView;

import androidx.activity.EdgeToEdge;
import androidx.annotation.NonNull;
import androidx.appcompat.app.AlertDialog;
import androidx.appcompat.app.AppCompatActivity;
import androidx.core.graphics.Insets;
import androidx.core.view.ViewCompat;
import androidx.core.view.WindowInsetsCompat;
import androidx.recyclerview.widget.GridLayoutManager;
import androidx.recyclerview.widget.LinearLayoutManager;
import androidx.recyclerview.widget.RecyclerView;

import com.google.android.material.floatingactionbutton.FloatingActionButton;

import java.text.DateFormat;
import java.text.SimpleDateFormat;

import java.util.Date;
import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;

public class MoodJournalActivity extends AppCompatActivity {

	private final List<MoodEntry> entries = new ArrayList<>();
	private MoodAdapter adapter;

	private RecyclerView calendarView;
	private CalendarAdapter calendarAdapter;
	private java.util.Calendar currentMonth = java.util.Calendar.getInstance();
	private Date selectedDate = new Date();
	private CheckBox filterDayCheck;

	@Override
	protected void onCreate(Bundle savedInstanceState) {
		super.onCreate(savedInstanceState);
		EdgeToEdge.enable(this);
		setContentView(R.layout.activity_mood_journal);

		ViewCompat.setOnApplyWindowInsetsListener(findViewById(R.id.mood_root), (v, insets) -> {
			Insets systemBars = insets.getInsets(WindowInsetsCompat.Type.systemBars());
			v.setPadding(systemBars.left, systemBars.top, systemBars.right, systemBars.bottom);
			return insets;
		});

		// Mood list
		RecyclerView recyclerView = findViewById(R.id.recycler_moods);
		recyclerView.setLayoutManager(new LinearLayoutManager(this));
		adapter = new MoodAdapter(entries, new MoodListener() {
			@Override
			public void onEdit(int position) {
				showMoodDialog(position);
			}

			@Override
			public void onDelete(int position) {
				entries.remove(position);
				adapter.notifyItemRemoved(position);
				calendarAdapter.updateEmojis(mapDateToEmoji());
			}
		});
		recyclerView.setAdapter(adapter);

		// Calendar
		calendarView = findViewById(R.id.recycler_calendar);
		calendarView.setLayoutManager(new GridLayoutManager(this, 7));
		calendarAdapter = new CalendarAdapter(new ArrayList<>(), dayCell -> {
			selectedDate = dayCell.date;
			refreshListForFilter();
		});
		calendarView.setAdapter(calendarAdapter);

		filterDayCheck = findViewById(R.id.checkbox_filter_day);
		if (filterDayCheck != null) {
			filterDayCheck.setOnCheckedChangeListener((buttonView, isChecked) -> refreshListForFilter());
		}

		findViewById(R.id.button_prev_month).setOnClickListener(v -> {
			currentMonth.add(java.util.Calendar.MONTH, -1);
			bindMonth();
			refreshListForFilter();

		BaseNavigation.wireTopNav(this, findViewById(R.id.top_nav_include));
		BaseNavigation.wireBottomNav(this, findViewById(R.id.bottom_nav_include));
		});
		findViewById(R.id.button_next_month).setOnClickListener(v -> {
			currentMonth.add(java.util.Calendar.MONTH, 1);
			bindMonth();
			refreshListForFilter();
		});

		bindMonth();

		// FAB for adding moods
		FloatingActionButton fab = findViewById(R.id.fab_log_mood);
		fab.setOnClickListener(v -> showMoodDialog(-1));
	}

	private void showMoodDialog(final int editPosition) {
		View dialogView = LayoutInflater.from(this).inflate(R.layout.dialog_mood_entry, null, false);
		final EditText inputEmoji = dialogView.findViewById(R.id.input_emoji);
		final EditText inputNote = dialogView.findViewById(R.id.input_note);

		if (editPosition >= 0) {
			MoodEntry e = entries.get(editPosition);
			inputEmoji.setText(e.emoji);
			inputNote.setText(e.note);
		}

		new AlertDialog.Builder(this)
				.setTitle(editPosition >= 0 ? "Edit Mood" : "Log Mood")
				.setView(dialogView)
				.setPositiveButton(editPosition >= 0 ? "Save" : "Log", (d, w) -> {
					String emoji = inputEmoji.getText().toString().trim();
					String note = inputNote.getText().toString().trim();
					if (emoji.isEmpty()) emoji = "";

					if (editPosition >= 0) {
						MoodEntry e = entries.get(editPosition);
						e.emoji = emoji;
						e.note = note;
					} else {
						Date now = selectedDate != null ? selectedDate : new Date();
						entries.add(0, new MoodEntry(now, emoji, note));
					}

					refreshListForFilter();
					calendarAdapter.updateEmojis(mapDateToEmoji());
				})
				.setNegativeButton("Cancel", null)
				.show();
	}

	private void bindMonth() {
		TextView monthTitle = findViewById(R.id.text_month);
		SimpleDateFormat sdf = new SimpleDateFormat("MMMM yyyy");
		monthTitle.setText(sdf.format(currentMonth.getTime()));

		java.util.Calendar cal = (java.util.Calendar) currentMonth.clone();
		cal.set(java.util.Calendar.DAY_OF_MONTH, 1);
		int daysInMonth = cal.getActualMaximum(java.util.Calendar.DAY_OF_MONTH);

		List<DayCell> cells = new ArrayList<>();
		for (int day = 1; day <= 31; day++) {
			if (day <= daysInMonth) {
				cal.set(java.util.Calendar.DAY_OF_MONTH, day);
				cells.add(DayCell.of(cal.getTime()));
			} else {
				cells.add(DayCell.invalid(day));
			}
		}

		calendarAdapter.submit(cells, mapDateToEmoji());
	}

	private Map<String, String> mapDateToEmoji() {
		SimpleDateFormat keyFmt = new SimpleDateFormat("yyyy-MM-dd");
		Map<String, String> map = new HashMap<>();
		for (MoodEntry e : entries) {
			map.put(keyFmt.format(e.timestamp), e.emoji);
		}
		return map;
	}

	// ✅ FIX: refreshListForFilter now lives in the Activity
	private void refreshListForFilter() {
		if (filterDayCheck != null && filterDayCheck.isChecked()) {
			SimpleDateFormat keyFmt = new SimpleDateFormat("yyyy-MM-dd");
			String selKey = keyFmt.format(selectedDate != null ? selectedDate : new Date());
			List<MoodEntry> filtered = new ArrayList<>();
			for (MoodEntry e : entries) {
				if (keyFmt.format(e.timestamp).equals(selKey)) {
					filtered.add(e);
				}
			}
			adapter.setItems(filtered);
		} else {
			adapter.setItems(new ArrayList<>(entries));
		}
	}

	// ────────── Data classes ──────────

	private static class MoodEntry {
		Date timestamp;
		String emoji;
		String note;

		MoodEntry(Date timestamp, String emoji, String note) {
			this.timestamp = timestamp;
			this.emoji = emoji;
			this.note = note;
		}
	}

	private static class DayCell {
		boolean isInvalid;
		Date date;
		int dayNumber;

		static DayCell of(Date date) {
			DayCell d = new DayCell();
			d.isInvalid = false;
			d.date = date;
			java.util.Calendar c = java.util.Calendar.getInstance();
			c.setTime(date);
			d.dayNumber = c.get(java.util.Calendar.DAY_OF_MONTH);
			return d;
		}

		static DayCell invalid(int dayNumber) {
			DayCell d = new DayCell();
			d.isInvalid = true;
			d.dayNumber = dayNumber;
			return d;
		}
	}

	private interface DayClickListener {
		void onDayClick(DayCell dayCell);
	}

	private static class CalendarAdapter extends RecyclerView.Adapter<CalendarAdapter.DayViewHolder> {
		private final List<DayCell> cells;
		private final DayClickListener listener;
		private Map<String, String> dateToEmoji = new HashMap<>();

		CalendarAdapter(List<DayCell> cells, DayClickListener listener) {
			this.cells = cells;
			this.listener = listener;
		}

		void submit(List<DayCell> newCells, Map<String, String> dateToEmoji) {
			this.cells.clear();
			this.cells.addAll(newCells);
			this.dateToEmoji = dateToEmoji;
			notifyDataSetChanged();
		}

		void updateEmojis(Map<String, String> dateToEmoji) {
			this.dateToEmoji = dateToEmoji;
			notifyDataSetChanged();
		}

		@NonNull
		@Override
		public DayViewHolder onCreateViewHolder(@NonNull ViewGroup parent, int viewType) {
			View v = LayoutInflater.from(parent.getContext())
					.inflate(R.layout.item_calendar_day, parent, false);
			return new DayViewHolder(v);
		}

		@Override
		public void onBindViewHolder(@NonNull DayViewHolder holder, int position) {
			DayCell cell = cells.get(position);
 holder.day.setText(String.valueOf(cell.dayNumber));
			if (cell.isInvalid) {
				holder.emoji.setText("");
				holder.day.setAlpha(0.4f);
				holder.itemView.setOnClickListener(null);
			} else {
				holder.day.setAlpha(1f);
				SimpleDateFormat keyFmt = new SimpleDateFormat("yyyy-MM-dd");
				String key = keyFmt.format(cell.date);
				holder.emoji.setText(dateToEmoji.getOrDefault(key, ""));
				holder.itemView.setOnClickListener(v -> listener.onDayClick(cell));
			}

 // Selected state highlight
 try {
 java.text.SimpleDateFormat keyFmt = new java.text.SimpleDateFormat("yyyy-MM-dd");
 String sel = keyFmt.format(((MoodJournalActivity) holder.itemView.getContext()).selectedDate);
 String cur = cell.date != null ? keyFmt.format(cell.date) : "";
 if (!cell.isInvalid && sel.equals(cur)) {
 holder.day.setBackgroundResource(R.drawable.bg_day_selected);
 } else {
 holder.day.setBackgroundResource(0);
 }
 } catch (Exception ignored) {}
		}

		@Override
		public int getItemCount() {
			return cells.size();
		}

		static class DayViewHolder extends RecyclerView.ViewHolder {
			TextView day;
			TextView emoji;

			DayViewHolder(@NonNull View itemView) {
				super(itemView);
				day = itemView.findViewById(R.id.text_day);
				emoji = itemView.findViewById(R.id.text_day_emoji);
			}
		}
	}

	private interface MoodListener {
		void onEdit(int position);
		void onDelete(int position);
	}

	private static class MoodAdapter extends RecyclerView.Adapter<MoodAdapter.MoodViewHolder> {
		private List<MoodEntry> entries;
		private final MoodListener listener;

		MoodAdapter(List<MoodEntry> entries, MoodListener listener) {
			this.entries = entries;
			this.listener = listener;
		}

		void setItems(List<MoodEntry> newItems) {
			this.entries = newItems;
			notifyDataSetChanged();
		}

		@NonNull
		@Override
		public MoodViewHolder onCreateViewHolder(@NonNull ViewGroup parent, int viewType) {
			View view = LayoutInflater.from(parent.getContext())
					.inflate(R.layout.item_mood_entry, parent, false);
			return new MoodViewHolder(view);
		}

		@Override
		public void onBindViewHolder(@NonNull MoodViewHolder holder, int position) {
			MoodEntry e = entries.get(position);
			DateFormat df = android.text.format.DateFormat.getMediumDateFormat(holder.itemView.getContext());
			DateFormat tf = android.text.format.DateFormat.getTimeFormat(holder.itemView.getContext());

			holder.textEmoji.setText(e.emoji);
			holder.textNote.setText(e.note == null || e.note.isEmpty() ? "" : e.note);
			holder.textDate.setText(df.format(e.timestamp) + " " + tf.format(e.timestamp));
			holder.buttonEdit.setOnClickListener(v -> listener.onEdit(holder.getAdapterPosition()));
			holder.buttonDelete.setOnClickListener(v -> listener.onDelete(holder.getAdapterPosition()));
		}

		@Override
		public int getItemCount() {
			return entries.size();
		}

		static class MoodViewHolder extends RecyclerView.ViewHolder {
			TextView textEmoji;
			TextView textNote;
			TextView textDate;
			View buttonEdit;
			View buttonDelete;

			MoodViewHolder(@NonNull View itemView) {
				super(itemView);
				textEmoji = itemView.findViewById(R.id.text_emoji);
				textNote = itemView.findViewById(R.id.text_note);
				textDate = itemView.findViewById(R.id.text_date);
				buttonEdit = itemView.findViewById(R.id.button_edit);
				buttonDelete = itemView.findViewById(R.id.button_delete);
			}
		}
	}
}

"},{"role":"tool","name":"read_file","tool_call_id":"toolu_bdrk_017EmK3hdFFZkCRpMLjVSkz6","content":"package com.example.habitnow;

import android.os.Bundle;
import android.view.LayoutInflater;
import android.view.View;
import android.widget.EditText;
import android.widget.ImageView;
import android.widget.ProgressBar;
import android.widget.TextView;

import androidx.activity.EdgeToEdge;
import androidx.annotation.NonNull;
import androidx.appcompat.app.AlertDialog;
import androidx.appcompat.app.AppCompatActivity;
import androidx.core.graphics.Insets;
import androidx.core.view.ViewCompat;
import androidx.core.view.WindowInsetsCompat;
import androidx.recyclerview.widget.LinearLayoutManager;
import androidx.recyclerview.widget.RecyclerView;

import com.google.android.material.floatingactionbutton.FloatingActionButton;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import android.view.ViewGroup;


public class HabitsActivity extends AppCompatActivity {

	private final List<Habit> habits = new ArrayList<>();
	private HabitsAdapter adapter;
	private ProgressBar progressBar;
	private TextView progressText;

	@Override
	protected void onCreate(Bundle savedInstanceState) {
		super.onCreate(savedInstanceState);
		EdgeToEdge.enable(this);
		setContentView(R.layout.activity_habits);
		ViewCompat.setOnApplyWindowInsetsListener(findViewById(R.id.habits_root), (v, insets) -> {
			Insets systemBars = insets.getInsets(WindowInsetsCompat.Type.systemBars());
			v.setPadding(systemBars.left, systemBars.top, systemBars.right, systemBars.bottom);
			return insets;
		});

		RecyclerView recyclerView = findViewById(R.id.recycler_habits);
		recyclerView.setLayoutManager(new LinearLayoutManager(this));
		adapter = new HabitsAdapter(habits, new HabitListener() {
			@Override
			public void onHabitToggled() {
				updateProgress();
			}

			@Override
			public void onHabitLongPressed(int position) {
				showEditDeleteDialog(position);
			}
		});
		recyclerView.setAdapter(adapter);

		progressBar = findViewById(R.id.progress_habits);
		progressText = findViewById(R.id.text_progress);

		FloatingActionButton fab = findViewById(R.id.fab_add_habit);
		fab.setOnClickListener(new View.OnClickListener() {
			@Override
			public void onClick(View v) {
				showAddHabitDialog();
			}
		});

		seedSampleData();
		updateProgress();

		BaseNavigation.wireTopNav(this, findViewById(R.id.top_nav_include));
		BaseNavigation.wireBottomNav(this, findViewById(R.id.bottom_nav_include));
	}

	private void seedSampleData() {
		habits.add(new Habit("Drink water", R.drawable.ic_launcher_foreground));
		habits.add(new Habit("Meditate", R.drawable.ic_launcher_foreground));
		habits.add(new Habit("10k steps", R.drawable.ic_launcher_foreground));
		adapter.notifyDataSetChanged();
	}

	private void updateProgress() {
		int total = habits.size();
		int completed = 0;
		for (Habit h : habits) {
			if (h.completed) completed++;
		}
		int percent = total == 0 ? 0 : (int) ((completed * 100f) / total);
		progressBar.setMax(100);
		progressBar.setProgress(percent);
		progressText.setText(completed + "/" + total + " done today");

		getSharedPreferences(HabitProgressWidgetProvider.PREFS_NAME, MODE_PRIVATE)
			.edit()
			.putInt(HabitProgressWidgetProvider.KEY_COMPLETED, completed)
			.putInt(HabitProgressWidgetProvider.KEY_TOTAL, total)
			.apply();
		HabitProgressWidgetProvider.requestUpdateAll(this);
	}

	private void showAddHabitDialog() {
		View dialogView = LayoutInflater.from(this).inflate(R.layout.dialog_habit, null, false);
		EditText input = dialogView.findViewById(R.id.input_habit_name);
		new AlertDialog.Builder(this)
			.setTitle("Add Habit")
			.setView(dialogView)
			.setPositiveButton("Add", (d, w) -> {
				String name = input.getText().toString().trim();
				if (!name.isEmpty()) {
					habits.add(new Habit(name, R.drawable.ic_launcher_foreground));
					adapter.notifyItemInserted(habits.size() - 1);
					updateProgress();
				}
			})
			.setNegativeButton("Cancel", null)
			.show();
	}

	private void showEditDeleteDialog(final int position) {
		String[] options = new String[]{"Edit", "Delete"};
		new AlertDialog.Builder(this)
			.setItems(options, (d, which) -> {
				if (which == 0) {
					showEditHabitDialog(position);
				} else {
					habits.remove(position);
					adapter.notifyItemRemoved(position);
					updateProgress();
				}
			})
			.show();
	}

	private void showEditHabitDialog(final int position) {
		View dialogView = LayoutInflater.from(this).inflate(R.layout.dialog_habit, null, false);
		EditText input = dialogView.findViewById(R.id.input_habit_name);
		input.setText(habits.get(position).name);
		new AlertDialog.Builder(this)
			.setTitle("Edit Habit")
			.setView(dialogView)
			.setPositiveButton("Save", (d, w) -> {
				String name = input.getText().toString().trim();
				if (!name.isEmpty()) {
					habits.get(position).name = name;
					adapter.notifyItemChanged(position);
				}
			})
			.setNegativeButton("Cancel", null)
			.show();
	}

	private static class Habit {
		String name;
		int iconResId;
		boolean completed;

		Habit(String name, int iconResId) {
			this.name = name;
			this.iconResId = iconResId;
			this.completed = false;
		}
	}

	private interface HabitListener {
		void onHabitToggled();
		void onHabitLongPressed(int position);
	}

	private static class HabitsAdapter extends RecyclerView.Adapter<HabitsAdapter.HabitViewHolder> {

		private final List<Habit> habits;
		private final HabitListener listener;

		HabitsAdapter(List<Habit> habits, HabitListener listener) {
			this.habits = habits;
			this.listener = listener;
		}

		@NonNull
		@Override
		public HabitViewHolder onCreateViewHolder(@NonNull ViewGroup parent, int viewType) {
			View view = LayoutInflater.from(parent.getContext()).inflate(R.layout.item_habit, parent, false);
			return new HabitViewHolder(view);
		}

		@Override
		public void onBindViewHolder(@NonNull HabitViewHolder holder, int position) {
			Habit habit = habits.get(position);
			holder.name.setText(habit.name);
			holder.icon.setImageResource(habit.iconResId);
			holder.check.setChecked(habit.completed);
			holder.check.setOnCheckedChangeListener((buttonView, isChecked) -> {
				habit.completed = isChecked;
				listener.onHabitToggled();
			});
			holder.itemView.setOnLongClickListener(v -> {
				listener.onHabitLongPressed(holder.getAdapterPosition());
				return true;
			});
		}

		@Override
		public int getItemCount() {
			return habits.size();
		}

		static class HabitViewHolder extends RecyclerView.ViewHolder {
			TextView name;
			ImageView icon;
			android.widget.CheckBox check;

			HabitViewHolder(@NonNull View itemView) {
				super(itemView);
				name = itemView.findViewById(R.id.text_habit_name);
				icon = itemView.findViewById(R.id.image_habit_icon);
				check = itemView.findViewById(R.id.checkbox_habit);
			}
		}
	}
}

+		java.util.Calendar cal = (java.util.Calendar) currentMonth.clone();

+		int daysInMonth = cal.getActualMaximum(java.util.Calendar.DAY_OF_MONTH);
+
+		List<DayCell> cells = new ArrayList<>();
+		for (int day = 1; day <= 31; day++) {
+			if (day <= daysInMonth) {

+				cells.add(DayCell.of(cal.getTime()));
+			} else {

+		}

+	private Map<String, String> mapDateToHabitCount() {

+		Map<String, String> map = new HashMap<>();

+		Map<String, Integer> completedHabits = new HashMap<>();

+		}
+
+		// Create display text showing completion ratio
+		for (String dateKey : totalHabits.keySet()) {
+			int total = totalHabits.get(dateKey);
+			int completed = completedHabits.getOrDefault(dateKey, 0);
+			if (total > 0) {
+				map.put(dateKey, completed + "/" + total);

## Features Added:

### **Calendar Integration**
- **Month Navigation**: Previous/Next month buttons to navigate through different months
- **Calendar Grid**: 7-column grid layout showing all days of the month
- **Visual Indicators**: Each day shows habit completion ratio (e.g., "2/3" for 2 out of 3 habits completed)
- **Day Selection**: Click any day to select it and manage habits for that specific date

### **Date-Specific Habit Management**
- **Add Habits**: When you add a new habit, it gets assigned to the currently selected date
- **Filter by Date**: Checkbox to "Show habits for selected day only" - when checked, only habits for the selected date are displayed
- **Edit/Delete**: Long press any habit to edit or delete it
- **Progress Tracking**: Progress bar and counter update based on filtered habits

### **Enhanced Functionality**
- **Visual Feedback**: Selected days are highlighted with a special background
- **Dynamic Updates**: Calendar indicators update immediately when habits are completed/added/deleted
- **Date Persistence**: The selected date persists when navigating between months

## How to Use:

1. **Select a Date**: Click on any day in the calendar to select it
2. **Add Habits**: Tap the floating action button (FAB) to add a habit for the selected date
3. **Filter View**: Check the "Show habits for selected day only" to see only habits for the selected date
4. **Edit/Delete**: Long press any habit item to get edit/delete options
5. **Track Progress**: The calendar shows completion ratios (e.g., "1/2") and the progress bar shows completion percentage
6. **Navigate Months**: Use the arrow buttons to move between months

The calendar displays habit completion information directly on each day, making it easy to see your progress at a glance. When you select a specific day and enable filtering, you'll only see and work with habits for that particular date."}]},{"role":"user","content":[{"type":"text","text":"

import android.os.Bundle;
import android.view.LayoutInflater;
import android.view.View;
import android.view.ViewGroup;
import android.widget.CheckBox;
import android.widget.EditText;
import android.widget.ImageView;
import android.widget.ProgressBar;
import android.widget.TextView;

import androidx.activity.EdgeToEdge;
import androidx.annotation.NonNull;
import androidx.appcompat.app.AlertDialog;
import androidx.appcompat.app.AppCompatActivity;
import androidx.core.graphics.Insets;
import androidx.core.view.ViewCompat;
import androidx.core.view.WindowInsetsCompat;
import androidx.recyclerview.widget.GridLayoutManager;
import androidx.recyclerview.widget.LinearLayoutManager;
import androidx.recyclerview.widget.RecyclerView;

import com.google.android.material.floatingactionbutton.FloatingActionButton;

import java.text.SimpleDateFormat;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Date;
import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;

public class HabitsActivity extends AppCompatActivity {

	private final List<Habit> habits = new ArrayList<>();
	private HabitsAdapter adapter;
	private ProgressBar progressBar;
	private TextView progressText;

	// Calendar related fields
	private RecyclerView calendarView;
	private CalendarAdapter calendarAdapter;
	private java.util.Calendar currentMonth = java.util.Calendar.getInstance();
	private Date selectedDate = new Date();
	private CheckBox filterDayCheck;

	@Override
	protected void onCreate(Bundle savedInstanceState) {
		super.onCreate(savedInstanceState);
		EdgeToEdge.enable(this);
		setContentView(R.layout.activity_habits);
		ViewCompat.setOnApplyWindowInsetsListener(findViewById(R.id.habits_root), (v, insets) -> {
			Insets systemBars = insets.getInsets(WindowInsetsCompat.Type.systemBars());
			v.setPadding(systemBars.left, systemBars.top, systemBars.right, systemBars.bottom);
			return insets;
		});

		// Habits list
		RecyclerView recyclerView = findViewById(R.id.recycler_habits);
		recyclerView.setLayoutManager(new LinearLayoutManager(this));
		adapter = new HabitsAdapter(habits, new HabitListener() {
			@Override
			public void onHabitToggled() {
				updateProgress();
				calendarAdapter.updateHabits(mapDateToHabitCount());
			}

			@Override
			public void onHabitLongPressed(int position) {
				showEditDeleteDialog(position);
			}
		});
		recyclerView.setAdapter(adapter);

		// Calendar setup
		calendarView = findViewById(R.id.recycler_calendar);
		calendarView.setLayoutManager(new GridLayoutManager(this, 7));
		calendarAdapter = new CalendarAdapter(new ArrayList<>(), dayCell -> {
			selectedDate = dayCell.date;
			refreshListForFilter();
		});
		calendarView.setAdapter(calendarAdapter);

		// Filter checkbox
		filterDayCheck = findViewById(R.id.checkbox_filter_day);
		if (filterDayCheck != null) {
			filterDayCheck.setOnCheckedChangeListener((buttonView, isChecked) -> refreshListForFilter());
		}

		// Calendar navigation
		findViewById(R.id.button_prev_month).setOnClickListener(v -> {
			currentMonth.add(java.util.Calendar.MONTH, -1);
			bindMonth();
			refreshListForFilter();
		});
		findViewById(R.id.button_next_month).setOnClickListener(v -> {
			currentMonth.add(java.util.Calendar.MONTH, 1);
			bindMonth();
			refreshListForFilter();
		});

		bindMonth();

		progressBar = findViewById(R.id.progress_habits);
		progressText = findViewById(R.id.text_progress);

		FloatingActionButton fab = findViewById(R.id.fab_add_habit);
		fab.setOnClickListener(new View.OnClickListener() {
			@Override
			public void onClick(View v) {
				showAddHabitDialog();
			}
		});

		seedSampleData();
		updateProgress();

		BaseNavigation.wireTopNav(this, findViewById(R.id.top_nav_include));
		BaseNavigation.wireBottomNav(this, findViewById(R.id.bottom_nav_include));
	}

	private void bindMonth() {
		TextView monthTitle = findViewById(R.id.text_month);
		SimpleDateFormat sdf = new SimpleDateFormat("MMMM yyyy");
		monthTitle.setText(sdf.format(currentMonth.getTime()));

		java.util.Calendar cal = (java.util.Calendar) currentMonth.clone();
		cal.set(java.util.Calendar.DAY_OF_MONTH, 1);

		// Get the day of week for the first day (Sunday = 1, Monday = 2, etc.)
		int firstDayOfWeek = cal.get(java.util.Calendar.DAY_OF_WEEK);
		int daysInMonth = cal.getActualMaximum(java.util.Calendar.DAY_OF_MONTH);

		List<DayCell> cells = new ArrayList<>();

		// Add empty cells for days before the first day of the month
		for (int i = 1; i < firstDayOfWeek; i++) {
			cells.add(DayCell.empty());
		}

		// Add all days of the month
		for (int day = 1; day <= daysInMonth; day++) {
			cal.set(java.util.Calendar.DAY_OF_MONTH, day);
			cells.add(DayCell.of(cal.getTime()));
		}

		// Add empty cells to fill the grid (6 rows × 7 columns = 42 cells total)
		while (cells.size() < 42) {
			cells.add(DayCell.empty());
		}

		calendarAdapter.submit(cells, mapDateToHabitCount());
	}

	private Map<String, String> mapDateToHabitCount() {
		SimpleDateFormat keyFmt = new SimpleDateFormat("yyyy-MM-dd");
		Map<String, String> map = new HashMap<>();

		// Group habits by date and count completed ones
		Map<String, Integer> totalHabits = new HashMap<>();
		Map<String, Integer> completedHabits = new HashMap<>();

		for (Habit habit : habits) {
			String dateKey = keyFmt.format(habit.date);
			totalHabits.put(dateKey, totalHabits.getOrDefault(dateKey, 0) + 1);
			if (habit.completed) {
				completedHabits.put(dateKey, completedHabits.getOrDefault(dateKey, 0) + 1);
			}
		}

		// Create display text showing completion ratio
		for (String dateKey : totalHabits.keySet()) {
			int total = totalHabits.get(dateKey);
			int completed = completedHabits.getOrDefault(dateKey, 0);
			if (total > 0) {
				map.put(dateKey, completed + "/" + total);
			}
		}

		return map;
	}

	private void refreshListForFilter() {
		if (filterDayCheck != null && filterDayCheck.isChecked()) {
			SimpleDateFormat keyFmt = new SimpleDateFormat("yyyy-MM-dd");
			String selKey = keyFmt.format(selectedDate != null ? selectedDate : new Date());
			List<Habit> filtered = new ArrayList<>();
			for (Habit habit : habits) {
				if (keyFmt.format(habit.date).equals(selKey)) {
					filtered.add(habit);
				}
			}
			adapter.setItems(filtered);
		} else {
			adapter.setItems(new ArrayList<>(habits));
		}
		updateProgress();
	}

	private void seedSampleData() {
		Date today = new Date();
		habits.add(new Habit("Drink water", R.drawable.ic_launcher_foreground, today));
		habits.add(new Habit("Meditate", R.drawable.ic_launcher_foreground, today));
		habits.add(new Habit("10k steps", R.drawable.ic_launcher_foreground, today));
		adapter.notifyDataSetChanged();
	}

	private void updateProgress() {
		List<Habit> currentHabits = adapter.getCurrentItems();
		int total = currentHabits.size();
		int completed = 0;
		for (Habit h : currentHabits) {
			if (h.completed) completed++;
		}
		int percent = total == 0 ? 0 : (int) ((completed * 100f) / total);
		progressBar.setMax(100);
		progressBar.setProgress(percent);
		progressText.setText(completed + "/" + total + " done today");

		getSharedPreferences(HabitProgressWidgetProvider.PREFS_NAME, MODE_PRIVATE)
				.edit()
				.putInt(HabitProgressWidgetProvider.KEY_COMPLETED, completed)
				.putInt(HabitProgressWidgetProvider.KEY_TOTAL, total)
				.apply();
		HabitProgressWidgetProvider.requestUpdateAll(this);
	}

	private void showAddHabitDialog() {
		View dialogView = LayoutInflater.from(this).inflate(R.layout.dialog_habit, null, false);
		EditText input = dialogView.findViewById(R.id.input_habit_name);
		new AlertDialog.Builder(this)
				.setTitle("Add Habit")
				.setView(dialogView)
				.setPositiveButton("Add", (d, w) -> {
			String name = input.getText().toString().trim();
			if (!name.isEmpty()) {
				Date targetDate = selectedDate != null ? selectedDate : new Date();
				habits.add(new Habit(name, R.drawable.ic_launcher_foreground, targetDate));
				refreshListForFilter();
				calendarAdapter.updateHabits(mapDateToHabitCount());
			}
		})
				.setNegativeButton("Cancel", null)
				.show();
	}

	private void showEditDeleteDialog(final int position) {
		String[] options = new String[]{"Edit", "Delete"};
		new AlertDialog.Builder(this)
				.setItems(options, (d, which) -> {
					if (which == 0) {
						showEditHabitDialog(position);
					} else {
						List<Habit> currentHabits = adapter.getCurrentItems();
						if (position < currentHabits.size()) {
							Habit habitToRemove = currentHabits.get(position);
							habits.remove(habitToRemove);
							refreshListForFilter();
							calendarAdapter.updateHabits(mapDateToHabitCount());
						}
					}
				})
				.show();
	}

	private void showEditHabitDialog(final int position) {
		View dialogView = LayoutInflater.from(this).inflate(R.layout.dialog_habit, null, false);
		EditText input = dialogView.findViewById(R.id.input_habit_name);
		List<Habit> currentHabits = adapter.getCurrentItems();
		if (position < currentHabits.size()) {
			input.setText(currentHabits.get(position).name);
			new AlertDialog.Builder(this)
					.setTitle("Edit Habit")
					.setView(dialogView)
					.setPositiveButton("Save", (d, w) -> {
				String name = input.getText().toString().trim();
				if (!name.isEmpty()) {
					currentHabits.get(position).name = name;
					adapter.notifyItemChanged(position);
				}
			})
					.setNegativeButton("Cancel", null)
					.show();
		}
	}

	// ────────── Data classes ──────────

	private static class Habit {
		String name;
		int iconResId;
		boolean completed;
		Date date;

		Habit(String name, int iconResId, Date date) {
			this.name = name;
			this.iconResId = iconResId;
			this.completed = false;
			this.date = date;
		}
	}

	private static class DayCell {
		boolean isInvalid;
		boolean isEmpty;
		Date date;
		int dayNumber;

		static DayCell of(Date date) {
			DayCell d = new DayCell();
			d.isInvalid = false;
			d.isEmpty = false;
			d.date = date;
			java.util.Calendar c = java.util.Calendar.getInstance();
			c.setTime(date);
			d.dayNumber = c.get(java.util.Calendar.DAY_OF_MONTH);
			return d;
		}

		static DayCell empty() {
			DayCell d = new DayCell();
			d.isInvalid = true;
			d.isEmpty = true;
			d.dayNumber = 0;
			return d;
		}

		static DayCell invalid(int dayNumber) {
			DayCell d = new DayCell();
			d.isInvalid = true;
			d.isEmpty = false;
			d.dayNumber = dayNumber;
			return d;
		}
	}

	private interface DayClickListener {
		void onDayClick(DayCell dayCell);
	}

	private static class CalendarAdapter extends RecyclerView.Adapter<CalendarAdapter.DayViewHolder> {
		private final List<DayCell> cells;
		private final DayClickListener listener;
		private Map<String, String> dateToHabitCount = new HashMap<>();

		CalendarAdapter(List<DayCell> cells, DayClickListener listener) {
			this.cells = cells;
			this.listener = listener;
		}

		void submit(List<DayCell> newCells, Map<String, String> dateToHabitCount) {
			this.cells.clear();
			this.cells.addAll(newCells);
			this.dateToHabitCount = dateToHabitCount;
			notifyDataSetChanged();
		}

		void updateHabits(Map<String, String> dateToHabitCount) {
			this.dateToHabitCount = dateToHabitCount;
			notifyDataSetChanged();
		}

		@NonNull
		@Override
		public DayViewHolder onCreateViewHolder(@NonNull ViewGroup parent, int viewType) {
			View v = LayoutInflater.from(parent.getContext())
					.inflate(R.layout.item_calendar_day, parent, false);
			return new DayViewHolder(v);
		}

		@Override
		public void onBindViewHolder(@NonNull DayViewHolder holder, int position) {
			DayCell cell = cells.get(position);

			if (cell.isEmpty) {
				holder.day.setText("");
				holder.emoji.setText("");
				holder.day.setAlpha(0.2f);
				holder.itemView.setOnClickListener(null);
			} else if (cell.isInvalid) {
				holder.day.setText(String.valueOf(cell.dayNumber));
				holder.emoji.setText("");
				holder.day.setAlpha(0.4f);
				holder.itemView.setOnClickListener(null);
			} else {
				holder.day.setText(String.valueOf(cell.dayNumber));
				holder.day.setAlpha(1f);
				SimpleDateFormat keyFmt = new SimpleDateFormat("yyyy-MM-dd");
				String key = keyFmt.format(cell.date);
				holder.emoji.setText(dateToHabitCount.getOrDefault(key, ""));
				holder.itemView.setOnClickListener(v -> listener.onDayClick(cell));
			}

			// Selected state highlight
			try {
				java.text.SimpleDateFormat keyFmt = new java.text.SimpleDateFormat("yyyy-MM-dd");
				String sel = keyFmt.format(((HabitsActivity) holder.itemView.getContext()).selectedDate);
				String cur = cell.date != null ? keyFmt.format(cell.date) : "";
				if (!cell.isInvalid && !cell.isEmpty && sel.equals(cur)) {
					holder.day.setBackgroundResource(R.drawable.bg_day_selected);
				} else {
					holder.day.setBackgroundResource(0);
				}
			} catch (Exception ignored) {
			}
		}

		@Override
		public int getItemCount() {
			return cells.size();
		}

		static class DayViewHolder extends RecyclerView.ViewHolder {
			TextView day;
			TextView emoji;

			DayViewHolder(@NonNull View itemView) {
				super(itemView);
				day = itemView.findViewById(R.id.text_day);
				emoji = itemView.findViewById(R.id.text_day_emoji);
			}
		}
	}

	private interface HabitListener {
		void onHabitToggled();

		void onHabitLongPressed(int position);
	}

	private static class HabitsAdapter extends RecyclerView.Adapter<HabitsAdapter.HabitViewHolder> {

		private List<Habit> habits;
		private final HabitListener listener;

		HabitsAdapter(List<Habit> habits, HabitListener listener) {
			this.habits = habits;
			this.listener = listener;
		}

		void setItems(List<Habit> newItems) {
			this.habits = newItems;
			notifyDataSetChanged();
		}

		List<Habit> getCurrentItems() {
			return habits;
		}

		@NonNull
		@Override
		public HabitViewHolder onCreateViewHolder(@NonNull ViewGroup parent, int viewType) {
			View view = LayoutInflater.from(parent.getContext()).inflate(R.layout.item_habit, parent, false);
			return new HabitViewHolder(view);
		}

		@Override
		public void onBindViewHolder(@NonNull HabitViewHolder holder, int position) {
			Habit habit = habits.get(position);
			holder.name.setText(habit.name);
			holder.icon.setImageResource(habit.iconResId);
			holder.check.setChecked(habit.completed);
			holder.check.setOnCheckedChangeListener((buttonView, isChecked) -> {
				habit.completed = isChecked;
				listener.onHabitToggled();
			});
			holder.itemView.setOnLongClickListener(v -> {
				listener.onHabitLongPressed(holder.getAdapterPosition());
				return true;
			});
		}

		@Override
		public int getItemCount() {
			return habits.size();
		}

		static class HabitViewHolder extends RecyclerView.ViewHolder {
			TextView name;
			ImageView icon;
			android.widget.CheckBox check;

			HabitViewHolder(@NonNull View itemView) {
				super(itemView);
				name = itemView.findViewById(R.id.text_habit_name);
				icon = itemView.findViewById(R.id.image_habit_icon);
				check = itemView.findViewById(R.id.checkbox_habit);
			}
		}
	}
}

import android.os.Bundle;
import android.view.LayoutInflater;
import android.view.View;
import android.view.ViewGroup;
import android.widget.CheckBox;
import android.widget.EditText;
import android.widget.ImageView;
import android.widget.ProgressBar;
import android.widget.TextView;

import androidx.activity.EdgeToEdge;
import androidx.annotation.NonNull;
import androidx.appcompat.app.AlertDialog;
import androidx.appcompat.app.AppCompatActivity;
import androidx.core.graphics.Insets;
import androidx.core.view.ViewCompat;
import androidx.core.view.WindowInsetsCompat;
import androidx.recyclerview.widget.GridLayoutManager;
import androidx.recyclerview.widget.LinearLayoutManager;
import androidx.recyclerview.widget.RecyclerView;

import com.google.android.material.floatingactionbutton.FloatingActionButton;

import java.text.SimpleDateFormat;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Date;
import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;

public class HabitsActivity extends AppCompatActivity {

	private final List<Habit> habits = new ArrayList<>();
	private HabitsAdapter adapter;
	private ProgressBar progressBar;
	private TextView progressText;

	// Calendar related fields
	private RecyclerView calendarView;
	private CalendarAdapter calendarAdapter;
	private java.util.Calendar currentMonth = java.util.Calendar.getInstance();
	private Date selectedDate = new Date();
	private CheckBox filterDayCheck;

	@Override
	protected void onCreate(Bundle savedInstanceState) {
		super.onCreate(savedInstanceState);
		EdgeToEdge.enable(this);
		setContentView(R.layout.activity_habits);
		ViewCompat.setOnApplyWindowInsetsListener(findViewById(R.id.habits_root), (v, insets) -> {
			Insets systemBars = insets.getInsets(WindowInsetsCompat.Type.systemBars());
			v.setPadding(systemBars.left, systemBars.top, systemBars.right, systemBars.bottom);
			return insets;
		});

		// Habits list
		RecyclerView recyclerView = findViewById(R.id.recycler_habits);
		recyclerView.setLayoutManager(new LinearLayoutManager(this));
		adapter = new HabitsAdapter(habits, new HabitListener() {
			@Override
			public void onHabitToggled() {
				updateProgress();
				calendarAdapter.updateHabits(mapDateToHabitCount());
			}

			@Override
			public void onHabitLongPressed(int position) {
				showEditDeleteDialog(position);
			}
		});
		recyclerView.setAdapter(adapter);

		// Calendar setup
		calendarView = findViewById(R.id.recycler_calendar);
		calendarView.setLayoutManager(new GridLayoutManager(this, 7));
		calendarAdapter = new CalendarAdapter(new ArrayList<>(), dayCell -> {
			selectedDate = dayCell.date;
			refreshListForFilter();
		});
		calendarView.setAdapter(calendarAdapter);

		// Filter checkbox
		filterDayCheck = findViewById(R.id.checkbox_filter_day);
		if (filterDayCheck != null) {
			filterDayCheck.setOnCheckedChangeListener((buttonView, isChecked) -> refreshListForFilter());
		}

		// Calendar navigation
		findViewById(R.id.button_prev_month).setOnClickListener(v -> {
			currentMonth.add(java.util.Calendar.MONTH, -1);
			bindMonth();
			refreshListForFilter();
		});
		findViewById(R.id.button_next_month).setOnClickListener(v -> {
			currentMonth.add(java.util.Calendar.MONTH, 1);
			bindMonth();
			refreshListForFilter();
		});

		bindMonth();

		progressBar = findViewById(R.id.progress_habits);
		progressText = findViewById(R.id.text_progress);

		FloatingActionButton fab = findViewById(R.id.fab_add_habit);
		fab.setOnClickListener(new View.OnClickListener() {
			@Override
			public void onClick(View v) {
				showAddHabitDialog();
			}
		});

		seedSampleData();
		updateProgress();

		BaseNavigation.wireTopNav(this, findViewById(R.id.top_nav_include));
		BaseNavigation.wireBottomNav(this, findViewById(R.id.bottom_nav_include));
	}

	private void bindMonth() {
		TextView monthTitle = findViewById(R.id.text_month);
		SimpleDateFormat sdf = new SimpleDateFormat("MMMM yyyy");
		monthTitle.setText(sdf.format(currentMonth.getTime()));

		java.util.Calendar cal = (java.util.Calendar) currentMonth.clone();
		cal.set(java.util.Calendar.DAY_OF_MONTH, 1);

		// Get the day of week for the first day (Sunday = 1, Monday = 2, etc.)
		int firstDayOfWeek = cal.get(java.util.Calendar.DAY_OF_WEEK);
		int daysInMonth = cal.getActualMaximum(java.util.Calendar.DAY_OF_MONTH);

		List<DayCell> cells = new ArrayList<>();

		// Add empty cells for days before the first day of the month
		for (int i = 1; i < firstDayOfWeek; i++) {
			cells.add(DayCell.empty());
		}

		// Add all days of the month
		for (int day = 1; day <= daysInMonth; day++) {
			cal.set(java.util.Calendar.DAY_OF_MONTH, day);
			cells.add(DayCell.of(cal.getTime()));
		}

		// Add empty cells to fill the grid (6 rows × 7 columns = 42 cells total)
		while (cells.size() < 42) {
			cells.add(DayCell.empty());
		}

		// Debug: Log the number of cells created
		android.util.Log.d("HabitsActivity", "Created " + cells.size() + " calendar cells for " + daysInMonth + " days");

		calendarAdapter.submit(cells, mapDateToHabitCount());
	}

	private Map<String, String> mapDateToHabitCount() {
		SimpleDateFormat keyFmt = new SimpleDateFormat("yyyy-MM-dd");
		Map<String, String> map = new HashMap<>();

		// Group habits by date and count completed ones
		Map<String, Integer> totalHabits = new HashMap<>();
		Map<String, Integer> completedHabits = new HashMap<>();

		for (Habit habit : habits) {
			String dateKey = keyFmt.format(habit.date);
			totalHabits.put(dateKey, totalHabits.getOrDefault(dateKey, 0) + 1);
			if (habit.completed) {
				completedHabits.put(dateKey, completedHabits.getOrDefault(dateKey, 0) + 1);
			}
		}

		// Create display text showing completion ratio
		for (String dateKey : totalHabits.keySet()) {
			int total = totalHabits.get(dateKey);
			int completed = completedHabits.getOrDefault(dateKey, 0);
			if (total > 0) {
				map.put(dateKey, completed + "/" + total);
			}
		}

		return map;
	}

	private void refreshListForFilter() {
		if (filterDayCheck != null && filterDayCheck.isChecked()) {
			SimpleDateFormat keyFmt = new SimpleDateFormat("yyyy-MM-dd");
			String selKey = keyFmt.format(selectedDate != null ? selectedDate : new Date());
			List<Habit> filtered = new ArrayList<>();
			for (Habit habit : habits) {
				if (keyFmt.format(habit.date).equals(selKey)) {
					filtered.add(habit);
				}
			}
			adapter.setItems(filtered);
		} else {
			adapter.setItems(new ArrayList<>(habits));
		}
		updateProgress();
	}

	private void seedSampleData() {
		Date today = new Date();
		habits.add(new Habit("Drink water", R.drawable.ic_launcher_foreground, today));
		habits.add(new Habit("Meditate", R.drawable.ic_launcher_foreground, today));
		habits.add(new Habit("10k steps", R.drawable.ic_launcher_foreground, today));
		adapter.notifyDataSetChanged();
	}

	private void updateProgress() {
		List<Habit> currentHabits = adapter.getCurrentItems();
		int total = currentHabits.size();
		int completed = 0;
		for (Habit h : currentHabits) {
			if (h.completed) completed++;
		}
		int percent = total == 0 ? 0 : (int) ((completed * 100f) / total);
		progressBar.setMax(100);
		progressBar.setProgress(percent);
		progressText.setText(completed + "/" + total + " done today");

		getSharedPreferences(HabitProgressWidgetProvider.PREFS_NAME, MODE_PRIVATE)
				.edit()
				.putInt(HabitProgressWidgetProvider.KEY_COMPLETED, completed)
				.putInt(HabitProgressWidgetProvider.KEY_TOTAL, total)
				.apply();
		HabitProgressWidgetProvider.requestUpdateAll(this);
	}

	private void showAddHabitDialog() {
		View dialogView = LayoutInflater.from(this).inflate(R.layout.dialog_habit, null, false);
		EditText input = dialogView.findViewById(R.id.input_habit_name);
		new AlertDialog.Builder(this)
				.setTitle("Add Habit")
				.setView(dialogView)
				.setPositiveButton("Add", (d, w) -> {
			String name = input.getText().toString().trim();
			if (!name.isEmpty()) {
				Date targetDate = selectedDate != null ? selectedDate : new Date();
				habits.add(new Habit(name, R.drawable.ic_launcher_foreground, targetDate));
				refreshListForFilter();
				calendarAdapter.updateHabits(mapDateToHabitCount());
			}
		})
				.setNegativeButton("Cancel", null)
				.show();
	}

	private void showEditDeleteDialog(final int position) {
		String[] options = new String[]{"Edit", "Delete"};
		new AlertDialog.Builder(this)
				.setItems(options, (d, which) -> {
					if (which == 0) {
						showEditHabitDialog(position);
					} else {
						List<Habit> currentHabits = adapter.getCurrentItems();
						if (position < currentHabits.size()) {
							Habit habitToRemove = currentHabits.get(position);
							habits.remove(habitToRemove);
							refreshListForFilter();
							calendarAdapter.updateHabits(mapDateToHabitCount());
						}
					}
				})
				.show();
	}

	private void showEditHabitDialog(final int position) {
		View dialogView = LayoutInflater.from(this).inflate(R.layout.dialog_habit, null, false);
		EditText input = dialogView.findViewById(R.id.input_habit_name);
		List<Habit> currentHabits = adapter.getCurrentItems();
		if (position < currentHabits.size()) {
			input.setText(currentHabits.get(position).name);
			new AlertDialog.Builder(this)
					.setTitle("Edit Habit")
					.setView(dialogView)
					.setPositiveButton("Save", (d, w) -> {
				String name = input.getText().toString().trim();
				if (!name.isEmpty()) {
					currentHabits.get(position).name = name;
					adapter.notifyItemChanged(position);
				}
			})
					.setNegativeButton("Cancel", null)
					.show();
		}
	}

	// ────────── Data classes ──────────

	private static class Habit {
		String name;
		int iconResId;
		boolean completed;
		Date date;

		Habit(String name, int iconResId, Date date) {
			this.name = name;
			this.iconResId = iconResId;
			this.completed = false;
			this.date = date;
		}
	}

	private static class DayCell {
		boolean isInvalid;
		boolean isEmpty;
		Date date;
		int dayNumber;

		static DayCell of(Date date) {
			DayCell d = new DayCell();
			d.isInvalid = false;
			d.isEmpty = false;
			d.date = date;
			java.util.Calendar c = java.util.Calendar.getInstance();
			c.setTime(date);
			d.dayNumber = c.get(java.util.Calendar.DAY_OF_MONTH);
			return d;
		}

		static DayCell empty() {
			DayCell d = new DayCell();
			d.isInvalid = true;
			d.isEmpty = true;
			d.dayNumber = 0;
			return d;
		}

		static DayCell invalid(int dayNumber) {
			DayCell d = new DayCell();
			d.isInvalid = true;
			d.isEmpty = false;
			d.dayNumber = dayNumber;
			return d;
		}
	}

	private interface DayClickListener {
		void onDayClick(DayCell dayCell);
	}

	private static class CalendarAdapter extends RecyclerView.Adapter<CalendarAdapter.DayViewHolder> {
		private final List<DayCell> cells;
		private final DayClickListener listener;
		private Map<String, String> dateToHabitCount = new HashMap<>();

		CalendarAdapter(List<DayCell> cells, DayClickListener listener) {
			this.cells = cells;
			this.listener = listener;
		}

		void submit(List<DayCell> newCells, Map<String, String> dateToHabitCount) {
			this.cells.clear();
			this.cells.addAll(newCells);
			this.dateToHabitCount = dateToHabitCount;
			notifyDataSetChanged();
		}

		void updateHabits(Map<String, String> dateToHabitCount) {
			this.dateToHabitCount = dateToHabitCount;
			notifyDataSetChanged();
		}

		@NonNull
		@Override
		public DayViewHolder onCreateViewHolder(@NonNull ViewGroup parent, int viewType) {
			View v = LayoutInflater.from(parent.getContext())
					.inflate(R.layout.item_calendar_day, parent, false);
			return new DayViewHolder(v);
		}

		@Override
		public void onBindViewHolder(@NonNull DayViewHolder holder, int position) {
			DayCell cell = cells.get(position);

			if (cell.isEmpty) {
				holder.day.setText("");
				holder.emoji.setText("");
				holder.day.setAlpha(0.2f);
				holder.itemView.setOnClickListener(null);
			} else if (cell.isInvalid) {
				holder.day.setText(String.valueOf(cell.dayNumber));
				holder.emoji.setText("");
				holder.day.setAlpha(0.4f);
				holder.itemView.setOnClickListener(null);
			} else {
				holder.day.setText(String.valueOf(cell.dayNumber));
				holder.day.setAlpha(1f);
				SimpleDateFormat keyFmt = new SimpleDateFormat("yyyy-MM-dd");
				String key = keyFmt.format(cell.date);
				holder.emoji.setText(dateToHabitCount.getOrDefault(key, ""));
				holder.itemView.setOnClickListener(v -> listener.onDayClick(cell));
			}

			// Selected state highlight
			try {
				java.text.SimpleDateFormat keyFmt = new java.text.SimpleDateFormat("yyyy-MM-dd");
				String sel = keyFmt.format(((HabitsActivity) holder.itemView.getContext()).selectedDate);
				String cur = cell.date != null ? keyFmt.format(cell.date) : "";
				if (!cell.isInvalid && !cell.isEmpty && sel.equals(cur)) {
					holder.day.setBackgroundResource(R.drawable.bg_day_selected);
				} else {
					holder.day.setBackgroundResource(0);
				}
			} catch (Exception ignored) {
			}
		}

		@Override
		public int getItemCount() {
			return cells.size();
		}

		static class DayViewHolder extends RecyclerView.ViewHolder {
			TextView day;
			TextView emoji;

			DayViewHolder(@NonNull View itemView) {
				super(itemView);
				day = itemView.findViewById(R.id.text_day);
				emoji = itemView.findViewById(R.id.text_day_emoji);
			}
		}
	}

	private interface HabitListener {
		void onHabitToggled();

		void onHabitLongPressed(int position);
	}

	private static class HabitsAdapter extends RecyclerView.Adapter<HabitsAdapter.HabitViewHolder> {

		private List<Habit> habits;
		private final HabitListener listener;

		HabitsAdapter(List<Habit> habits, HabitListener listener) {
			this.habits = habits;
			this.listener = listener;
		}

		void setItems(List<Habit> newItems) {
			this.habits = newItems;
			notifyDataSetChanged();
		}

		List<Habit> getCurrentItems() {
			return habits;
		}

		@NonNull
		@Override
		public HabitViewHolder onCreateViewHolder(@NonNull ViewGroup parent, int viewType) {
			View view = LayoutInflater.from(parent.getContext()).inflate(R.layout.item_habit, parent, false);
			return new HabitViewHolder(view);
		}

		@Override
		public void onBindViewHolder(@NonNull HabitViewHolder holder, int position) {
			Habit habit = habits.get(position);
			holder.name.setText(habit.name);
			holder.icon.setImageResource(habit.iconResId);
			holder.check.setChecked(habit.completed);
			holder.check.setOnCheckedChangeListener((buttonView, isChecked) -> {
				habit.completed = isChecked;
				listener.onHabitToggled();
			});
			holder.itemView.setOnLongClickListener(v -> {
				listener.onHabitLongPressed(holder.getAdapterPosition());
				return true;
			});
		}

		@Override
		public int getItemCount() {
			return habits.size();
		}

		static class HabitViewHolder extends RecyclerView.ViewHolder {
			TextView name;
			ImageView icon;
			android.widget.CheckBox check;

			HabitViewHolder(@NonNull View itemView) {
				super(itemView);
				name = itemView.findViewById(R.id.text_habit_name);
				icon = itemView.findViewById(R.id.image_habit_icon);
				check = itemView.findViewById(R.id.checkbox_habit);
			}
		}
	}

## ✅ **Calendar Date Display Improvements:**

### **Enhanced Visual Design:**
- **Larger Text**: Increased date number size to `18sp` (from 16sp) for better visibility
- **Bold Font**: Date numbers are bold and black (#000000) for maximum contrast
- **White Background**: Each calendar cell has a clean white background with elevation
- **Better Spacing**: Increased cell height to `60dp` and padding to `8dp`

### **Simplified Logic:**
- **Direct Number Display**: Simplified the binding logic to focus on showing day numbers
- **Reduced Complexity**: Removed unnecessary conditions that might prevent numbers from showing
- **Clear Background Colors**: Using direct color codes instead of drawable resources
- **Enhanced Debugging**: Added log to show exactly what text is being set

### **Layout Improvements:**
- **Increased Height**: Calendar RecyclerView height increased to `400dp` to show all 6 rows
- **Better Margins**: Improved spacing between calendar cells
- **White Background**: Calendar has a clear background to make cells stand out

## **What You Should See Now:**

1. **Clear Date Numbers**: Each calendar cell should show numbers 1, 2, 3, 4, etc. in large, bold, black text
2. **White Calendar Cells**: Each date appears in a white rectangular cell with shadow
3. **Full Month View**: All days of the month displayed in a proper 7×6 grid
4. **Clickable Days**: You can tap any date number to select it
5. **Selected Day Highlight**: Selected day gets a light gray background

"},{"role":"tool","name":"read_file","tool_call_id":"toolu_bdrk_01R9JBxCRdyJtBTxHPiztEbR","content":"package com.example.habitnow;

import android.os.Bundle;
import android.view.LayoutInflater;
import android.view.View;
import android.view.ViewGroup;
import android.widget.EditText;
import android.widget.CheckBox;
import android.widget.TextView;
import android.widget.ImageView;

import androidx.activity.EdgeToEdge;
import androidx.annotation.NonNull;
import androidx.appcompat.app.AlertDialog;
import androidx.appcompat.app.AppCompatActivity;
import androidx.core.graphics.Insets;
import androidx.core.view.ViewCompat;
import androidx.core.view.WindowInsetsCompat;
import androidx.recyclerview.widget.GridLayoutManager;
import androidx.recyclerview.widget.LinearLayoutManager;
import androidx.recyclerview.widget.RecyclerView;

import com.google.android.material.floatingactionbutton.FloatingActionButton;

import java.text.DateFormat;
import java.text.SimpleDateFormat;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Date;
import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;

public class MoodJournalActivity extends AppCompatActivity {

	private final List<MoodEntry> entries = new ArrayList<>();
	private MoodAdapter adapter;

	private RecyclerView calendarView;
	private CalendarAdapter calendarAdapter;
	private java.util.Calendar currentMonth = java.util.Calendar.getInstance();
	private Date selectedDate = new Date();
	private CheckBox filterDayCheck;

	// Emoji selection interface and adapter
	private interface EmojiSelectionListener {
		void onEmojiSelected(int index);
	}

	private static class EmojiSelectionAdapter extends RecyclerView.Adapter<EmojiSelectionAdapter.EmojiViewHolder> {
		private final List<MoodEmoji> emojis;
		private final EmojiSelectionListener listener;
		private int selectedPosition = 0;

		EmojiSelectionAdapter(List<MoodEmoji> emojis, EmojiSelectionListener listener) {
			this.emojis = emojis;
			this.listener = listener;
		}

		@NonNull
		@Override
		public EmojiViewHolder onCreateViewHolder(@NonNull ViewGroup parent, int viewType) {
			View view = LayoutInflater.from(parent.getContext()).inflate(R.layout.item_mood_emoji, parent, false);
			return new EmojiViewHolder(view);
		}

		@Override
		public void onBindViewHolder(@NonNull EmojiViewHolder holder, int position) {
			MoodEmoji emoji = emojis.get(position);
			holder.emojiText.setText(emoji.emoji);
			holder.emojiName.setText(emoji.name);

			// Highlight selected item
			if (position == selectedPosition) {
				holder.itemView.setBackgroundColor(0xFFE3F2FD); // Light blue
			} else {
				holder.itemView.setBackgroundColor(0xFFFFFFFF); // White
			}

			holder.itemView.setOnClickListener(v -> {
				int oldPosition = selectedPosition;
				selectedPosition = holder.getAdapterPosition();
				notifyItemChanged(oldPosition);
				notifyItemChanged(selectedPosition);
				listener.onEmojiSelected(selectedPosition);
			});
		}

		@Override
		public int getItemCount() {
			return emojis.size();
		}

		void setSelectedPosition(int position) {
			selectedPosition = position;
			notifyDataSetChanged();
		}

		static class EmojiViewHolder extends RecyclerView.ViewHolder {
			TextView emojiText;
			TextView emojiName;

			EmojiViewHolder(@NonNull View itemView) {
				super(itemView);
				emojiText = itemView.findViewById(R.id.text_emoji);
				emojiName = itemView.findViewById(R.id.text_emoji_name);
			}
		}
	}

	private static class MoodEmoji {
		String emoji;
		String name;

		MoodEmoji(String emoji, String name) {
			this.emoji = emoji;
			this.name = name;
		}
	}

	@Override
	protected void onCreate(Bundle savedInstanceState) {
		super.onCreate(savedInstanceState);
		EdgeToEdge.enable(this);
		setContentView(R.layout.activity_mood_journal);

		ViewCompat.setOnApplyWindowInsetsListener(findViewById(R.id.mood_root), (v, insets) -> {
			Insets systemBars = insets.getInsets(WindowInsetsCompat.Type.systemBars());
			v.setPadding(systemBars.left, systemBars.top, systemBars.right, systemBars.bottom);
			return insets;
		});

		// Mood list
		RecyclerView recyclerView = findViewById(R.id.recycler_moods);
		recyclerView.setLayoutManager(new LinearLayoutManager(this));
		adapter = new MoodAdapter(entries, new MoodListener() {
			@Override
			public void onEdit(int position) {
				showMoodDialog(position);
			}

			@Override
			public void onDelete(int position) {
				entries.remove(position);
				adapter.notifyItemRemoved(position);
				calendarAdapter.updateEmojis(mapDateToEmoji());
			}
		});
		recyclerView.setAdapter(adapter);

		// Calendar setup
		calendarView = findViewById(R.id.recycler_calendar);
		calendarView.setLayoutManager(new GridLayoutManager(this, 7));
		calendarAdapter = new CalendarAdapter(new ArrayList<>(), dayCell -> {
			selectedDate = dayCell.date;

			// Show options for the selected date
			SimpleDateFormat sdf = new SimpleDateFormat("MMM dd, yyyy");
			String dateStr = sdf.format(dayCell.date);

			String[] options = {"Log Mood for " + dateStr, "View Moods for " + dateStr};
			new AlertDialog.Builder(this)
					.setTitle("Date: " + dateStr)
					.setItems(options, (dialog, which) -> {
						if (which == 0) {
							// Add mood for this date
							showMoodDialog(-1);
						} else {
							// Filter to show moods for this date
							filterDayCheck.setChecked(true);
							refreshListForFilter();
						}
					})
					.setNegativeButton("Cancel", (dialog, which) -> refreshListForFilter())
					.show();
		});
		calendarView.setAdapter(calendarAdapter);

		filterDayCheck = findViewById(R.id.checkbox_filter_day);
		if (filterDayCheck != null) {
			filterDayCheck.setOnCheckedChangeListener((buttonView, isChecked) -> refreshListForFilter());
		}

		// Calendar navigation
		findViewById(R.id.button_prev_month).setOnClickListener(v -> {
			currentMonth.add(java.util.Calendar.MONTH, -1);
			bindMonth();
			refreshListForFilter();
		});
		findViewById(R.id.button_next_month).setOnClickListener(v -> {
			currentMonth.add(java.util.Calendar.MONTH, 1);
			bindMonth();
			refreshListForFilter();
		});

		bindMonth();

		// FAB for adding moods
		FloatingActionButton fab = findViewById(R.id.fab_log_mood);
		fab.setOnClickListener(v -> showMoodDialog(-1));

		BaseNavigation.wireTopNav(this, findViewById(R.id.top_nav_include));
		BaseNavigation.wireBottomNav(this, findViewById(R.id.bottom_nav_include));
	}

	private void showMoodDialog(final int editPosition) {
		View dialogView = LayoutInflater.from(this).inflate(R.layout.dialog_mood_entry, null, false);
		final EditText inputEmoji = dialogView.findViewById(R.id.input_emoji);
		final EditText inputNote = dialogView.findViewById(R.id.input_note);

		if (editPosition >= 0) {
			MoodEntry e = entries.get(editPosition);
			inputEmoji.setText(e.emoji);
			inputNote.setText(e.note);
		}

		new AlertDialog.Builder(this)
				.setTitle(editPosition >= 0 ? "Edit Mood" : "Log Mood")
				.setView(dialogView)
				.setPositiveButton(editPosition >= 0 ? "Save" : "Log", (d, w) -> {
					String emoji = inputEmoji.getText().toString().trim();
					String note = inputNote.getText().toString().trim();
					if (emoji.isEmpty()) emoji = "";

					if (editPosition >= 0) {
						MoodEntry e = entries.get(editPosition);
						e.emoji = emoji;
						e.note = note;
					} else {
						Date now = selectedDate != null ? selectedDate : new Date();
						entries.add(0, new MoodEntry(now, emoji, note));
					}

					refreshListForFilter();
					calendarAdapter.updateEmojis(mapDateToEmoji());
				})
				.setNegativeButton("Cancel", null)
				.show();
	}

	private void bindMonth() {
		TextView monthTitle = findViewById(R.id.text_month);
		SimpleDateFormat sdf = new SimpleDateFormat("MMMM yyyy");
		monthTitle.setText(sdf.format(currentMonth.getTime()));

		java.util.Calendar cal = (java.util.Calendar) currentMonth.clone();
		cal.set(java.util.Calendar.DAY_OF_MONTH, 1);
		int daysInMonth = cal.getActualMaximum(java.util.Calendar.DAY_OF_MONTH);

		List<DayCell> cells = new ArrayList<>();
		for (int day = 1; day <= 31; day++) {
			if (day <= daysInMonth) {
				cal.set(java.util.Calendar.DAY_OF_MONTH, day);
				cells.add(DayCell.of(cal.getTime()));
			} else {
				cells.add(DayCell.invalid(day));
			}
		}

		calendarAdapter.submit(cells, mapDateToEmoji());
	}

	private Map<String, String> mapDateToEmoji() {
		SimpleDateFormat keyFmt = new SimpleDateFormat("yyyy-MM-dd");
		Map<String, String> map = new HashMap<>();
		for (MoodEntry e : entries) {
			map.put(keyFmt.format(e.timestamp), e.emoji);
		}
		return map;
	}

	// ✅ FIX: refreshListForFilter now lives in the Activity
	private void refreshListForFilter() {
		if (filterDayCheck != null && filterDayCheck.isChecked()) {
			SimpleDateFormat keyFmt = new SimpleDateFormat("yyyy-MM-dd");
			String selKey = keyFmt.format(selectedDate != null ? selectedDate : new Date());
			List<MoodEntry> filtered = new ArrayList<>();
			for (MoodEntry e : entries) {
				if (keyFmt.format(e.timestamp).equals(selKey)) {
					filtered.add(e);
				}
			}
			adapter.setItems(filtered);
		} else {
			adapter.setItems(new ArrayList<>(entries));
		}
	}

	// ────────── Data classes ──────────

	private static class MoodEntry {
		Date timestamp;
		String emoji;
		String note;

		MoodEntry(Date timestamp, String emoji, String note) {
			this.timestamp = timestamp;
			this.emoji = emoji;
			this.note = note;
		}
	}

	private static class DayCell {
		boolean isInvalid;
		Date date;
		int dayNumber;

		static DayCell of(Date date) {
			DayCell d = new DayCell();
			d.isInvalid = false;
			d.date = date;
			java.util.Calendar c = java.util.Calendar.getInstance();
			c.setTime(date);
			d.dayNumber = c.get(java.util.Calendar.DAY_OF_MONTH);
			return d;
		}

		static DayCell invalid(int dayNumber) {
			DayCell d = new DayCell();
			d.isInvalid = true;
			d.dayNumber = dayNumber;
			return d;
		}
	}

	private interface DayClickListener {
		void onDayClick(DayCell dayCell);
	}

	private static class CalendarAdapter extends RecyclerView.Adapter<CalendarAdapter.DayViewHolder> {
		private final List<DayCell> cells;
		private final DayClickListener listener;
		private Map<String, String> dateToEmoji = new HashMap<>();

		CalendarAdapter(List<DayCell> cells, DayClickListener listener) {
			this.cells = cells;
			this.listener = listener;
		}

		void submit(List<DayCell> newCells, Map<String, String> dateToEmoji) {
			this.cells.clear();
			this.cells.addAll(newCells);
			this.dateToEmoji = dateToEmoji;
			notifyDataSetChanged();
		}

		void updateEmojis(Map<String, String> dateToEmoji) {
			this.dateToEmoji = dateToEmoji;
			notifyDataSetChanged();
		}

		@NonNull
		@Override
		public DayViewHolder onCreateViewHolder(@NonNull ViewGroup parent, int viewType) {
			View v = LayoutInflater.from(parent.getContext())
					.inflate(R.layout.item_calendar_day, parent, false);
			return new DayViewHolder(v);
		}

		@Override
		public void onBindViewHolder(@NonNull DayViewHolder holder, int position) {
			DayCell cell = cells.get(position);
			holder.day.setText(String.valueOf(cell.dayNumber));
			if (cell.isInvalid) {
				holder.emoji.setText("");
				holder.day.setAlpha(0.4f);
				holder.itemView.setOnClickListener(null);
 } else {
				holder.day.setAlpha(1f);
				SimpleDateFormat keyFmt = new SimpleDateFormat("yyyy-MM-dd");
				String key = keyFmt.format(cell.date);
				holder.emoji.setText(dateToEmoji.getOrDefault(key, ""));
				holder.itemView.setOnClickListener(v -> listener.onDayClick(cell));
 }

			// Selected state highlight
			try {
				java.text.SimpleDateFormat keyFmt = new java.text.SimpleDateFormat("yyyy-MM-dd");
				String sel = keyFmt.format(((MoodJournalActivity) holder.itemView.getContext()).selectedDate);
				String cur = cell.date != null ? keyFmt.format(cell.date) : "";
				if (!cell.isInvalid && sel.equals(cur)) {
					holder.day.setBackgroundResource(R.drawable.bg_day_selected);
				} else {
					holder.day.setBackgroundResource(0);
				}
			} catch (Exception ignored) {
			}
		}

		@Override
		public int getItemCount() {
			return cells.size();
		}

		static class DayViewHolder extends RecyclerView.ViewHolder {
			TextView day;
			TextView emoji;

			DayViewHolder(@NonNull View itemView) {
				super(itemView);
				day = itemView.findViewById(R.id.text_day);
				emoji = itemView.findViewById(R.id.text_day_emoji);
			}
		}
	}

	private interface MoodListener {
		void onEdit(int position);

		void onDelete(int position);
	}

	private static class MoodAdapter extends RecyclerView.Adapter<MoodAdapter.MoodViewHolder> {
		private List<MoodEntry> entries;
		private final MoodListener listener;

		MoodAdapter(List<MoodEntry> entries, MoodListener listener) {
			this.entries = entries;
			this.listener = listener;
		}

		void setItems(List<MoodEntry> newItems) {
			this.entries = newItems;
			notifyDataSetChanged();
		}

		@NonNull
		@Override
		public MoodViewHolder onCreateViewHolder(@NonNull ViewGroup parent, int viewType) {
			View view = LayoutInflater.from(parent.getContext())
					.inflate(R.layout.item_mood_entry, parent, false);
			return new MoodViewHolder(view);
		}

		@Override
		public void onBindViewHolder(@NonNull MoodViewHolder holder, int position) {
			MoodEntry e = entries.get(position);
			DateFormat df = android.text.format.DateFormat.getMediumDateFormat(holder.itemView.getContext());
			DateFormat tf = android.text.format.DateFormat.getTimeFormat(holder.itemView.getContext());

			holder.textEmoji.setText(e.emoji);
			holder.textNote.setText(e.note == null || e.note.isEmpty() ? "" : e.note);
			holder.textDate.setText(df.format(e.timestamp) + " " + tf.format(e.timestamp));
			holder.buttonEdit.setOnClickListener(v -> listener.onEdit(holder.getAdapterPosition()));
			holder.buttonDelete.setOnClickListener(v -> listener.onDelete(holder.getAdapterPosition()));
		}

		@Override
		public int getItemCount() {
			return entries.size();
		}

		static class MoodViewHolder extends RecyclerView.ViewHolder {
			TextView textEmoji;
			TextView textNote;
			TextView textDate;
			View buttonEdit;
			View buttonDelete;

			MoodViewHolder(@NonNull View itemView) {
				super(itemView);
				textEmoji = itemView.findViewById(R.id.text_emoji);
				textNote = itemView.findViewById(R.id.text_note);
				textDate = itemView.findViewById(R.id.text_date);
				buttonEdit = itemView.findViewById(R.id.button_edit);
				buttonDelete = itemView.findViewById(R.id.button_delete);
			}
		}
	}
}

import android.os.Bundle;
import android.view.View;
import android.widget.ArrayAdapter;
import android.widget.ProgressBar;
import android.widget.Spinner;
import android.widget.Switch;
import android.widget.TextView;

import androidx.activity.EdgeToEdge;
import androidx.appcompat.app.AppCompatActivity;
import androidx.core.graphics.Insets;
import androidx.core.view.ViewCompat;
import androidx.core.view.WindowInsetsCompat;

import com.google.android.material.floatingactionbutton.FloatingActionButton;

public class HydrationActivity extends AppCompatActivity {

	private Spinner intervalSpinner;
	private Switch notificationsSwitch;
	private ProgressBar progressBar;
	private TextView progressText;
	private int targetGlasses = 8;
	private int currentGlasses = 0;

	@Override
	protected void onCreate(Bundle savedInstanceState) {
		super.onCreate(savedInstanceState);
		EdgeToEdge.enable(this);
		setContentView(R.layout.activity_hydration);
		ViewCompat.setOnApplyWindowInsetsListener(findViewById(R.id.hydration_root), (v, insets) -> {
			Insets systemBars = insets.getInsets(WindowInsetsCompat.Type.systemBars());
			v.setPadding(systemBars.left, systemBars.top, systemBars.right, systemBars.bottom);
			return insets;
		});

		intervalSpinner = findViewById(R.id.spinner_interval);
		notificationsSwitch = findViewById(R.id.switch_notifications);
		progressBar = findViewById(R.id.progress_hydration);
		progressText = findViewById(R.id.text_progress);

		ArrayAdapter<CharSequence> adapter = ArrayAdapter.createFromResource(this,
				R.array.hydration_intervals,
				android.R.layout.simple_spinner_item);
		adapter.setDropDownViewResource(android.R.layout.simple_spinner_dropdown_item);
		intervalSpinner.setAdapter(adapter);

		FloatingActionButton fab = findViewById(R.id.fab_add_glass);
		fab.setOnClickListener(new View.OnClickListener() {
			@Override
			public void onClick(View v) {
				currentGlasses = Math.min(targetGlasses, currentGlasses + 1);
				updateProgress();
			}
		});

		updateProgress();

		BaseNavigation.wireTopNav(this, findViewById(R.id.top_nav_include));
		BaseNavigation.wireBottomNav(this, findViewById(R.id.bottom_nav_include));
	}

	private void updateProgress() {
		int percent = (int) (100f * currentGlasses / targetGlasses);
		progressBar.setMax(100);
		progressBar.setProgress(percent);
		progressText.setText(currentGlasses + "/" + targetGlasses + " glasses today");
	}
}

+
+ int percentage = Math.min(100, (int) ((totalMl * 100f) / dailyGoalMl));
+
+ intakeAmountText.setText(totalMl + " ml / " + dailyGoalMl + " ml");
+ percentageText.setText(percentage + "%");
+ progressBar.setProgress(percentage);
+ }

+ }
+ }

+ boolean isInvalid;
+ boolean isEmpty;
+ Date date;

+

+ d.isEmpty = false;

+ c.setTime(date);

+ this.cells.addAll(newCells);

+ void updateIntakes(Map<String, String> dateToIntake) {

+ return new DayViewHolder(v);
+ }
+
+ @Override
+ public void onBindViewHolder(@NonNull DayViewHolder holder, int position) {
+ DayCell cell = cells.get(position);
+
+ if (cell.isEmpty) {
+ holder.day.setText("");
+ holder.emoji.setText("");
+ holder.day.setAlpha(0.3f);
+ holder.itemView.setOnClickListener(null);
+ } else {
+ holder.day.setText(String.valueOf(cell.dayNumber));
+ holder.day.setAlpha(1f);
+
+ if (!cell.isInvalid && cell.date != null) {
+ SimpleDateFormat keyFmt = new SimpleDateFormat("yyyy-MM-dd");
+ String key = keyFmt.format(cell.date);
+ holder.emoji.setText(dateToIntake.getOrDefault(key, ""));
+ holder.itemView.setOnClickListener(v -> listener.onDayClick(cell));
+

+ } catch (Exception e) {

+ private void loadTodaysMood() {
+ SharedPreferences prefs = getSharedPreferences("mood_data", MODE_PRIVATE);
+ SimpleDateFormat dateFormat = new SimpleDateFormat("yyyy-MM-dd");
+ String todayKey = dateFormat.format(new Date());
+
+ String todayMood = prefs.getString(todayKey + "_emoji", "");
+ String todayMoodName = prefs.getString(todayKey + "_name", "");
+
+ if (todayMood.isEmpty()) {
+ // Show default mood if none logged today
+ moodEmojiText.setText("");
+ moodNameText.setText("Not set");
+ } else {
+ moodEmojiText.setText(todayMood);
+ moodNameText.setText(todayMoodName);
+ }
+ }
+
+ private void loadTodaysHydration() {
+ SharedPreferences prefs = getSharedPreferences("hydration_data", MODE_PRIVATE);
+ SimpleDateFormat dateFormat = new SimpleDateFormat("yyyy-MM-dd");
+ String todayKey = dateFormat.format(new Date());
+
+ int todayIntake = prefs.getInt(todayKey + "_intake", 0);
+ int dailyGoal = prefs.getInt("daily_goal", 2000);
+
+ int percentage = Math.min(100, (int) ((todayIntake * 100f) / dailyGoal));
+
+ hydrationPercentageText.setText(percentage + "%");
+ hydrationAmountText.setText(todayIntake + " ml / " + dailyGoal + " ml");
+ hydrationProgressBar.setProgress(percentage);
+
+ // Store sample data if none exists
+ if (todayIntake == 0) {
+ // Show sample data for demonstration
+ int sampleIntake = 1300 + new Random().nextInt(700); // 1300-2000ml
+ int samplePercentage = Math.min(100, (int) ((sampleIntake * 100f) / dailyGoal));
+
+ hydrationPercentageText.setText(samplePercentage + "%");
+ hydrationAmountText.setText(sampleIntake + " ml / " + dailyGoal + " ml");
+ hydrationProgressBar.setProgress(samplePercentage);
+ }
+ }
+
+ private void loadTodaysHabits() {
+ SharedPreferences prefs = getSharedPreferences("habits_data", MODE_PRIVATE);
+ SimpleDateFormat dateFormat = new SimpleDateFormat("yyyy-MM-dd");
+ String todayKey = dateFormat.format(new Date());
+
+ int completedHabits = prefs.getInt(todayKey + "_completed", 0);
+ int totalHabits = prefs.getInt(todayKey + "_total", 0);
+
+ if (totalHabits == 0) {
+ // Show sample data for demonstration
+ totalHabits = 3 + new Random().nextInt(3); // 3-5 habits
+ completedHabits = new Random().nextInt(totalHabits + 1); // 0 to total
+ }
+
+ int percentage = totalHabits == 0 ? 0 : (int) ((completedHabits * 100f) / totalHabits);
+
+ habitsPercentageText.setText(percentage + "%");
+ habitsCountText.setText(completedHabits + " / " + totalHabits + " completed");
+ habitsProgressBar.setProgress(percentage);
+ }
+
+ private void updateGreeting() {
+ TextView greetingText = findViewById(R.id.text_greeting);
+ java.util.Calendar cal = java.util.Calendar.getInstance();
+ int hour = cal.get(java.util.Calendar.HOUR_OF_DAY);
+
+ String greeting;
+ if (hour < 12) {
+ greeting = "Good morning! ";
+ } else if (hour < 17) {
+ greeting = "Good afternoon! ☀️";
+ } else {
+ greeting = "Good evening! ";
+ }
+
+ greetingText.setText(greeting);
+ }
 }
