+	private void bindMonth() {
+		TextView monthTitle = findViewById(R.id.text_month);
+		SimpleDateFormat sdf = new SimpleDateFormat("MMMM yyyy");
+		monthTitle.setText(sdf.format(currentMonth.getTime()));
+
+		java.util.Calendar cal = (java.util.Calendar) currentMonth.clone();
+		cal.set(java.util.Calendar.DAY_OF_MONTH, 1);
+
+		// Get the day of week for the first day (Sunday = 1, Monday = 2, etc.)
+		int firstDayOfWeek = cal.get(java.util.Calendar.DAY_OF_WEEK);
+		int daysInMonth = cal.getActualMaximum(java.util.Calendar.DAY_OF_MONTH);
+
+		List<DayCell> cells = new ArrayList<>();
+
+		// Add empty cells for days before the first day of the month
+		for (int i = 1; i < firstDayOfWeek; i++) {
+			cells.add(DayCell.empty());
+		}
+
+		// Add all days of the month
+		for (int day = 1; day <= daysInMonth; day++) {
+			cal.set(java.util.Calendar.DAY_OF_MONTH, day);
+			cells.add(DayCell.of(cal.getTime()));
+		}
+
+		// Add empty cells to fill the grid (6 rows × 7 columns = 42 cells total)
+		while (cells.size() < 42) {
+			cells.add(DayCell.empty());
+		}
+
+		// Debug: Log the number of cells created
+		android.util.Log.d("HabitsActivity", "Created " + cells.size() + " calendar cells for " + daysInMonth + " days");
+
+		calendarAdapter.submit(cells, mapDateToHabitCount());
+	}
+
+	private Map<String, String> mapDateToHabitCount() {
+		SimpleDateFormat keyFmt = new SimpleDateFormat("yyyy-MM-dd");
+		Map<String, String> map = new HashMap<>();
+
+		// Group habits by date and count completed ones
+		Map<String, Integer> totalHabits = new HashMap<>();
+		Map<String, Integer> completedHabits = new HashMap<>();
+
+		for (Habit habit : habits) {
+			String dateKey = keyFmt.format(habit.date);
+			totalHabits.put(dateKey, totalHabits.getOrDefault(dateKey, 0) + 1);
+			if (habit.completed) {
+				completedHabits.put(dateKey, completedHabits.getOrDefault(dateKey, 0) + 1);
+			}
+		}
+
+		// Create display text showing completion ratio
+		for (String dateKey : totalHabits.keySet()) {
+			int total = totalHabits.get(dateKey);
+			int completed = completedHabits.getOrDefault(dateKey, 0);
+			if (total > 0) {
+				map.put(dateKey, completed + "/" + total);
+			}
+		}
+
+		return map;
+	}
+

+		android.util.Log.d("HabitsActivity", "refreshListForFilter called, total habits: " + habits.size());
+
+		if (filterDayCheck != null && filterDayCheck.isChecked()) {
+			SimpleDateFormat keyFmt = new SimpleDateFormat("yyyy-MM-dd");
+			String selKey = keyFmt.format(selectedDate != null ? selectedDate : new Date());
+			android.util.Log.d("HabitsActivity", "Filtering for selected day: " + selKey);
+
+			List<Habit> filtered = new ArrayList<>();
+			for (Habit habit : habits) {
+				String habitDateKey = keyFmt.format(habit.date);
+				android.util.Log.d("HabitsActivity", "Habit '" + habit.name + "' date: " + habitDateKey);
+				if (habitDateKey.equals(selKey)) {
+					filtered.add(habit);
+				}
+			}
+			android.util.Log.d("HabitsActivity", "Filtered habits count: " + filtered.size());
+			adapter.setItems(filtered);
+		} else {
+			android.util.Log.d("HabitsActivity", "Showing all habits: " + habits.size());
+			adapter.setItems(new ArrayList<>(habits));
+		}
+		updateProgress();
+	}

+	private static class EmojiSelectionAdapter extends RecyclerView.Adapter<EmojiSelectionAdapter.EmojiViewHolder> {

+		private final EmojiSelectionListener listener;
+		private int selectedPosition = 0;
+
+		EmojiSelectionAdapter(List<MoodEmoji> emojis, EmojiSelectionListener listener) {
+			this.emojis = emojis;
+			this.listener = listener;
+		}
+
+		@NonNull
+		@Override
+		public EmojiViewHolder onCreateViewHolder(@NonNull ViewGroup parent, int viewType) {
+			View view = LayoutInflater.from(parent.getContext()).inflate(R.layout.item_mood_emoji, parent, false);
+			return new EmojiViewHolder(view);
+		}
+
+		@Override
+		public void onBindViewHolder(@NonNull EmojiViewHolder holder, int position) {
+			MoodEmoji emoji = emojis.get(position);
+			holder.emojiText.setText(emoji.emoji);
+			holder.emojiName.setText(emoji.name);
+
+			// Highlight selected item
+			if (position == selectedPosition) {
+				holder.itemView.setBackgroundColor(0xFFE3F2FD); // Light blue
+			} else {
+				holder.itemView.setBackgroundColor(0xFFFFFFFF); // White
+			}
+
+			holder.itemView.setOnClickListener(v -> {
+				int oldPosition = selectedPosition;
+				selectedPosition = holder.getAdapterPosition();
+				notifyItemChanged(oldPosition);
+				notifyItemChanged(selectedPosition);
+				listener.onEmojiSelected(selectedPosition);
+			});
+		}
+
+		@Override
+		public int getItemCount() {
+			return emojis.size();
+		}
+
+		void setSelectedPosition(int position) {
+			selectedPosition = position;
+			notifyDataSetChanged();
+		}
+

+ private void bindMonth() {

+ monthTitle.setText(sdf.format(currentMonth.getTime()));
+
+ java.util.Calendar cal = (java.util.Calendar) currentMonth.clone();
+ cal.set(java.util.Calendar.DAY_OF_MONTH, 1);
+
+ int firstDayOfWeek = cal.get(java.util.Calendar.DAY_OF_WEEK);
+ int daysInMonth = cal.getActualMaximum(java.util.Calendar.DAY_OF_MONTH);
+
+ List<DayCell> cells = new ArrayList<>();
+
+ // Add empty cells for proper alignment
+ for (int i = 1; i < firstDayOfWeek; i++) {
+ cells.add(DayCell.empty());
+ }
+
+ // Add all days of the month
+ for (int day = 1; day <= daysInMonth; day++) {
+ cal.set(java.util.Calendar.DAY_OF_MONTH, day);
+ cells.add(DayCell.of(cal.getTime()));
+ }
+
+ // Fill to 42 cells (6 rows × 7 columns)
+ while (cells.size() < 42) {
+ cells.add(DayCell.empty());
+ }
+
+ calendarAdapter.submit(cells, mapDateToIntake());

+ for (WaterIntake intake : intakes) {
+ totalMl += intake.volumeMl;
+ }
+ int percentage = (int) ((totalMl * 100f) / dailyGoalMl);
+ map.put(dateKey, percentage + "%");
+ }
+ }
+
+ return map;
+ }

+
+ if (dailyIntakes.containsKey(todayKey)) {
+ todayIntakes = dailyIntakes.get(todayKey);
+ } else {
+ todayIntakes = new ArrayList<>();
+ dailyIntakes.put(todayKey, todayIntakes);
+ }
+
+ historyAdapter.updateItems(todayIntakes);
+ }
+
+ private void loadSelectedDateData() {
+ SimpleDateFormat keyFmt = new SimpleDateFormat("yyyy-MM-dd");
+ String selectedKey = keyFmt.format(selectedDate);
+
+ List<WaterIntake> selectedIntakes = dailyIntakes.getOrDefault(selectedKey, new ArrayList<>());
+ historyAdapter.updateItems(selectedIntakes);
+
+ // Update progress for selected date
+ int totalMl = 0;
+ for (WaterIntake intake : selectedIntakes) {
+ totalMl += intake.volumeMl;
+ }
+
+ int percentage = (int) ((totalMl * 100f) / dailyGoalMl);
+ intakeAmountText.setText(totalMl + " ml / " + dailyGoalMl + " ml");
+ percentageText.setText(percentage + "%");
+ progressBar.setProgress(percentage);

+ private void saveTodayData() {

+ String todayKey = keyFmt.format(new Date());
+ dailyIntakes.put(todayKey, new ArrayList<>(todayIntakes));
+ }
+
+ private void updateProgress() {
+ int totalMl = 0;
+ for (WaterIntake intake : todayIntakes) {
+ totalMl += intake.volumeMl;
+ }
+
+ int percentage = Math.min(100, (int) ((totalMl * 100f) / dailyGoalMl));
+
+ intakeAmountText.setText(totalMl + " ml / " + dailyGoalMl + " ml");
+ percentageText.setText(percentage + "%");
+ progressBar.setProgress(percentage);
+ }

+ private void loadTodaysMood() {
+ SharedPreferences prefs = getSharedPreferences("mood_data", MODE_PRIVATE);
+ SimpleDateFormat dateFormat = new SimpleDateFormat("yyyy-MM-dd");
+ String todayKey = dateFormat.format(new Date());
+
+ String todayMood = prefs.getString(todayKey + "_emoji", "");
+ String todayMoodName = prefs.getString(todayKey + "_name", "");
+
+ if (todayMood.isEmpty()) {
+ // Show default mood if none logged today
+ moodEmojiText.setText("");
+ moodNameText.setText("Not set");
+ } else {
+ moodEmojiText.setText(todayMood);
+ moodNameText.setText(todayMoodName);
+ }
+ }
+
+ private void loadTodaysHydration() {
+ SharedPreferences prefs = getSharedPreferences("hydration_data", MODE_PRIVATE);
+ SimpleDateFormat dateFormat = new SimpleDateFormat("yyyy-MM-dd");
+ String todayKey = dateFormat.format(new Date());
+
+ int todayIntake = prefs.getInt(todayKey + "_intake", 0);
+ int dailyGoal = prefs.getInt("daily_goal", 2000);
+
+ int percentage = Math.min(100, (int) ((todayIntake * 100f) / dailyGoal));
+
+ hydrationPercentageText.setText(percentage + "%");
+ hydrationAmountText.setText(todayIntake + " ml / " + dailyGoal + " ml");
+ hydrationProgressBar.setProgress(percentage);
+
+ // Store sample data if none exists
+ if (todayIntake == 0) {
+ // Show sample data for demonstration
+ int sampleIntake = 1300 + new Random().nextInt(700); // 1300-2000ml
+ int samplePercentage = Math.min(100, (int) ((sampleIntake * 100f) / dailyGoal));
+
+ hydrationPercentageText.setText(samplePercentage + "%");
+ hydrationAmountText.setText(sampleIntake + " ml / " + dailyGoal + " ml");
+ hydrationProgressBar.setProgress(samplePercentage);
+ }
+ }
+
+ private void loadTodaysHabits() {
+ SharedPreferences prefs = getSharedPreferences("habits_data", MODE_PRIVATE);
+ SimpleDateFormat dateFormat = new SimpleDateFormat("yyyy-MM-dd");
+ String todayKey = dateFormat.format(new Date());
+
+ int completedHabits = prefs.getInt(todayKey + "_completed", 0);
+ int totalHabits = prefs.getInt(todayKey + "_total", 0);
+
+ if (totalHabits == 0) {
+ // Show sample data for demonstration
+ totalHabits = 3 + new Random().nextInt(3); // 3-5 habits
+ completedHabits = new Random().nextInt(totalHabits + 1); // 0 to total
+ }
+
+ int percentage = totalHabits == 0 ? 0 : (int) ((completedHabits * 100f) / totalHabits);
+
+ habitsPercentageText.setText(percentage + "%");
+ habitsCountText.setText(completedHabits + " / " + totalHabits + " completed");
+ habitsProgressBar.setProgress(percentage);
+ }
+
+ private void updateGreeting() {
+ TextView greetingText = findViewById(R.id.text_greeting);
+ java.util.Calendar cal = java.util.Calendar.getInstance();
+ int hour = cal.get(java.util.Calendar.HOUR_OF_DAY);
+
+ String greeting;
+ if (hour < 12) {
+ greeting = "Good morning! ";
+ } else if (hour < 17) {
+ greeting = "Good afternoon! ☀️";
+ } else {
+ greeting = "Good evening! ";
+ }
+
+ greetingText.setText(greeting);
+ }
 }

 private void loadTodaysMood() {
 SharedPreferences prefs = getSharedPreferences("mood_data", MODE_PRIVATE);
 SimpleDateFormat dateFormat = new SimpleDateFormat("yyyy-MM-dd");
 String todayKey = dateFormat.format(new Date());

 String todayMood = prefs.getString(todayKey + "_emoji", "");
 String todayMoodName = prefs.getString(todayKey + "_name", "");

 if (todayMood.isEmpty()) {
 // Show default mood if none logged today
 moodEmojiText.setText("");
 moodNameText.setText("Not set");
 } else {
 moodEmojiText.setText(todayMood);
 moodNameText.setText(todayMoodName);
 }
 }

 private void loadTodaysHydration() {
 SharedPreferences prefs = getSharedPreferences("hydration_data", MODE_PRIVATE);
 SimpleDateFormat dateFormat = new SimpleDateFormat("yyyy-MM-dd");
 String todayKey = dateFormat.format(new Date());

 int todayIntake = prefs.getInt(todayKey + "_intake", 0);
 int dailyGoal = prefs.getInt("daily_goal", 2000);

 int percentage = Math.min(100, (int) ((todayIntake * 100f) / dailyGoal));

 hydrationPercentageText.setText(percentage + "%");
 hydrationAmountText.setText(todayIntake + " ml / " + dailyGoal + " ml");
 hydrationProgressBar.setProgress(percentage);

 // Store sample data if none exists
 if (todayIntake == 0) {
 // Show sample data for demonstration
 int sampleIntake = 1300 + new Random().nextInt(700); // 1300-2000ml
 int samplePercentage = Math.min(100, (int) ((sampleIntake * 100f) / dailyGoal));

 hydrationPercentageText.setText(samplePercentage + "%");
 hydrationAmountText.setText(sampleIntake + " ml / " + dailyGoal + " ml");
 hydrationProgressBar.setProgress(samplePercentage);
 }
 }

 private void loadTodaysHabits() {
 SharedPreferences prefs = getSharedPreferences("habits_data", MODE_PRIVATE);
 SimpleDateFormat dateFormat = new SimpleDateFormat("yyyy-MM-dd");
 String todayKey = dateFormat.format(new Date());

 int completedHabits = prefs.getInt(todayKey + "_completed", 0);
 int totalHabits = prefs.getInt(todayKey + "_total", 0);

 if (totalHabits == 0) {
 // Show sample data for demonstration
 totalHabits = 3 + new Random().nextInt(3); // 3-5 habits
 completedHabits = new Random().nextInt(totalHabits + 1); // 0 to total
 }

 int percentage = totalHabits == 0 ? 0 : (int) ((completedHabits * 100f) / totalHabits);

 habitsPercentageText.setText(percentage + "%");
 habitsCountText.setText(completedHabits + " / " + totalHabits + " completed");
 habitsProgressBar.setProgress(percentage);
 }

 private void updateGreeting() {
 TextView greetingText = findViewById(R.id.text_greeting);
 java.util.Calendar cal = java.util.Calendar.getInstance();
 int hour = cal.get(java.util.Calendar.HOUR_OF_DAY);

 String greeting;
 if (hour < 12) {
 greeting = "Good morning! ";
 } else if (hour < 17) {
 greeting = "Good afternoon! ☀️";
 } else {
 greeting = "Good evening! ";
 }

 greetingText.setText(greeting);
 }

			android:focusable="true"

					android:textSize="12sp"

				android:layout_height="wrap_content"
				android:layout_marginStart="24dp"
				android:layout_marginTop="12dp"
				android:layout_marginEnd="24dp"
				android:background="@drawable/bg_card"
				android:orientation="vertical">

				<TextView
					android:layout_width="match_parent"
					android:layout_height="wrap_content"
					android:text="@string/daily_progress"
					android:textColor="@color/dark_text"
					android:textStyle="bold" />

				<ProgressBar
					android:id="@+id/progress_habits"
					style="@android:style/Widget.ProgressBar.Horizontal"
					android:layout_width="match_parent"
					android:layout_height="wrap_content"
					android:max="100"

	<com.google.android.material.floatingactionbutton.FloatingActionButton

		app:layout_constraintBottom_toTopOf="@id/bottom_nav"
		app:layout_constraintEnd_toEndOf="parent" />

</androidx.constraintlayout.widget.ConstraintLayout>

			android:layout_weight="1"

			android:background="?android:attr/selectableItemBackground">

			<ImageView
				android:layout_width="20dp"

				android:src="@drawable/ic_nav_water"
				android:scaleType="centerInside" />

			<TextView
				android:layout_width="wrap_content"
				android:layout_height="wrap_content"
				android:text="Water"
				android:textSize="10sp"
				android:textColor="#666666"
				android:layout_marginTop="2dp" />
		</LinearLayout>

		<LinearLayout
			android:id="@+id/nav_settings"
			android:layout_width="0dp"
			android:layout_height="match_parent"
			android:layout_weight="1"
			android:clickable="true"
			android:focusable="true"
			android:gravity="center"
			android:orientation="vertical"
			android:background="?android:attr/selectableItemBackground">

			<ImageView
				android:layout_width="20dp"
				android:layout_height="20dp"
				android:src="@drawable/ic_nav_settings"
				android:scaleType="centerInside" />

			<TextView
				android:layout_width="wrap_content"

				android:text="Settings"
				android:textSize="10sp"
				android:textColor="#666666"
				android:layout_marginTop="2dp" />
		</LinearLayout>

	</LinearLayout>

</androidx.constraintlayout.widget.ConstraintLayout>

Now let me check the Hydration activity:"}],"tool_calls":[{"id":"toolu_bdrk_01JgfcejfoheCkzLbPKfcyqJ","type":"function","function":{"name":"read_file","arguments":"{"target_file": "app/src/main/res/layout/activity_hydration.xml"}"}}]},{"role":"tool","name":"read_file","tool_call_id":"toolu_bdrk_01JgfcejfoheCkzLbPKfcyqJ","content":"<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<androidx.constraintlayout.widget.ConstraintLayout xmlns:android="http://schemas.android.com/apk/res/android"
	xmlns:app="http://schemas.android.com/apk/res-auto"
	xmlns:tools="http://schemas.android.com/tools"
	android:id="@+id/hydration_root"
	android:layout_width="match_parent"
	android:layout_height="match_parent"
	android:background="@color/off_white_bg"
	tools:context=".HydrationActivity">

	<include
		android:id="@+id/top_nav_include"
		layout="@layout/include_top_nav"
		app:layout_constraintTop_toTopOf="parent"
		app:layout_constraintStart_toStartOf="parent"
		app:layout_constraintEnd_toEndOf="parent" />

	<ScrollView
		android:id="@+id/scroll_view"
		android:layout_width="0dp"
		android:layout_height="0dp"
		android:fillViewport="true"
		app:layout_constraintTop_toBottomOf="@id/top_nav_include"
		app:layout_constraintBottom_toTopOf="@id/bottom_nav"
		app:layout_constraintStart_toStartOf="parent"
		app:layout_constraintEnd_toEndOf="parent">

		<LinearLayout
			android:layout_width="match_parent"
			android:layout_height="wrap_content"
			android:orientation="vertical">

			<TextView
				android:id="@+id/text_title"
				android:layout_width="match_parent"
				android:layout_height="wrap_content"
				android:layout_marginStart="24dp"
				android:layout_marginTop="24dp"
				android:layout_marginEnd="24dp"
				android:text="Hydration"
				android:textColor="@color/dark_text"
				android:textSize="22sp"
				android:textStyle="bold" />

			<!-- Daily Goal Card -->
			<LinearLayout
				android:id="@+id/card_daily_goal"
				android:layout_width="match_parent"
				android:layout_height="wrap_content"
				android:layout_marginStart="24dp"
				android:layout_marginTop="16dp"
				android:layout_marginEnd="24dp"
				android:background="@drawable/bg_card"
				android:orientation="vertical"
				android:padding="16dp">

				<TextView
					android:layout_width="match_parent"
					android:layout_height="wrap_content"
					android:text="Today's Progress"
					android:textColor="@color/dark_text"
					android:textSize="18sp"
					android:textStyle="bold"
					android:layout_marginBottom="12dp" />

				<LinearLayout
					android:layout_width="match_parent"
					android:layout_height="wrap_content"
					android:orientation="horizontal"
					android:gravity="center_vertical"
					android:layout_marginBottom="8dp">

					<ImageView
						android:layout_width="32dp"
						android:layout_height="32dp"
						android:src="@drawable/ic_water"
						android:layout_marginEnd="12dp" />

					<TextView
						android:id="@+id/text_intake_amount"
						android:layout_width="0dp"
						android:layout_height="wrap_content"
						android:layout_weight="1"
						android:text="0 ml / 2000 ml"
						android:textColor="@color/dark_text"
						android:textSize="16sp"
						android:textStyle="bold" />

					<TextView
						android:id="@+id/text_percentage"
						android:layout_width="wrap_content"
						android:layout_height="wrap_content"
						android:text="0%"
						android:textColor="@color/sky_blue_accent"
						android:textSize="14sp"
						android:textStyle="bold" />

				</LinearLayout>

				<ProgressBar
					android:id="@+id/progress_hydration"
					style="@android:style/Widget.ProgressBar.Horizontal"
					android:layout_width="match_parent"
					android:layout_height="12dp"
					android:max="100"
					android:progress="0"
					android:progressTint="@color/sky_blue_accent" />

			</LinearLayout>

			<!-- Volume Selection Card -->
			<LinearLayout
				android:id="@+id/card_volume_selection"
				android:layout_width="match_parent"
				android:layout_height="wrap_content"
				android:layout_marginStart="24dp"
				android:layout_marginTop="16dp"
				android:layout_marginEnd="24dp"
				android:background="@drawable/bg_card"
				android:orientation="vertical"
				android:padding="16dp">

				<TextView
					android:layout_width="match_parent"
					android:layout_height="wrap_content"
					android:text="Add Water Intake"
					android:textColor="@color/dark_text"
					android:textSize="18sp"
					android:textStyle="bold"
					android:layout_marginBottom="12dp" />

				<GridLayout
					android:layout_width="match_parent"
					android:layout_height="wrap_content"
					android:columnCount="2"
					android:rowCount="2">

					<Button
						android:id="@+id/btn_250ml"
						android:layout_width="0dp"
						android:layout_height="80dp"
						android:layout_columnWeight="1"
						android:layout_margin="4dp"
						android:backgroundTint="@color/sky_blue_accent"
						android:text="250ml\n"
						android:textColor="@color/white"
						android:textSize="14sp" />

					<Button
						android:id="@+id/btn_500ml"
						android:layout_width="0dp"
						android:layout_height="80dp"
						android:layout_columnWeight="1"
						android:layout_margin="4dp"
						android:backgroundTint="@color/teal_primary"
						android:text="500ml\n"
						android:textColor="@color/white"
						android:textSize="14sp" />

					<Button
						android:id="@+id/btn_750ml"
						android:layout_width="0dp"
						android:layout_height="80dp"
						android:layout_columnWeight="1"
						android:layout_margin="4dp"
						android:backgroundTint="@color/peach_secondary"
						android:text="750ml\n"
						android:textColor="@color/white"
						android:textSize="14sp" />

					<Button
						android:id="@+id/btn_1000ml"
						android:layout_width="0dp"
						android:layout_height="80dp"
						android:layout_columnWeight="1"
						android:layout_margin="4dp"
						android:backgroundTint="@color/soft_orange_secondary"
						android:text="1000ml\n"
						android:textColor="@color/white"
						android:textSize="14sp" />

				</GridLayout>

			</LinearLayout>

			<!-- Calendar Section -->
			<LinearLayout
				android:id="@+id/calendar_header"
				android:layout_width="match_parent"
				android:layout_height="wrap_content"
				android:layout_marginStart="24dp"
				android:layout_marginTop="16dp"
				android:layout_marginEnd="24dp"
				android:gravity="center_vertical"
				android:orientation="horizontal">

				<ImageButton
					android:id="@+id/button_prev_month"
					android:layout_width="wrap_content"
					android:layout_height="wrap_content"
					android:background="@android:color/transparent"
					android:src="@android:drawable/ic_media_previous" />

				<TextView
					android:id="@+id/text_month"
					android:layout_width="0dp"
					android:layout_height="wrap_content"
					android:layout_marginStart="8dp"
					android:layout_marginEnd="8dp"
					android:gravity="center"
					android:textColor="@color/dark_text"
					android:textSize="18sp"
					android:textStyle="bold"
					android:layout_weight="1" />

				<ImageButton
					android:id="@+id/button_next_month"
					android:layout_width="wrap_content"
					android:layout_height="wrap_content"
					android:background="@android:color/transparent"
					android:src="@android:drawable/ic_media_next" />

			</LinearLayout>

			<!-- Day headers -->
			<LinearLayout
				android:id="@+id/day_headers"
				android:layout_width="match_parent"
				android:layout_height="wrap_content"
				android:layout_marginStart="24dp"
				android:layout_marginEnd="24dp"
				android:layout_marginTop="8dp"
				android:orientation="horizontal">

				<TextView
					android:layout_width="0dp"
					android:layout_height="wrap_content"
					android:layout_weight="1"
					android:gravity="center"
					android:text="Sun"
					android:textColor="@color/dark_text"
					android:textSize="12sp"
					android:textStyle="bold" />

				<TextView
					android:layout_width="0dp"
					android:layout_height="wrap_content"
					android:layout_weight="1"
					android:gravity="center"
					android:text="Mon"
					android:textColor="@color/dark_text"
					android:textSize="12sp"
					android:textStyle="bold" />

				<TextView
					android:layout_width="0dp"
					android:layout_height="wrap_content"
					android:layout_weight="1"
					android:gravity="center"
					android:text="Tue"
					android:textColor="@color/dark_text"
					android:textSize="12sp"
					android:textStyle="bold" />

				<TextView
					android:layout_width="0dp"
					android:layout_height="wrap_content"
					android:layout_weight="1"
					android:gravity="center"
					android:text="Wed"
					android:textColor="@color/dark_text"
					android:textSize="12sp"
					android:textStyle="bold" />

				<TextView
					android:layout_width="0dp"
					android:layout_height="wrap_content"
					android:layout_weight="1"
					android:gravity="center"
					android:text="Thu"
					android:textColor="@color/dark_text"
					android:textSize="12sp"
					android:textStyle="bold" />

				<TextView
					android:layout_width="0dp"
					android:layout_height="wrap_content"
					android:layout_weight="1"
					android:gravity="center"
					android:text="Fri"
					android:textColor="@color/dark_text"
					android:textSize="12sp"
					android:textStyle="bold" />

				<TextView
					android:layout_width="0dp"
					android:layout_height="wrap_content"
					android:layout_weight="1"
					android:gravity="center"
					android:text="Sat"
					android:textColor="@color/dark_text"
					android:textSize="12sp"
					android:textStyle="bold" />

			</LinearLayout>

			<androidx.recyclerview.widget.RecyclerView
				android:id="@+id/recycler_calendar"
				android:layout_width="match_parent"
				android:layout_height="350dp"
				android:layout_marginStart="24dp"
				android:layout_marginEnd="24dp"
				android:layout_marginTop="8dp"
				android:background="@color/off_white_bg"
				android:padding="4dp"
				android:nestedScrollingEnabled="false"
				tools:listitem="@layout/item_calendar_day" />

			<!-- Today's Intake History -->
			<LinearLayout
				android:id="@+id/card_intake_history"
				android:layout_width="match_parent"
				android:layout_height="wrap_content"
				android:layout_marginStart="24dp"
				android:layout_marginTop="16dp"
				android:layout_marginEnd="24dp"
				android:background="@drawable/bg_card"
				android:orientation="vertical"
				android:padding="16dp">

				<TextView
					android:layout_width="match_parent"
					android:layout_height="wrap_content"
					android:text="Today's Intake History"
					android:textColor="@color/dark_text"
					android:textSize="18sp"
					android:textStyle="bold"
					android:layout_marginBottom="12dp" />

				<androidx.recyclerview.widget.RecyclerView
					android:id="@+id/recycler_intake_history"
					android:layout_width="match_parent"
					android:layout_height="200dp"
					android:nestedScrollingEnabled="false" />

			</LinearLayout>

			<!-- Settings Card -->
			<LinearLayout
				android:id="@+id/card_settings"
				android:layout_width="match_parent"
				android:layout_height="wrap_content"
				android:layout_marginStart="24dp"
				android:layout_marginTop="16dp"
				android:layout_marginEnd="24dp"
				android:layout_marginBottom="80dp"
				android:background="@drawable/bg_card"
				android:orientation="vertical"
				android:padding="16dp">

				<TextView
					android:layout_width="match_parent"
					android:layout_height="wrap_content"
					android:text="Settings"
					android:textColor="@color/dark_text"
					android:textSize="18sp"
					android:textStyle="bold"
					android:layout_marginBottom="12dp" />

				<TextView
					android:layout_width="match_parent"
					android:layout_height="wrap_content"
					android:text="Daily Goal (ml)"
					android:textColor="@color/dark_text"
					android:textStyle="bold"
					android:layout_marginBottom="8dp" />

				<Spinner
					android:id="@+id/spinner_daily_goal"
					android:layout_width="match_parent"
					android:layout_height="wrap_content"
					android:layout_marginBottom="16dp" />

				<TextView
					android:layout_width="match_parent"
					android:layout_height="wrap_content"
					android:text="Reminder Interval"
					android:textColor="@color/dark_text"
					android:textStyle="bold"
					android:layout_marginBottom="8dp" />

				<Spinner
					android:id="@+id/spinner_interval"
					android:layout_width="match_parent"
					android:layout_height="wrap_content"
					android:layout_marginBottom="16dp" />

				<LinearLayout
					android:layout_width="match_parent"
					android:layout_height="wrap_content"
					android:orientation="horizontal"
					android:gravity="center_vertical">

					<TextView
						android:layout_width="0dp"
						android:layout_height="wrap_content"
						android:layout_weight="1"
						android:text="Notifications"
						android:textColor="@color/dark_text"
						android:textStyle="bold" />

					<Switch
						android:id="@+id/switch_notifications"
						android:layout_width="wrap_content"
						android:layout_height="wrap_content" />

				</LinearLayout>

			</LinearLayout>

		</LinearLayout>

	</ScrollView>

	<LinearLayout
		android:id="@+id/bottom_nav"
		android:layout_width="0dp"
		android:layout_height="50dp"
		android:background="#FFFFFF"
		android:elevation="8dp"
		android:orientation="horizontal"
		android:paddingTop="4dp"
		android:paddingBottom="4dp"
		app:layout_constraintBottom_toBottomOf="parent"
		app:layout_constraintEnd_toEndOf="parent"
		app:layout_constraintStart_toStartOf="parent">

		<LinearLayout
			android:id="@+id/nav_home"
			android:layout_width="0dp"
			android:layout_height="match_parent"
			android:layout_weight="1"
			android:clickable="true"
			android:focusable="true"
			android:gravity="center"
			android:orientation="vertical"
			android:background="?android:attr/selectableItemBackground">

			<ImageView
				android:layout_width="20dp"
				android:layout_height="20dp"
				android:src="@drawable/ic_nav_home"
				android:scaleType="centerInside" />

			<TextView
				android:layout_width="wrap_content"
				android:layout_height="wrap_content"
				android:text="Home"
				android:textSize="10sp"
				android:textColor="#666666"
				android:layout_marginTop="2dp" />
		</LinearLayout>

		<LinearLayout
			android:id="@+id/nav_habits"
			android:layout_width="0dp"
			android:layout_height="match_parent"
			android:layout_weight="1"
			android:clickable="true"
			android:focusable="true"
			android:gravity="center"
			android:orientation="vertical"
			android:background="?android:attr/selectableItemBackground">

			<ImageView
				android:layout_width="20dp"
				android:layout_height="20dp"
				android:src="@drawable/ic_nav_habits"
				android:scaleType="centerInside" />

			<TextView
				android:layout_width="wrap_content"
				android:layout_height="wrap_content"
				android:text="Habits"
				android:textSize="10sp"
				android:textColor="#666666"
				android:layout_marginTop="2dp" />
		</LinearLayout>

		<LinearLayout
			android:id="@+id/nav_mood"
			android:layout_width="0dp"
			android:layout_height="match_parent"
			android:layout_weight="1"
			android:clickable="true"
			android:focusable="true"
			android:gravity="center"
			android:orientation="vertical"
			android:background="?android:attr/selectableItemBackground">

			<ImageView
				android:layout_width="20dp"
				android:layout_height="20dp"
				android:src="@drawable/ic_nav_mood"
				android:scaleType="centerInside" />

			<TextView
				android:layout_width="wrap_content"
				android:layout_height="wrap_content"
				android:text="Mood"
				android:textSize="10sp"
				android:textColor="#666666"
				android:layout_marginTop="2dp" />
		</LinearLayout>

		<LinearLayout
			android:id="@+id/nav_hydration"
			android:layout_width="0dp"
			android:layout_height="match_parent"
			android:layout_weight="1"
			android:clickable="true"
			android:focusable="true"
			android:gravity="center"
			android:orientation="vertical"
			android:background="?android:attr/selectableItemBackground">

			<ImageView
				android:layout_width="20dp"
				android:layout_height="20dp"
				android:src="@drawable/ic_nav_water"
				android:scaleType="centerInside"
				app:tint="@color/sky_blue_accent" />

			<TextView
				android:layout_width="wrap_content"
				android:layout_height="wrap_content"
				android:text="Water"
				android:textSize="10sp"
				android:textColor="@color/sky_blue_accent"
				android:textStyle="bold"
				android:layout_marginTop="2dp" />
		</LinearLayout>

		<LinearLayout
			android:id="@+id/nav_settings"
			android:layout_width="0dp"
			android:layout_height="match_parent"
			android:layout_weight="1"
			android:clickable="true"
			android:focusable="true"
			android:gravity="center"
			android:orientation="vertical"
			android:background="?android:attr/selectableItemBackground">

			<ImageView
				android:layout_width="20dp"
				android:layout_height="20dp"
				android:src="@drawable/ic_nav_settings"
				android:scaleType="centerInside" />

			<TextView
				android:layout_width="wrap_content"
				android:layout_height="wrap_content"
				android:text="Settings"
				android:textSize="10sp"
				android:textColor="#666666"
				android:layout_marginTop="2dp" />
		</LinearLayout>

	</LinearLayout>

</androidx.constraintlayout.widget.ConstraintLayout>

Now let me check the Widget Settings activity:"}],"tool_calls":[{"id":"toolu_bdrk_014NQ2cqeT3DYZJDrjEUnsag","type":"function","function":{"name":"read_file","arguments":"{"target_file": "app/src/main/res/layout/activity_widget_settings.xml"}"}}]},{"role":"tool","name":"read_file","tool_call_id":"toolu_bdrk_014NQ2cqeT3DYZJDrjEUnsag","content":"<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<LinearLayout xmlns:android="http://schemas.android.com/apk/res/android"
	android:layout_width="match_parent"
	android:layout_height="match_parent"
	android:orientation="vertical"
	android:padding="16dp"
	android:background="@color/off_white_bg">

	<include
		android:id="@+id/top_nav_include"
		layout="@layout/include_top_nav" />

	<TextView
		android:layout_width="wrap_content"
		android:layout_height="wrap_content"
		android:text="Widget display"
		android:textColor="@color/dark_text"
		android:textStyle="bold" />

	<RadioGroup
		android:id="@+id/group_display_mode"
		android:layout_width="match_parent"
		android:layout_height="wrap_content">

		<RadioButton
			android:id="@+id/radio_percent"
			android:layout_width="wrap_content"
			android:layout_height="wrap_content"
			android:checked="true"
			android:text="Percent (e.g., 50%)" />

		<RadioButton
			android:id="@+id/radio_fraction"
			android:layout_width="wrap_content"
			android:layout_height="wrap_content"
			android:text="Fraction (e.g., 4/8)" />

	</RadioGroup>

	<Button
		android:id="@+id/button_save"
		android:layout_width="match_parent"
		android:layout_height="wrap_content"
		android:text="Save" />

	<include
		android:id="@+id/bottom_nav_include"
		layout="@layout/include_bottom_nav" />

</LinearLayout>

import android.os.Bundle;
import android.view.LayoutInflater;
import android.view.View;
import android.view.ViewGroup;
import android.widget.ArrayAdapter;
import android.widget.Button;
import android.widget.ImageButton;
import android.widget.ProgressBar;
import android.widget.Spinner;
import android.widget.Switch;
import android.widget.TextView;

import androidx.activity.EdgeToEdge;
import androidx.annotation.NonNull;
import androidx.appcompat.app.AppCompatActivity;
import androidx.core.graphics.Insets;
import androidx.core.view.ViewCompat;
import androidx.core.view.WindowInsetsCompat;
import androidx.recyclerview.widget.GridLayoutManager;
import androidx.recyclerview.widget.LinearLayoutManager;
import androidx.recyclerview.widget.RecyclerView;

import java.text.SimpleDateFormat;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Date;
import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;

public class HydrationActivity extends AppCompatActivity {

 // UI Elements
 private Spinner intervalSpinner, dailyGoalSpinner;
 private Switch notificationsSwitch;
 private ProgressBar progressBar;
 private TextView intakeAmountText, percentageText;
 private Button btn250ml, btn500ml, btn750ml, btn1000ml;

 // Calendar
 private RecyclerView calendarView, intakeHistoryRecycler;
 private CalendarAdapter calendarAdapter;
 private IntakeHistoryAdapter historyAdapter;
 private java.util.Calendar currentMonth = java.util.Calendar.getInstance();
 private Date selectedDate = new Date();

 // Data
 private int dailyGoalMl = 2000;
 private Map<String, List<WaterIntake>> dailyIntakes = new HashMap<>();
 private List<WaterIntake> todayIntakes = new ArrayList<>();

 @Override
 protected void onCreate(Bundle savedInstanceState) {
 super.onCreate(savedInstanceState);
 EdgeToEdge.enable(this);
 setContentView(R.layout.activity_hydration);
 ViewCompat.setOnApplyWindowInsetsListener(findViewById(R.id.hydration_root), (v, insets) -> {
 Insets systemBars = insets.getInsets(WindowInsetsCompat.Type.systemBars());
 v.setPadding(systemBars.left, systemBars.top, systemBars.right, systemBars.bottom);
 return insets;
 });

 initializeViews();
 setupSpinners();
 setupVolumeButtons();
 setupCalendar();
 setupIntakeHistory();
 loadTodayData();
 updateProgress();

 BaseNavigation.wireTopNav(this, findViewById(R.id.top_nav_include));
 BaseNavigation.wireBottomNav(this, findViewById(R.id.bottom_nav_include));
 }

 private void initializeViews() {
 intervalSpinner = findViewById(R.id.spinner_interval);
 dailyGoalSpinner = findViewById(R.id.spinner_daily_goal);
 notificationsSwitch = findViewById(R.id.switch_notifications);
 progressBar = findViewById(R.id.progress_hydration);
 intakeAmountText = findViewById(R.id.text_intake_amount);
 percentageText = findViewById(R.id.text_percentage);

 btn250ml = findViewById(R.id.btn_250ml);
 btn500ml = findViewById(R.id.btn_500ml);
 btn750ml = findViewById(R.id.btn_750ml);
 btn1000ml = findViewById(R.id.btn_1000ml);

 calendarView = findViewById(R.id.recycler_calendar);
 intakeHistoryRecycler = findViewById(R.id.recycler_intake_history);
 }

 private void setupSpinners() {
 // Daily goal spinner
 String[] goals = {"1500 ml", "2000 ml", "2500 ml", "3000 ml", "3500 ml"};
 ArrayAdapter<String> goalAdapter = new ArrayAdapter<>(this, android.R.layout.simple_spinner_item, goals);
 goalAdapter.setDropDownViewResource(android.R.layout.simple_spinner_dropdown_item);
 dailyGoalSpinner.setAdapter(goalAdapter);
 dailyGoalSpinner.setSelection(1); // Default to 2000ml

 dailyGoalSpinner.setOnItemSelectedListener(new android.widget.AdapterView.OnItemSelectedListener() {
 @Override
 public void onItemSelected(android.widget.AdapterView<?> parent, View view, int position, long id) {
 switch (position) {
 case 0:
 dailyGoalMl = 1500;
 break;
 case 1:
 dailyGoalMl = 2000;
 break;
 case 2:
 dailyGoalMl = 2500;
 break;
 case 3:
 dailyGoalMl = 3000;
 break;
 case 4:
 dailyGoalMl = 3500;
 break;
 }
 updateProgress();
 }

 @Override
 public void onNothingSelected(android.widget.AdapterView<?> parent) {
 }
 });

 // Interval spinner
 String[] intervals = {"30 minutes", "1 hour", "2 hours", "3 hours"};
 ArrayAdapter<String> intervalAdapter = new ArrayAdapter<>(this, android.R.layout.simple_spinner_item, intervals);
 intervalAdapter.setDropDownViewResource(android.R.layout.simple_spinner_dropdown_item);
 intervalSpinner.setAdapter(intervalAdapter);
 }

 private void setupVolumeButtons() {
 btn250ml.setOnClickListener(v -> addWaterIntake(250));
 btn500ml.setOnClickListener(v -> addWaterIntake(500));
 btn750ml.setOnClickListener(v -> addWaterIntake(750));
 btn1000ml.setOnClickListener(v -> addWaterIntake(1000));
 }

 private void setupCalendar() {
 calendarView.setLayoutManager(new GridLayoutManager(this, 7));
 calendarAdapter = new CalendarAdapter(new ArrayList<>(), dayCell -> {
 selectedDate = dayCell.date;
 loadSelectedDateData();
 });
 calendarView.setAdapter(calendarAdapter);

 // Calendar navigation
 findViewById(R.id.button_prev_month).setOnClickListener(v -> {
 currentMonth.add(java.util.Calendar.MONTH, -1);
 bindMonth();
 });
 findViewById(R.id.button_next_month).setOnClickListener(v -> {
 currentMonth.add(java.util.Calendar.MONTH, 1);
 bindMonth();
 });

 bindMonth();
 }

 private void setupIntakeHistory() {
 historyAdapter = new IntakeHistoryAdapter(todayIntakes, position -> {
 // Delete intake
 if (position < todayIntakes.size()) {
 todayIntakes.remove(position);
 saveTodayData();
 historyAdapter.notifyItemRemoved(position);
 updateProgress();
 calendarAdapter.updateIntakes(mapDateToIntake());
 }
 });
 intakeHistoryRecycler.setLayoutManager(new LinearLayoutManager(this));
 intakeHistoryRecycler.setAdapter(historyAdapter);
 }

 private void addWaterIntake(int volumeMl) {
 WaterIntake intake = new WaterIntake(volumeMl, new Date());
 todayIntakes.add(0, intake);
 saveTodayData();
 historyAdapter.notifyItemInserted(0);
 updateProgress();
 calendarAdapter.updateIntakes(mapDateToIntake());
 }

 private void bindMonth() {
 TextView monthTitle = findViewById(R.id.text_month);
 SimpleDateFormat sdf = new SimpleDateFormat("MMMM yyyy");
 monthTitle.setText(sdf.format(currentMonth.getTime()));

 java.util.Calendar cal = (java.util.Calendar) currentMonth.clone();
 cal.set(java.util.Calendar.DAY_OF_MONTH, 1);

 int firstDayOfWeek = cal.get(java.util.Calendar.DAY_OF_WEEK);
 int daysInMonth = cal.getActualMaximum(java.util.Calendar.DAY_OF_MONTH);

 List<DayCell> cells = new ArrayList<>();

 // Add empty cells for proper alignment
 for (int i = 1; i < firstDayOfWeek; i++) {
 cells.add(DayCell.empty());
 }

 // Add all days of the month
 for (int day = 1; day <= daysInMonth; day++) {
 cal.set(java.util.Calendar.DAY_OF_MONTH, day);
 cells.add(DayCell.of(cal.getTime()));
 }

 // Fill to 42 cells (6 rows × 7 columns)
 while (cells.size() < 42) {
 cells.add(DayCell.empty());
 }

 calendarAdapter.submit(cells, mapDateToIntake());
 }

 private Map<String, String> mapDateToIntake() {
 SimpleDateFormat keyFmt = new SimpleDateFormat("yyyy-MM-dd");
 Map<String, String> map = new HashMap<>();

 for (String dateKey : dailyIntakes.keySet()) {
 List<WaterIntake> intakes = dailyIntakes.get(dateKey);
 if (intakes != null && !intakes.isEmpty()) {
 int totalMl = 0;
 for (WaterIntake intake : intakes) {
 totalMl += intake.volumeMl;
 }
 int percentage = (int) ((totalMl * 100f) / dailyGoalMl);
 map.put(dateKey, percentage + "%");
 }
 }

 return map;
 }

 private void loadTodayData() {
 SimpleDateFormat keyFmt = new SimpleDateFormat("yyyy-MM-dd");
 String todayKey = keyFmt.format(new Date());

 if (dailyIntakes.containsKey(todayKey)) {
 todayIntakes = dailyIntakes.get(todayKey);
 } else {
 todayIntakes = new ArrayList<>();
 dailyIntakes.put(todayKey, todayIntakes);
 }

 historyAdapter.updateItems(todayIntakes);
 }

 private void loadSelectedDateData() {
 SimpleDateFormat keyFmt = new SimpleDateFormat("yyyy-MM-dd");
 String selectedKey = keyFmt.format(selectedDate);

 List<WaterIntake> selectedIntakes = dailyIntakes.getOrDefault(selectedKey, new ArrayList<>());
 historyAdapter.updateItems(selectedIntakes);

 // Update progress for selected date
 int totalMl = 0;
 for (WaterIntake intake : selectedIntakes) {
 totalMl += intake.volumeMl;
 }

 int percentage = (int) ((totalMl * 100f) / dailyGoalMl);
 intakeAmountText.setText(totalMl + " ml / " + dailyGoalMl + " ml");
 percentageText.setText(percentage + "%");
 progressBar.setProgress(percentage);
 }

 private void saveTodayData() {
 SimpleDateFormat keyFmt = new SimpleDateFormat("yyyy-MM-dd");
 String todayKey = keyFmt.format(new Date());
 dailyIntakes.put(todayKey, new ArrayList<>(todayIntakes));
 }

 private void updateProgress() {
 int totalMl = 0;
 for (WaterIntake intake : todayIntakes) {
 totalMl += intake.volumeMl;
 }

 int percentage = Math.min(100, (int) ((totalMl * 100f) / dailyGoalMl));

 intakeAmountText.setText(totalMl + " ml / " + dailyGoalMl + " ml");
 percentageText.setText(percentage + "%");
 progressBar.setProgress(percentage);
 }

 // Data Classes
 private static class WaterIntake {
 int volumeMl;
 Date timestamp;

 WaterIntake(int volumeMl, Date timestamp) {
 this.volumeMl = volumeMl;
 this.timestamp = timestamp;
 }
 }

 private static class DayCell {
 boolean isInvalid;
 boolean isEmpty;
 Date date;
 int dayNumber;

 static DayCell of(Date date) {
 DayCell d = new DayCell();
 d.isInvalid = false;
 d.isEmpty = false;
 d.date = date;
 java.util.Calendar c = java.util.Calendar.getInstance();
 c.setTime(date);
 d.dayNumber = c.get(java.util.Calendar.DAY_OF_MONTH);
 return d;
 }

 static DayCell empty() {
 DayCell d = new DayCell();
 d.isInvalid = false;
 d.isEmpty = true;
 d.dayNumber = 0;
 return d;
 }
 }

 // Adapters
 private interface DayClickListener {
 void onDayClick(DayCell dayCell);
 }

 private static class CalendarAdapter extends RecyclerView.Adapter<CalendarAdapter.DayViewHolder> {
 private final List<DayCell> cells;
 private final DayClickListener listener;
 private Map<String, String> dateToIntake = new HashMap<>();

 CalendarAdapter(List<DayCell> cells, DayClickListener listener) {
 this.cells = cells;
 this.listener = listener;
 }

 void submit(List<DayCell> newCells, Map<String, String> dateToIntake) {
 this.cells.clear();
 this.cells.addAll(newCells);
 this.dateToIntake = dateToIntake;
 notifyDataSetChanged();
 }

 void updateIntakes(Map<String, String> dateToIntake) {
 this.dateToIntake = dateToIntake;
 notifyDataSetChanged();
 }

 @NonNull
 @Override
 public DayViewHolder onCreateViewHolder(@NonNull ViewGroup parent, int viewType) {
 View v = LayoutInflater.from(parent.getContext()).inflate(R.layout.item_calendar_day, parent, false);
 return new DayViewHolder(v);
 }

 @Override
 public void onBindViewHolder(@NonNull DayViewHolder holder, int position) {
 DayCell cell = cells.get(position);

 if (cell.isEmpty) {
 holder.day.setText("");
 holder.emoji.setText("");
 holder.day.setAlpha(0.3f);
 holder.itemView.setOnClickListener(null);
 } else {
 holder.day.setText(String.valueOf(cell.dayNumber));
 holder.day.setAlpha(1f);

 if (!cell.isInvalid && cell.date != null) {
 SimpleDateFormat keyFmt = new SimpleDateFormat("yyyy-MM-dd");
 String key = keyFmt.format(cell.date);
 holder.emoji.setText(dateToIntake.getOrDefault(key, ""));
 holder.itemView.setOnClickListener(v -> listener.onDayClick(cell));

 // Highlight selected day
 try {
 String sel = keyFmt.format(((HydrationActivity) holder.itemView.getContext()).selectedDate);
 if (sel.equals(key)) {
 holder.itemView.setBackgroundColor(0xFFE3F2FD);
 } else {
 holder.itemView.setBackgroundColor(0xFFFFFFFF);
 }
 } catch (Exception e) {
 holder.itemView.setBackgroundColor(0xFFFFFFFF);
 }
 } else {
 holder.emoji.setText("");
 holder.itemView.setOnClickListener(null);
 holder.itemView.setBackgroundColor(0xFFFFFFFF);
 }
 }
 }

 @Override
 public int getItemCount() {
 return cells.size();
 }

 static class DayViewHolder extends RecyclerView.ViewHolder {
 TextView day, emoji;

 DayViewHolder(@NonNull View itemView) {
 super(itemView);
 day = itemView.findViewById(R.id.text_day);
 emoji = itemView.findViewById(R.id.text_day_emoji);
 }
 }
 }

 private interface IntakeDeleteListener {
 void onDeleteIntake(int position);
 }

 private static class IntakeHistoryAdapter extends RecyclerView.Adapter<IntakeHistoryAdapter.IntakeViewHolder> {
 private List<WaterIntake> intakes;

 IntakeHistoryAdapter(List<WaterIntake> intakes, IntakeDeleteListener listener) {
 this.intakes = intakes;
 this.listener = listener;
 }

 void updateItems(List<WaterIntake> newIntakes) {
 this.intakes = newIntakes;
 notifyDataSetChanged();

 @NonNull

 public IntakeViewHolder onCreateViewHolder(@NonNull ViewGroup parent, int viewType) {

 }

 @Override
 public void onBindViewHolder(@NonNull IntakeViewHolder holder, int position) {
 WaterIntake intake = intakes.get(position);
 holder.volumeText.setText(intake.volumeMl + " ml");

 SimpleDateFormat timeFormat = new SimpleDateFormat("hh:mm a");
 holder.timeText.setText(timeFormat.format(intake.timestamp));

 holder.deleteButton.setOnClickListener(v -> listener.onDeleteIntake(holder.getAdapterPosition()));

 @Override
 public int getItemCount() {
 return intakes.size();

 static class IntakeViewHolder extends RecyclerView.ViewHolder {
 TextView volumeText, timeText;
 ImageButton deleteButton;

 IntakeViewHolder(@NonNull View itemView) {
 super(itemView);
 volumeText = itemView.findViewById(R.id.text_volume);
 timeText = itemView.findViewById(R.id.text_time);
 deleteButton = itemView.findViewById(R.id.btn_delete);
 }
 }
 }

import android.appwidget.AppWidgetManager;
import android.content.Intent;
import android.os.Bundle;
import android.view.View;
import android.widget.RadioButton;
import android.widget.RadioGroup;

import androidx.activity.EdgeToEdge;
import androidx.appcompat.app.AppCompatActivity;

public class WidgetSettingsActivity extends AppCompatActivity {

	private int appWidgetId = AppWidgetManager.INVALID_APPWIDGET_ID;

	@Override
	protected void onCreate(Bundle savedInstanceState) {
		super.onCreate(savedInstanceState);
		EdgeToEdge.enable(this);
		setContentView(R.layout.activity_widget_settings);

		BaseNavigation.wireTopNav(this, findViewById(R.id.top_nav_include));
		BaseNavigation.wireBottomNav(this, findViewById(R.id.bottom_nav_include));

		Intent intent = getIntent();
		Bundle extras = intent.getExtras();
		if (extras != null) {
			appWidgetId = extras.getInt(AppWidgetManager.EXTRA_APPWIDGET_ID, AppWidgetManager.INVALID_APPWIDGET_ID);
		}

		findViewById(R.id.button_save).setOnClickListener(new View.OnClickListener() {
			@Override
			public void onClick(View v) {
				RadioGroup group = findViewById(R.id.group_display_mode);
				int selected = group.getCheckedRadioButtonId();
				String mode = selected == R.id.radio_percent ? "percent" : "fraction";
				getSharedPreferences(HabitProgressWidgetProvider.PREFS_NAME, MODE_PRIVATE)
					.edit()
					.putString(HabitProgressWidgetProvider.KEY_DISPLAY_MODE, mode)
					.apply();

				HabitProgressWidgetProvider.requestUpdateAll(WidgetSettingsActivity.this);

				Intent result = new Intent();
				result.putExtra(AppWidgetManager.EXTRA_APPWIDGET_ID, appWidgetId);
				setResult(RESULT_OK, result);
				finish();
			}
		});
	}
}

import android.os.Bundle;
import android.view.LayoutInflater;
import android.view.View;
import android.view.ViewGroup;
import android.widget.ArrayAdapter;
import android.widget.Button;
import android.widget.ImageButton;
import android.widget.ProgressBar;
import android.widget.Spinner;
import android.widget.Switch;
import android.widget.TextView;

import androidx.activity.EdgeToEdge;
import androidx.annotation.NonNull;
import androidx.appcompat.app.AppCompatActivity;
import androidx.core.graphics.Insets;
import androidx.core.view.ViewCompat;
import androidx.core.view.WindowInsetsCompat;
import androidx.recyclerview.widget.GridLayoutManager;
import androidx.recyclerview.widget.LinearLayoutManager;
import androidx.recyclerview.widget.RecyclerView;

import java.text.SimpleDateFormat;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Date;
import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;

public class HydrationActivity extends AppCompatActivity {

 // UI Elements
 private Spinner intervalSpinner, dailyGoalSpinner;
 private Switch notificationsSwitch;
 private ProgressBar progressBar;
 private TextView intakeAmountText, percentageText;
 private Button btn250ml, btn500ml, btn750ml, btn1000ml;

 // Calendar
 private RecyclerView calendarView, intakeHistoryRecycler;
 private CalendarAdapter calendarAdapter;
 private IntakeHistoryAdapter historyAdapter;
 private java.util.Calendar currentMonth = java.util.Calendar.getInstance();
 private Date selectedDate = new Date();

 // Data
 private int dailyGoalMl = 2000;
 private Map<String, List<WaterIntake>> dailyIntakes = new HashMap<>();
 private List<WaterIntake> todayIntakes = new ArrayList<>();

 @Override
 protected void onCreate(Bundle savedInstanceState) {
 super.onCreate(savedInstanceState);
 EdgeToEdge.enable(this);
 setContentView(R.layout.activity_hydration);
 ViewCompat.setOnApplyWindowInsetsListener(findViewById(R.id.hydration_root), (v, insets) -> {
 Insets systemBars = insets.getInsets(WindowInsetsCompat.Type.systemBars());
 v.setPadding(systemBars.left, systemBars.top, systemBars.right, systemBars.bottom);
 return insets;
 });

 initializeViews();
 setupSpinners();
 setupVolumeButtons();
 setupCalendar();
 setupIntakeHistory();
 loadTodayData();
 updateProgress();

 BaseNavigation.wireTopNav(this, findViewById(R.id.top_nav_include));
 setupBottomNavigation();
 }

 private void initializeViews() {
 intervalSpinner = findViewById(R.id.spinner_interval);
 dailyGoalSpinner = findViewById(R.id.spinner_daily_goal);
 notificationsSwitch = findViewById(R.id.switch_notifications);
 progressBar = findViewById(R.id.progress_hydration);
 intakeAmountText = findViewById(R.id.text_intake_amount);
 percentageText = findViewById(R.id.text_percentage);

 btn250ml = findViewById(R.id.btn_250ml);
 btn500ml = findViewById(R.id.btn_500ml);
 btn750ml = findViewById(R.id.btn_750ml);
 btn1000ml = findViewById(R.id.btn_1000ml);

 calendarView = findViewById(R.id.recycler_calendar);
 intakeHistoryRecycler = findViewById(R.id.recycler_intake_history);
 }

 private void setupSpinners() {
 // Daily goal spinner
 String[] goals = {"1500 ml", "2000 ml", "2500 ml", "3000 ml", "3500 ml"};
 ArrayAdapter<String> goalAdapter = new ArrayAdapter<>(this, android.R.layout.simple_spinner_item, goals);
 goalAdapter.setDropDownViewResource(android.R.layout.simple_spinner_dropdown_item);
 dailyGoalSpinner.setAdapter(goalAdapter);
 dailyGoalSpinner.setSelection(1); // Default to 2000ml

 dailyGoalSpinner.setOnItemSelectedListener(new android.widget.AdapterView.OnItemSelectedListener() {
 @Override
 public void onItemSelected(android.widget.AdapterView<?> parent, View view, int position, long id) {
 switch (position) {
 case 0:
 dailyGoalMl = 1500;
 break;
 case 1:
 dailyGoalMl = 2000;
 break;
 case 2:
 dailyGoalMl = 2500;
 break;
 case 3:
 dailyGoalMl = 3000;
 break;
 case 4:
 dailyGoalMl = 3500;
 break;
 }
 updateProgress();
 }

 @Override
 public void onNothingSelected(android.widget.AdapterView<?> parent) {
 }
 });

 // Interval spinner
 String[] intervals = {"30 minutes", "1 hour", "2 hours", "3 hours"};
 ArrayAdapter<String> intervalAdapter = new ArrayAdapter<>(this, android.R.layout.simple_spinner_item, intervals);
 intervalAdapter.setDropDownViewResource(android.R.layout.simple_spinner_dropdown_item);
 intervalSpinner.setAdapter(intervalAdapter);
 }

 private void setupVolumeButtons() {
 btn250ml.setOnClickListener(v -> addWaterIntake(250));
 btn500ml.setOnClickListener(v -> addWaterIntake(500));
 btn750ml.setOnClickListener(v -> addWaterIntake(750));
 btn1000ml.setOnClickListener(v -> addWaterIntake(1000));
 }

 private void setupCalendar() {
 calendarView.setLayoutManager(new GridLayoutManager(this, 7));
 calendarAdapter = new CalendarAdapter(new ArrayList<>(), dayCell -> {
 selectedDate = dayCell.date;
 loadSelectedDateData();
 });
 calendarView.setAdapter(calendarAdapter);

 // Update calendar for the current month and highlight today's date
 TextView monthTitle = findViewById(R.id.text_month);
 SimpleDateFormat sdf = new SimpleDateFormat("MMMM yyyy");
 monthTitle.setText(sdf.format(currentMonth.getTime()));

 java.util.Calendar cal = (java.util.Calendar) currentMonth.clone();
 cal.set(java.util.Calendar.DAY_OF_MONTH, 1);

 int firstDayOfWeek = cal.get(java.util.Calendar.DAY_OF_WEEK);
 int daysInMonth = cal.getActualMaximum(java.util.Calendar.DAY_OF_MONTH);

 List<DayCell> cells = new ArrayList<>();

 // Add empty cells for proper alignment
 for (int i = 1; i < firstDayOfWeek; i++) {
 cells.add(DayCell.empty());
 }

 // Add all days of the month
 for (int day = 1; day <= daysInMonth; day++) {
 cal.set(java.util.Calendar.DAY_OF_MONTH, day);
 cells.add(DayCell.of(cal.getTime()));
 }

 // Fill to 42 cells (6 rows × 7 columns)
 while (cells.size() < 42) {
 cells.add(DayCell.empty());
 }

 calendarAdapter.submit(cells, mapDateToIntake());
 }

 private void setupIntakeHistory() {
 historyAdapter = new IntakeHistoryAdapter(todayIntakes, position -> {
 // Delete intake
 if (position < todayIntakes.size()) {
 todayIntakes.remove(position);
 saveTodayData();
 historyAdapter.notifyItemRemoved(position);
 updateProgress();
 calendarAdapter.updateIntakes(mapDateToIntake());
 }
 });
 intakeHistoryRecycler.setLayoutManager(new LinearLayoutManager(this));
 intakeHistoryRecycler.setAdapter(historyAdapter);
 }

 private void addWaterIntake(int volumeMl) {
 WaterIntake intake = new WaterIntake(volumeMl, new Date());
 todayIntakes.add(0, intake);
 saveTodayData();
 historyAdapter.notifyItemInserted(0);
 updateProgress();
 calendarAdapter.updateIntakes(mapDateToIntake());
 }

 private void bindMonth() {
 TextView monthTitle = findViewById(R.id.text_month);
 SimpleDateFormat sdf = new SimpleDateFormat("MMMM yyyy");
 monthTitle.setText(sdf.format(currentMonth.getTime()));

 java.util.Calendar cal = (java.util.Calendar) currentMonth.clone();
 cal.set(java.util.Calendar.DAY_OF_MONTH, 1);

 int firstDayOfWeek = cal.get(java.util.Calendar.DAY_OF_WEEK);
 int daysInMonth = cal.getActualMaximum(java.util.Calendar.DAY_OF_MONTH);

 List<DayCell> cells = new ArrayList<>();

 // Add empty cells for proper alignment
 for (int i = 1; i < firstDayOfWeek; i++) {
 cells.add(DayCell.empty());
 }

 // Add all days of the month
 for (int day = 1; day <= daysInMonth; day++) {
 cal.set(java.util.Calendar.DAY_OF_MONTH, day);
 cells.add(DayCell.of(cal.getTime()));
 }

 // Fill to 42 cells (6 rows × 7 columns)
 while (cells.size() < 42) {
 cells.add(DayCell.empty());
 }

 calendarAdapter.submit(cells, mapDateToIntake());
 }

 private Map<String, String> mapDateToIntake() {
 SimpleDateFormat keyFmt = new SimpleDateFormat("yyyy-MM-dd");
 Map<String, String> map = new HashMap<>();

 for (String dateKey : dailyIntakes.keySet()) {
 List<WaterIntake> intakes = dailyIntakes.get(dateKey);
 if (intakes != null && !intakes.isEmpty()) {
 int totalMl = 0;
 for (WaterIntake intake : intakes) {
 totalMl += intake.volumeMl;
 }
 int percentage = (int) ((totalMl * 100f) / dailyGoalMl);
 map.put(dateKey, percentage + "%");
 }
 }

 return map;
 }

 private void loadTodayData() {
 SimpleDateFormat keyFmt = new SimpleDateFormat("yyyy-MM-dd");
 String todayKey = keyFmt.format(new Date());

 if (dailyIntakes.containsKey(todayKey)) {
 todayIntakes = dailyIntakes.get(todayKey);
 } else {
 todayIntakes = new ArrayList<>();
 dailyIntakes.put(todayKey, todayIntakes);
 }

 historyAdapter.updateItems(todayIntakes);
 }

 private void loadSelectedDateData() {
 SimpleDateFormat keyFmt = new SimpleDateFormat("yyyy-MM-dd");
 String selectedKey = keyFmt.format(selectedDate);

 List<WaterIntake> selectedIntakes = dailyIntakes.getOrDefault(selectedKey, new ArrayList<>());
 historyAdapter.updateItems(selectedIntakes);

 // Update progress for selected date
 int totalMl = 0;
 for (WaterIntake intake : selectedIntakes) {
 totalMl += intake.volumeMl;
 }

 int percentage = (int) ((totalMl * 100f) / dailyGoalMl);
 intakeAmountText.setText(totalMl + " ml / " + dailyGoalMl + " ml");
 percentageText.setText(percentage + "%");
 progressBar.setProgress(percentage);
 }

 private void saveTodayData() {
 SimpleDateFormat keyFmt = new SimpleDateFormat("yyyy-MM-dd");
 String todayKey = keyFmt.format(new Date());
 dailyIntakes.put(todayKey, new ArrayList<>(todayIntakes));
 }

 private void updateProgress() {
 int totalMl = 0;
 for (WaterIntake intake : todayIntakes) {
 totalMl += intake.volumeMl;
 }

 int percentage = Math.min(100, (int) ((totalMl * 100f) / dailyGoalMl));

 intakeAmountText.setText(totalMl + " ml / " + dailyGoalMl + " ml");
 percentageText.setText(percentage + "%");
 progressBar.setProgress(percentage);
 }

 // Data Classes
 private static class WaterIntake {
 int volumeMl;
 Date timestamp;

 WaterIntake(int volumeMl, Date timestamp) {
 this.volumeMl = volumeMl;
 this.timestamp = timestamp;
 }
 }

 private static class DayCell {
 boolean isInvalid;
 boolean isEmpty;
 Date date;
 int dayNumber;

 static DayCell of(Date date) {
 DayCell d = new DayCell();
 d.isInvalid = false;
 d.isEmpty = false;
 d.date = date;
 java.util.Calendar c = java.util.Calendar.getInstance();
 c.setTime(date);
 d.dayNumber = c.get(java.util.Calendar.DAY_OF_MONTH);
 return d;
 }

 static DayCell empty() {
 DayCell d = new DayCell();
 d.isInvalid = false;
 d.isEmpty = true;
 d.dayNumber = 0;
 return d;
 }
 }

 // Adapters
 private interface DayClickListener {
 void onDayClick(DayCell dayCell);
 }

 private static class CalendarAdapter extends RecyclerView.Adapter<CalendarAdapter.DayViewHolder> {
 private final List<DayCell> cells;
 private final DayClickListener listener;
 private Map<String, String> dateToIntake = new HashMap<>();

 CalendarAdapter(List<DayCell> cells, DayClickListener listener) {
 this.cells = cells;
 this.listener = listener;
 }

 void submit(List<DayCell> newCells, Map<String, String> dateToIntake) {
 this.cells.clear();
 this.cells.addAll(newCells);
 this.dateToIntake = dateToIntake;
 notifyDataSetChanged();
 }

 void updateIntakes(Map<String, String> dateToIntake) {
 this.dateToIntake = dateToIntake;
 notifyDataSetChanged();
 }

 @NonNull
 @Override
 public DayViewHolder onCreateViewHolder(@NonNull ViewGroup parent, int viewType) {
 View v = LayoutInflater.from(parent.getContext()).inflate(R.layout.item_calendar_day, parent, false);
 return new DayViewHolder(v);
 }

 @Override
 public void onBindViewHolder(@NonNull DayViewHolder holder, int position) {
 DayCell cell = cells.get(position);

 if (cell.isEmpty) {
 holder.day.setText("");
 holder.emoji.setText("");
 holder.day.setAlpha(0.3f);
 holder.itemView.setOnClickListener(null);
 } else {
 holder.day.setText(String.valueOf(cell.dayNumber));
 holder.day.setAlpha(1f);

 if (!cell.isInvalid && cell.date != null) {
 SimpleDateFormat keyFmt = new SimpleDateFormat("yyyy-MM-dd");
 String key = keyFmt.format(cell.date);
 holder.emoji.setText(dateToIntake.getOrDefault(key, ""));
 holder.itemView.setOnClickListener(v -> listener.onDayClick(cell));

 // Highlight selected day
 try {
 String sel = keyFmt.format(((HydrationActivity) holder.itemView.getContext()).selectedDate);
 if (sel.equals(key)) {
 holder.itemView.setBackgroundColor(0xFFE3F2FD);
 } else {
 holder.itemView.setBackgroundColor(0xFFFFFFFF);
 }
 } catch (Exception e) {
 holder.itemView.setBackgroundColor(0xFFFFFFFF);
 }
 } else {
 holder.emoji.setText("");
 holder.itemView.setOnClickListener(null);
 holder.itemView.setBackgroundColor(0xFFFFFFFF);
 }
 }
 }

 @Override
 public int getItemCount() {
 return cells.size();
 }

 static class DayViewHolder extends RecyclerView.ViewHolder {
 TextView day, emoji;

 DayViewHolder(@NonNull View itemView) {
 super(itemView);
 day = itemView.findViewById(R.id.text_day);
 emoji = itemView.findViewById(R.id.text_day_emoji);
 }
 }
 }

 private interface IntakeDeleteListener {
 void onDeleteIntake(int position);
 }

 private static class IntakeHistoryAdapter extends RecyclerView.Adapter<IntakeHistoryAdapter.IntakeViewHolder> {
 private List<WaterIntake> intakes;
 private final IntakeDeleteListener listener;

 IntakeHistoryAdapter(List<WaterIntake> intakes, IntakeDeleteListener listener) {
 this.intakes = intakes;
 this.listener = listener;
 }

 void updateItems(List<WaterIntake> newIntakes) {
 this.intakes = newIntakes;
 notifyDataSetChanged();
 }

 @NonNull
 @Override
 public IntakeViewHolder onCreateViewHolder(@NonNull ViewGroup parent, int viewType) {
 View view = LayoutInflater.from(parent.getContext()).inflate(R.layout.item_water_intake, parent, false);
 return new IntakeViewHolder(view);
 }

 @Override
 public void onBindViewHolder(@NonNull IntakeViewHolder holder, int position) {
 WaterIntake intake = intakes.get(position);
 holder.volumeText.setText(intake.volumeMl + " ml");

 SimpleDateFormat timeFormat = new SimpleDateFormat("hh:mm a");
 holder.timeText.setText(timeFormat.format(intake.timestamp));

 holder.deleteButton.setOnClickListener(v -> listener.onDeleteIntake(holder.getAdapterPosition()));
 }

 @Override
 public int getItemCount() {
 return intakes.size();
 }

 static class IntakeViewHolder extends RecyclerView.ViewHolder {
 TextView volumeText, timeText;
 ImageButton deleteButton;

 IntakeViewHolder(@NonNull View itemView) {
 super(itemView);
 volumeText = itemView.findViewById(R.id.text_volume);
 timeText = itemView.findViewById(R.id.text_time);
 deleteButton = itemView.findViewById(R.id.btn_delete);
 }
 }
 }

 // Home navigation
 findViewById(R.id.nav_home).setOnClickListener(v -> {

 findViewById(R.id.nav_hydration).setOnClickListener(v -> {
 // Already on hydration page
 });

 findViewById(R.id.nav_settings).setOnClickListener(v -> {
 android.content.Intent intent = new android.content.Intent(HydrationActivity.this, WidgetSettingsActivity.class);
 startActivity(intent);
 });
 }
}

+	private void enterEditMode() {
+		isEditMode = true;
+
+		// Hide display views
+		textUserName.setVisibility(View.GONE);
+		textUserEmail.setVisibility(View.GONE);

+
+		// Set current values

+

+	}
+
+	private void saveProfileChanges() {
+		String newName = editUserName.getText().toString().trim();
+		String newEmail = editUserEmail.getText().toString().trim();
+
+		// Validate input
+		if (TextUtils.isEmpty(newName)) {
+			editUserName.setError("Name is required");
+			editUserName.requestFocus();
+			return;
+		}
+
+		if (TextUtils.isEmpty(newEmail)) {
+			editUserEmail.setError("Email is required");
+			editUserEmail.requestFocus();
+			return;
+		}
+
+		if (!Patterns.EMAIL_ADDRESS.matcher(newEmail).matches()) {
+			editUserEmail.setError("Please enter a valid email address");
+			editUserEmail.requestFocus();
+			return;
+		}
+
+		// Check if email is already taken (by another user)
+		if (!newEmail.equals(originalEmail) && sharedPreferences.contains("user_email_" + newEmail)) {
+			editUserEmail.setError("This email is already registered");
+			editUserEmail.requestFocus();
+			return;
+		}
+
+		// Save changes
+		SharedPreferences.Editor editor = sharedPreferences.edit();
+
+		// If email changed, update all user data keys
+		if (!newEmail.equals(originalEmail)) {
+			// Get current password
+			String currentPassword = sharedPreferences.getString("user_password_" + originalEmail, "");
+
+			// Remove old entries
+			editor.remove("user_email_" + originalEmail);
+			editor.remove("user_name_" + originalEmail);
+			editor.remove("user_password_" + originalEmail);
+
+			// Add new entries
+			editor.putString("user_email_" + newEmail, newEmail);
+			editor.putString("user_name_" + newEmail, newName);
+			editor.putString("user_password_" + newEmail, currentPassword);
+		} else {
+			// Just update name
+			editor.putString("user_name_" + newEmail, newName);
+		}
+
+		// Update current session
+		editor.putString("current_user_name", newName);
+		editor.putString("current_user_email", newEmail);
+
+		editor.apply();
+
+		// Update display
+		originalName = newName;
+		originalEmail = newEmail;
+		exitEditMode();
+
+		Toast.makeText(this, "Profile updated successfully!", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show();
+	}
+
+	private void cancelEdit() {
+		exitEditMode();
+	}
+
+	private void exitEditMode() {
+		isEditMode = false;
+
+		// Show display views
+		textUserName.setVisibility(View.VISIBLE);
+		textUserEmail.setVisibility(View.VISIBLE);
+		btnEditProfile.setVisibility(View.VISIBLE);
+
+		// Hide edit views
+		editUserName.setVisibility(View.GONE);
+		editUserEmail.setVisibility(View.GONE);
+		layoutEditButtons.setVisibility(View.GONE);
+
+		// Update display with current values
+		textUserName.setText(originalName);
+		textUserEmail.setText(originalEmail);
+	}

+		EditText editCurrentPassword = dialogView.findViewById(R.id.edit_current_password);
+		EditText editNewPassword = dialogView.findViewById(R.id.edit_new_password);
+		EditText editConfirmNewPassword = dialogView.findViewById(R.id.edit_confirm_new_password);
+
+		AlertDialog dialog = new AlertDialog.Builder(this)
+				.setView(dialogView)
+				.setCancelable(true)
+				.create();
+
+		dialogView.findViewById(R.id.btn_cancel_password).setOnClickListener(v -> dialog.dismiss());
+
+		dialogView.findViewById(R.id.btn_update_password).setOnClickListener(v -> {
+			String currentPassword = editCurrentPassword.getText().toString().trim();

+
+		if (!newPassword.equals(confirmNewPassword)) {
+			editConfirmNewPassword.setError("Passwords do not match");
+			editConfirmNewPassword.requestFocus();
+			return false;
+		}
+
+		return true;
+	}
+

import android.appwidget.AppWidgetManager;
import android.content.Intent;
import android.content.SharedPreferences;
import android.os.Bundle;
import android.text.TextUtils;
import android.util.Patterns;
import android.view.LayoutInflater;
import android.view.View;
import android.widget.Button;
import android.widget.EditText;
import android.widget.LinearLayout;
import android.widget.RadioButton;
import android.widget.RadioGroup;
import android.widget.TextView;
import android.widget.Toast;

import androidx.activity.EdgeToEdge;
import androidx.appcompat.app.AlertDialog;
import androidx.appcompat.app.AppCompatActivity;

public class WidgetSettingsActivity extends AppCompatActivity {

	private int appWidgetId = AppWidgetManager.INVALID_APPWIDGET_ID;
	private SharedPreferences sharedPreferences;
	private TextView textUserName, textUserEmail;
	private EditText editUserName, editUserEmail;
	private Button btnEditProfile, btnSaveChanges, btnCancelEdit, btnChangePassword, btnLogout;
	private LinearLayout layoutEditButtons;
	private boolean isEditMode = false;
	private String originalName, originalEmail;

	@Override
	protected void onCreate(Bundle savedInstanceState) {
		super.onCreate(savedInstanceState);
		EdgeToEdge.enable(this);
		setContentView(R.layout.activity_widget_settings);

		BaseNavigation.wireTopNav(this, findViewById(R.id.top_nav_include));
		setupBottomNavigation();

		// Initialize SharedPreferences
		sharedPreferences = getSharedPreferences("HabitNowPrefs", MODE_PRIVATE);

		// Check authentication
		if (!isUserLoggedIn()) {
			navigateToLogin();
			return;
		}

		initializeViews();
		setupClickListeners();
		loadUserInfo();

		Intent intent = getIntent();
		Bundle extras = intent.getExtras();
		if (extras != null) {
			appWidgetId = extras.getInt(AppWidgetManager.EXTRA_APPWIDGET_ID, AppWidgetManager.INVALID_APPWIDGET_ID);
		}
	}

	private void initializeViews() {
		textUserName = findViewById(R.id.text_user_name);
		textUserEmail = findViewById(R.id.text_user_email);
		editUserName = findViewById(R.id.edit_user_name);
		editUserEmail = findViewById(R.id.edit_user_email);
		btnEditProfile = findViewById(R.id.btn_edit_profile);
		btnSaveChanges = findViewById(R.id.btn_save_changes);
		btnCancelEdit = findViewById(R.id.btn_cancel_edit);
		btnChangePassword = findViewById(R.id.btn_change_password);
		btnLogout = findViewById(R.id.btn_logout);
		layoutEditButtons = findViewById(R.id.layout_edit_buttons);
	}

	private void setupClickListeners() {
		// Widget settings save button
		findViewById(R.id.button_save).setOnClickListener(new View.OnClickListener() {
			@Override
			public void onClick(View v) {
				RadioGroup group = findViewById(R.id.group_display_mode);
				int selected = group.getCheckedRadioButtonId();
				String mode = selected == R.id.radio_percent ? "percent" : "fraction";
				getSharedPreferences(HabitProgressWidgetProvider.PREFS_NAME, MODE_PRIVATE)
					.edit()
					.putString(HabitProgressWidgetProvider.KEY_DISPLAY_MODE, mode)
					.apply();

				HabitProgressWidgetProvider.requestUpdateAll(WidgetSettingsActivity.this);

				Intent result = new Intent();
				result.putExtra(AppWidgetManager.EXTRA_APPWIDGET_ID, appWidgetId);
				setResult(RESULT_OK, result);

				Toast.makeText(WidgetSettingsActivity.this, "Widget settings saved!", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show();
			}
		});

		// Profile editing buttons
		btnEditProfile.setOnClickListener(v -> enterEditMode());
		btnSaveChanges.setOnClickListener(v -> saveProfileChanges());
		btnCancelEdit.setOnClickListener(v -> cancelEdit());
		btnChangePassword.setOnClickListener(v -> showChangePasswordDialog());
		btnLogout.setOnClickListener(v -> showLogoutDialog());
	}

	private void loadUserInfo() {
		String userName = sharedPreferences.getString("current_user_name", "User");
		String userEmail = sharedPreferences.getString("current_user_email", "user@email.com");
		boolean isGuest = sharedPreferences.getBoolean("is_guest", false);

		if (isGuest) {
			textUserName.setText("Guest User");
			textUserEmail.setText("Not logged in");
			btnLogout.setText("Login");
			btnEditProfile.setVisibility(View.GONE);
			btnChangePassword.setVisibility(View.GONE);
		} else {
			textUserName.setText(userName);
			textUserEmail.setText(userEmail);
			btnLogout.setText("Logout");
			btnEditProfile.setVisibility(View.VISIBLE);
			btnChangePassword.setVisibility(View.VISIBLE);
		}

		// Store original values
		originalName = userName;
		originalEmail = userEmail;
	}

	private void enterEditMode() {
		isEditMode = true;

		// Hide display views
		textUserName.setVisibility(View.GONE);
		textUserEmail.setVisibility(View.GONE);
		btnEditProfile.setVisibility(View.GONE);

		// Show edit views
		editUserName.setVisibility(View.VISIBLE);
		editUserEmail.setVisibility(View.VISIBLE);
		layoutEditButtons.setVisibility(View.VISIBLE);

		// Set current values
		editUserName.setText(originalName);
		editUserEmail.setText(originalEmail);

		// Focus on name field
		editUserName.requestFocus();
	}

	private void saveProfileChanges() {
		String newName = editUserName.getText().toString().trim();
		String newEmail = editUserEmail.getText().toString().trim();

		// Validate input
		if (TextUtils.isEmpty(newName)) {
			editUserName.setError("Name is required");
			editUserName.requestFocus();
			return;
		}

		if (TextUtils.isEmpty(newEmail)) {
			editUserEmail.setError("Email is required");
			editUserEmail.requestFocus();
			return;
		}

		if (!Patterns.EMAIL_ADDRESS.matcher(newEmail).matches()) {
			editUserEmail.setError("Please enter a valid email address");
			editUserEmail.requestFocus();
			return;
		}

		// Check if email is already taken (by another user)
		if (!newEmail.equals(originalEmail) && sharedPreferences.contains("user_email_" + newEmail)) {
			editUserEmail.setError("This email is already registered");
			editUserEmail.requestFocus();
			return;
		}

		// Save changes
		SharedPreferences.Editor editor = sharedPreferences.edit();

		// If email changed, update all user data keys
		if (!newEmail.equals(originalEmail)) {
			// Get current password
			String currentPassword = sharedPreferences.getString("user_password_" + originalEmail, "");

			// Remove old entries
			editor.remove("user_email_" + originalEmail);
			editor.remove("user_name_" + originalEmail);
			editor.remove("user_password_" + originalEmail);

			// Add new entries
			editor.putString("user_email_" + newEmail, newEmail);
			editor.putString("user_name_" + newEmail, newName);
			editor.putString("user_password_" + newEmail, currentPassword);
		} else {
			// Just update name
			editor.putString("user_name_" + newEmail, newName);
		}

		// Update current session
		editor.putString("current_user_name", newName);
		editor.putString("current_user_email", newEmail);

		editor.apply();

		// Update display
		originalName = newName;
		originalEmail = newEmail;
		exitEditMode();

		Toast.makeText(this, "Profile updated successfully!", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show();
	}

	private void cancelEdit() {
		exitEditMode();
	}

	private void exitEditMode() {
		isEditMode = false;

		// Show display views
		textUserName.setVisibility(View.VISIBLE);
		textUserEmail.setVisibility(View.VISIBLE);
		btnEditProfile.setVisibility(View.VISIBLE);

		// Hide edit views
		editUserName.setVisibility(View.GONE);
		editUserEmail.setVisibility(View.GONE);
		layoutEditButtons.setVisibility(View.GONE);

		// Update display with current values
		textUserName.setText(originalName);
		textUserEmail.setText(originalEmail);
	}

	private void showChangePasswordDialog() {
		View dialogView = LayoutInflater.from(this).inflate(R.layout.dialog_change_password, null);

		EditText editCurrentPassword = dialogView.findViewById(R.id.edit_current_password);
		EditText editNewPassword = dialogView.findViewById(R.id.edit_new_password);
		EditText editConfirmNewPassword = dialogView.findViewById(R.id.edit_confirm_new_password);

		AlertDialog dialog = new AlertDialog.Builder(this)
				.setView(dialogView)
				.setCancelable(true)
				.create();

		dialogView.findViewById(R.id.btn_cancel_password).setOnClickListener(v -> dialog.dismiss());

		dialogView.findViewById(R.id.btn_update_password).setOnClickListener(v -> {
			String currentPassword = editCurrentPassword.getText().toString().trim();
			String newPassword = editNewPassword.getText().toString().trim();
			String confirmNewPassword = editConfirmNewPassword.getText().toString().trim();

			if (validatePasswordChange(currentPassword, newPassword, confirmNewPassword, editCurrentPassword, editNewPassword, editConfirmNewPassword)) {
				updatePassword(newPassword);
				dialog.dismiss();
				Toast.makeText(this, "Password updated successfully!", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show();
			}
		});

		dialog.show();
	}

	private boolean validatePasswordChange(String currentPassword, String newPassword, String confirmNewPassword,
										 EditText editCurrentPassword, EditText editNewPassword, EditText editConfirmNewPassword) {
		// Check current password
		if (TextUtils.isEmpty(currentPassword)) {
			editCurrentPassword.setError("Current password is required");
			editCurrentPassword.requestFocus();
			return false;
		}

		String storedPassword = sharedPreferences.getString("user_password_" + originalEmail, "");
		if (!currentPassword.equals(storedPassword)) {
			editCurrentPassword.setError("Current password is incorrect");
			editCurrentPassword.requestFocus();
			return false;
		}

		// Check new password
		if (TextUtils.isEmpty(newPassword)) {
			editNewPassword.setError("New password is required");
			editNewPassword.requestFocus();
			return false;
		}

		if (newPassword.length() < 6) {
			editNewPassword.setError("Password must be at least 6 characters long");
			editNewPassword.requestFocus();
			return false;
		}

		// Check confirm password
		if (TextUtils.isEmpty(confirmNewPassword)) {
			editConfirmNewPassword.setError("Please confirm your new password");
			editConfirmNewPassword.requestFocus();
			return false;
		}

		if (!newPassword.equals(confirmNewPassword)) {
			editConfirmNewPassword.setError("Passwords do not match");
			editConfirmNewPassword.requestFocus();
			return false;
		}

		return true;
	}

	private void updatePassword(String newPassword) {
		SharedPreferences.Editor editor = sharedPreferences.edit();
		editor.putString("user_password_" + originalEmail, newPassword);
		editor.apply();
	}

	private void showLogoutDialog() {
		boolean isGuest = sharedPreferences.getBoolean("is_guest", false);

		if (isGuest) {
			// If guest, navigate to login
			navigateToLogin();
			return;
		}

		new AlertDialog.Builder(this)
				.setTitle("Logout")
				.setMessage("Are you sure you want to logout?")
				.setPositiveButton("Logout", (dialog, which) -> {
					logout();
				})
				.setNegativeButton("Cancel", null)
				.show();
	}

	private void logout() {
		// Clear user session
		SharedPreferences.Editor editor = sharedPreferences.edit();
		editor.remove("current_user_email");
		editor.remove("current_user_name");
		editor.putBoolean("is_logged_in", false);
		editor.remove("is_guest");
		editor.remove("remembered_email");
		editor.putBoolean("remember_me", false);
		editor.apply();

		Toast.makeText(this, "Logged out successfully", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show();

		navigateToLogin();
	}

	private boolean isUserLoggedIn() {
		return sharedPreferences.getBoolean("is_logged_in", false);
	}

	private void navigateToLogin() {
		Intent intent = new Intent(WidgetSettingsActivity.this, LoginActivity.class);
		intent.setFlags(Intent.FLAG_ACTIVITY_NEW_TASK | Intent.FLAG_ACTIVITY_CLEAR_TASK);
		startActivity(intent);
		finish();
	}

	@Override
	public void onBackPressed() {
		if (isEditMode) {
			cancelEdit();
		} else {
			super.onBackPressed();
		}
	}

	private void setupBottomNavigation() {
		// Home navigation
		findViewById(R.id.nav_home).setOnClickListener(v -> {
			Intent intent = new Intent(WidgetSettingsActivity.this, MainActivity.class);
			startActivity(intent);
		});

		// Habits navigation
		findViewById(R.id.nav_habits).setOnClickListener(v -> {
			Intent intent = new Intent(WidgetSettingsActivity.this, HabitsActivity.class);
			startActivity(intent);
		});
