		findViewById(R.id.nav_mood).setOnClickListener(v -> {

			startActivity(intent);
		});

			Intent intent = new Intent(WidgetSettingsActivity.this, HydrationActivity.class);
			startActivity(intent);
		});

		// Settings navigation (current page - do nothing)
		findViewById(R.id.nav_settings).setOnClickListener(v -> {
			// Already on settings page
		});
	}
}

import android.content.Context;
import android.content.Intent;
import android.content.SharedPreferences;

public class AuthenticationManager {

 private static final String PREF_NAME = "HabitNowAuth";
 private static final String IS_LOGGED_IN = "is_logged_in";
 private static final String CURRENT_USER_EMAIL = "current_user_email";
 private static final String CURRENT_USER_NAME = "current_user_name";

 private SharedPreferences sharedPreferences;
 private Context context;

 public AuthenticationManager(Context context) {
 this.context = context;
 this.sharedPreferences = context.getSharedPreferences(PREF_NAME, Context.MODE_PRIVATE);
 }

 public boolean isUserLoggedIn() {
 return sharedPreferences.getBoolean(IS_LOGGED_IN, false);
 }

 public String getCurrentUserEmail() {
 return sharedPreferences.getString(CURRENT_USER_EMAIL, "");
 }

 public String getCurrentUserName() {
 return sharedPreferences.getString(CURRENT_USER_NAME, "User");
 }

 public void logout() {
 SharedPreferences.Editor editor = sharedPreferences.edit();
 editor.putBoolean(IS_LOGGED_IN, false);
 editor.remove(CURRENT_USER_EMAIL);
 editor.remove(CURRENT_USER_NAME);
 editor.apply();
 }

 public void navigateToLogin() {
 Intent intent = new Intent(context, LoginActivity.class);
 intent.setFlags(Intent.FLAG_ACTIVITY_NEW_TASK | Intent.FLAG_ACTIVITY_CLEAR_TASK);
 context.startActivity(intent);
 }

 public void checkAuthenticationAndRedirect() {
 if (!isUserLoggedIn()) {
 navigateToLogin();
 }
 }
}"},{"role":"tool","name":"read_file","tool_call_id":"toolu_bdrk_01GNU89Yv3GX8x3yHCBHZmwA","content":"package com.example.habitnow;

import android.content.Intent;
import android.content.SharedPreferences;
import android.os.Bundle;
import android.text.TextUtils;
import android.util.Patterns;
import android.view.View;
import android.widget.Button;
import android.widget.CheckBox;
import android.widget.EditText;
import android.widget.ProgressBar;
import android.widget.TextView;
import android.widget.Toast;

import androidx.activity.EdgeToEdge;
import androidx.appcompat.app.AppCompatActivity;
import androidx.core.graphics.Insets;
import androidx.core.view.ViewCompat;
import androidx.core.view.WindowInsetsCompat;

public class LoginActivity extends AppCompatActivity {

 private EditText editLoginEmail, editLoginPassword;
 private CheckBox checkboxRemember;
 private Button btnLogin;
 private TextView textRegisterLink, textGuestMode;
 private ProgressBar progressLogin;
 private SharedPreferences sharedPreferences;

 @Override
 protected void onCreate(Bundle savedInstanceState) {
 super.onCreate(savedInstanceState);
 EdgeToEdge.enable(this);
 setContentView(R.layout.activity_login);

 ViewCompat.setOnApplyWindowInsetsListener(findViewById(android.R.id.content), (v, insets) -> {
 Insets systemBars = insets.getInsets(WindowInsetsCompat.Type.systemBars());
 v.setPadding(systemBars.left, systemBars.top, systemBars.right, systemBars.bottom);
 return insets;
 });

 initializeViews();
 setupClickListeners();

 // Initialize SharedPreferences
 sharedPreferences = getSharedPreferences("HabitNowPrefs", MODE_PRIVATE);

 // Check if user is already logged in
 if (isUserLoggedIn()) {
 navigateToMainActivity();
 return;
 }

 // Auto-fill email if remember me was checked
 loadRememberedCredentials();
 }

 private void initializeViews() {
 editLoginEmail = findViewById(R.id.edit_login_email);
 editLoginPassword = findViewById(R.id.edit_login_password);
 checkboxRemember = findViewById(R.id.checkbox_remember);
 btnLogin = findViewById(R.id.btn_login);
 textRegisterLink = findViewById(R.id.text_register_link);
 textGuestMode = findViewById(R.id.text_guest_mode);
 progressLogin = findViewById(R.id.progress_login);
 }

 private void setupClickListeners() {
 btnLogin.setOnClickListener(v -> handleLogin());

 textRegisterLink.setOnClickListener(v -> {
 Intent intent = new Intent(LoginActivity.this, RegisterActivity.class);
 startActivity(intent);
 finish();
 });

 textGuestMode.setOnClickListener(v -> {
 // Login as guest
 loginAsGuest();
 });
 }

 private void handleLogin() {
 String email = editLoginEmail.getText().toString().trim();
 String password = editLoginPassword.getText().toString().trim();

 // Validate input
 if (!validateInput(email, password)) {
 return;
 }

 // Show progress
 showProgress(true);

 // Simulate login process (in real app, this would be API call)
 loginUser(email, password);
 }

 private boolean validateInput(String email, String password) {
 // Check if fields are empty
 if (TextUtils.isEmpty(email)) {
 editLoginEmail.setError("Email is required");
 editLoginEmail.requestFocus();
 return false;
 }

 if (TextUtils.isEmpty(password)) {
 editLoginPassword.setError("Password is required");
 editLoginPassword.requestFocus();
 return false;
 }

 // Validate email format
 if (!Patterns.EMAIL_ADDRESS.matcher(email).matches()) {
 editLoginEmail.setError("Please enter a valid email address");
 editLoginEmail.requestFocus();
 return false;
 }

 return true;
 }

 private void loginUser(String email, String password) {
 // Simulate network delay
 new android.os.Handler().postDelayed(() -> {
 try {
 // Check if user exists
 String storedPassword = sharedPreferences.getString("user_password_" + email, null);
 String storedName = sharedPreferences.getString("user_name_" + email, null);

 if (storedPassword != null && storedPassword.equals(password)) {
 // Login successful
 SharedPreferences.Editor editor = sharedPreferences.edit();
 editor.putString("current_user_email", email);
 editor.putString("current_user_name", storedName);
 editor.putBoolean("is_logged_in", true);
 editor.putLong("last_login", System.currentTimeMillis());

 // Save remember me preference
 if (checkboxRemember.isChecked()) {
 editor.putString("remembered_email", email);
 editor.putBoolean("remember_me", true);
 } else {
 editor.remove("remembered_email");
 editor.putBoolean("remember_me", false);
 }

 editor.apply();

 showProgress(false);

 Toast.makeText(LoginActivity.this, "Welcome back, " + storedName + "!", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show();

 navigateToMainActivity();
 } else {
 // Login failed
 showProgress(false);
 Toast.makeText(LoginActivity.this, "Invalid email or password", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show();
 }

 } catch (Exception e) {
 showProgress(false);
 Toast.makeText(LoginActivity.this, "Login failed. Please try again.", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show();
 }
 }, 1500); // 1.5 second delay to simulate network call
 }

 private void loginAsGuest() {
 // Set guest mode
 SharedPreferences.Editor editor = sharedPreferences.edit();
 editor.putString("current_user_email", "guest@habitnow.com");
 editor.putString("current_user_name", "Guest User");
 editor.putBoolean("is_logged_in", true);
 editor.putBoolean("is_guest", true);
 editor.putLong("last_login", System.currentTimeMillis());
 editor.apply();

 Toast.makeText(this, "Welcome, Guest User!", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show();
 navigateToMainActivity();
 }

 private boolean isUserLoggedIn() {
 return sharedPreferences.getBoolean("is_logged_in", false);
 }

 private void loadRememberedCredentials() {
 if (sharedPreferences.getBoolean("remember_me", false)) {
 String rememberedEmail = sharedPreferences.getString("remembered_email", "");
 if (!TextUtils.isEmpty(rememberedEmail)) {
 editLoginEmail.setText(rememberedEmail);
 checkboxRemember.setChecked(true);
 editLoginPassword.requestFocus();
 }
 }
 }

 private void navigateToMainActivity() {
 Intent intent = new Intent(LoginActivity.this, MainActivity.class);
 intent.setFlags(Intent.FLAG_ACTIVITY_NEW_TASK | Intent.FLAG_ACTIVITY_CLEAR_TASK);
 startActivity(intent);
 finish();
 }

 private void showProgress(boolean show) {
 if (show) {
 progressLogin.setVisibility(View.VISIBLE);
 btnLogin.setVisibility(View.GONE);
 } else {
 progressLogin.setVisibility(View.GONE);
 btnLogin.setVisibility(View.VISIBLE);
 }
 }

 @Override
 public void onBackPressed() {
 super.onBackPressed();
 // Exit app or minimize when back is pressed on login
 moveTaskToBack(true);
 }
}"},{"role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"text","text":"Perfect! I can see that the logout functionality is already implemented in the `WidgetSettingsActivity.java` file. Looking at the code, I can see that:

 private boolean validateInput(String fullName, String email, String password, String confirmPassword) {

 editFullName.setError("Full name is required");
 editFullName.requestFocus();
 return false;
 }

 if (TextUtils.isEmpty(email)) {
 editEmail.setError("Email is required");
 editEmail.requestFocus();
 return false;
 }

 if (TextUtils.isEmpty(password)) {
 editPassword.setError("Password is required");
 editPassword.requestFocus();
 return false;
 }

 if (TextUtils.isEmpty(confirmPassword)) {
 editConfirmPassword.setError("Please confirm your password");
 editConfirmPassword.requestFocus();
 return false;
 }

 // Validate email format
 if (!Patterns.EMAIL_ADDRESS.matcher(email).matches()) {
 editEmail.setError("Please enter a valid email address");
 editEmail.requestFocus();
 return false;
 }

 // Validate password length
 if (password.length() < 6) {
 editPassword.setError("Password must be at least 6 characters long");
 editPassword.requestFocus();
 return false;
 }

 // Check if passwords match
 if (!password.equals(confirmPassword)) {
 editConfirmPassword.setError("Passwords do not match");
 editConfirmPassword.requestFocus();
 return false;
 }

	private static class IconSelectionAdapter extends RecyclerView.Adapter<IconSelectionAdapter.IconViewHolder> {
		private final List<HabitIcon> icons;
		private final IconSelectionListener listener;
		private int selectedPosition = 0;

		IconSelectionAdapter(List<HabitIcon> icons, IconSelectionListener listener) {
			this.icons = icons;
			this.listener = listener;
		}

		@NonNull
		@Override
		public IconViewHolder onCreateViewHolder(@NonNull ViewGroup parent, int viewType) {
			View view = LayoutInflater.from(parent.getContext()).inflate(R.layout.item_habit_icon, parent, false);
			return new IconViewHolder(view);
		}

		@Override
		public void onBindViewHolder(@NonNull IconViewHolder holder, int position) {
			HabitIcon icon = icons.get(position);
			holder.iconImage.setImageResource(icon.iconResId);
			holder.iconName.setText(icon.name);

			// Highlight selected item
			if (position == selectedPosition) {
				holder.itemView.setBackgroundColor(0xFFE3F2FD); // Light blue
			} else {
				holder.itemView.setBackgroundColor(0xFFFFFFFF); // White
			}

			holder.itemView.setOnClickListener(v -> {
				int oldPosition = selectedPosition;
				selectedPosition = holder.getAdapterPosition();
				notifyItemChanged(oldPosition);
				notifyItemChanged(selectedPosition);
				listener.onIconSelected(selectedPosition);
			});
		}

		@Override
		public int getItemCount() {
			return icons.size();
		}

		void setSelectedPosition(int position) {
			selectedPosition = position;
			notifyDataSetChanged();
		}

		static class IconViewHolder extends RecyclerView.ViewHolder {
			ImageView iconImage;

				iconImage = itemView.findViewById(R.id.image_icon);

 private void setupCalendar() {
 calendarView.setLayoutManager(new GridLayoutManager(this, 7));
 calendarAdapter = new CalendarAdapter(new ArrayList<>(), dayCell -> {
 selectedDate = dayCell.date;
 showDateOptionsDialog(dayCell.date);
 });
 calendarView.setAdapter(calendarAdapter);
 bindMonth();
 }

 private void bindMonth() {
		TextView monthTitle = findViewById(R.id.text_month);
		SimpleDateFormat sdf = new SimpleDateFormat("MMMM yyyy");
		monthTitle.setText(sdf.format(currentMonth.getTime()));

		java.util.Calendar cal = (java.util.Calendar) currentMonth.clone();
		cal.set(java.util.Calendar.DAY_OF_MONTH, 1);

		// Get the day of week for the first day (Sunday = 1, Monday = 2, etc.)
		int firstDayOfWeek = cal.get(java.util.Calendar.DAY_OF_WEEK);
		int daysInMonth = cal.getActualMaximum(java.util.Calendar.DAY_OF_MONTH);

		List<DayCell> cells = new ArrayList<>();

		// Add empty cells for days before the first day of the month
		for (int i = 1; i < firstDayOfWeek; i++) {
			cells.add(DayCell.empty());
		}

		// Add all days of the month
		for (int day = 1; day <= daysInMonth; day++) {
			cal.set(java.util.Calendar.DAY_OF_MONTH, day);
			cells.add(DayCell.of(cal.getTime()));
		}

		// Add empty cells to fill the grid (6 rows × 7 columns = 42 cells total)
		while (cells.size() < 42) {
			cells.add(DayCell.empty());
		}

		// Debug: Log the number of cells created
		android.util.Log.d("HabitsActivity", "Created " + cells.size() + " calendar cells for " + daysInMonth + " days");

		calendarAdapter.submit(cells, mapDateToHabitCount());
	}

	private Map<String, String> mapDateToHabitCount() {
		SimpleDateFormat keyFmt = new SimpleDateFormat("yyyy-MM-dd");
		Map<String, String> map = new HashMap<>();

		// Group habits by date and count completed ones
		Map<String, Integer> totalHabits = new HashMap<>();
		Map<String, Integer> completedHabits = new HashMap<>();

		for (Habit habit : habits) {
			String dateKey = keyFmt.format(habit.date);
			totalHabits.put(dateKey, totalHabits.getOrDefault(dateKey, 0) + 1);
			if (habit.completed) {
				completedHabits.put(dateKey, completedHabits.getOrDefault(dateKey, 0) + 1);
			}
		}

		// Create display text showing completion ratio
		for (String dateKey : totalHabits.keySet()) {
			int total = totalHabits.get(dateKey);
			int completed = completedHabits.getOrDefault(dateKey, 0);
			if (total > 0) {
				map.put(dateKey, completed + "/" + total);
			}
		}

		return map;
	}

	private void refreshListForFilter() {
		android.util.Log.d("HabitsActivity", "refreshListForFilter called, total habits: " + habits.size());

		if (filterDayCheck != null && filterDayCheck.isChecked()) {
			SimpleDateFormat keyFmt = new SimpleDateFormat("yyyy-MM-dd");
			String selKey = keyFmt.format(selectedDate != null ? selectedDate : new Date());
			android.util.Log.d("HabitsActivity", "Filtering for selected day: " + selKey);

			List<Habit> filtered = new ArrayList<>();
			for (Habit habit : habits) {
				String habitDateKey = keyFmt.format(habit.date);
				android.util.Log.d("HabitsActivity", "Habit '" + habit.name + "' date: " + habitDateKey);
				if (habitDateKey.equals(selKey)) {
					filtered.add(habit);
				}
			}
			android.util.Log.d("HabitsActivity", "Filtered habits count: " + filtered.size());
			adapter.setItems(filtered);
		} else {
			android.util.Log.d("HabitsActivity", "Showing all habits: " + habits.size());
			adapter.setItems(new ArrayList<>(habits));
		}
		updateProgress();
	}

	private void seedSampleData() {
		Date today = new Date();
		habits.add(new Habit("Drink water", R.drawable.ic_water, today));
		habits.add(new Habit("Meditate", R.drawable.ic_meditation, today));
		habits.add(new Habit("Exercise", R.drawable.ic_exercise, today));
		adapter.notifyDataSetChanged();
	}

	private void updateProgress() {
		List<Habit> currentHabits = adapter.getCurrentItems();
		int total = currentHabits.size();
		int completed = 0;
		for (Habit h : currentHabits) {
			if (h.completed) completed++;
		}
		int percent = total == 0 ? 0 : (int) ((completed * 100f) / total);
		progressBar.setMax(100);
		progressBar.setProgress(percent);
		progressText.setText(completed + "/" + total + " done today");

		getSharedPreferences(HabitProgressWidgetProvider.PREFS_NAME, MODE_PRIVATE)
				.edit()
				.putInt(HabitProgressWidgetProvider.KEY_COMPLETED, completed)
				.putInt(HabitProgressWidgetProvider.KEY_TOTAL, total)
				.apply();
		HabitProgressWidgetProvider.requestUpdateAll(this);
	}

				.setView(dialogView)

					String name = input.getText().toString().trim();
					if (!name.isEmpty()) {
						Date targetDate = selectedDate != null ? selectedDate : new Date();
						habits.add(new Habit(name, icons.get(selectedIconIndex[0]).iconResId, targetDate));
						refreshListForFilter();
						calendarAdapter.updateHabits(mapDateToHabitCount());
					}
				})
				.setNegativeButton("Cancel", null)
				.show();
	}

	private void showEditDeleteDialog(final int position) {
		String[] options = new String[]{"Edit", "Delete"};
		new AlertDialog.Builder(this)
				.setItems(options, (d, which) -> {
					if (which == 0) {
						showEditHabitDialog(position);
					} else {
						List<Habit> currentHabits = adapter.getCurrentItems();
						if (position < currentHabits.size()) {
							Habit habitToRemove = currentHabits.get(position);
							habits.remove(habitToRemove);
							refreshListForFilter();
							calendarAdapter.updateHabits(mapDateToHabitCount());
						}
					}
				})
				.show();
	}

	private void showEditHabitDialog(final int position) {
		View dialogView = LayoutInflater.from(this).inflate(R.layout.dialog_habit, null, false);
		EditText input = dialogView.findViewById(R.id.input_habit_name);
		TextView dateText = dialogView.findViewById(R.id.text_selected_date);
		ImageView selectedIconView = dialogView.findViewById(R.id.image_selected_icon);
		TextView iconNameText = dialogView.findViewById(R.id.text_icon_name);
		RecyclerView iconRecycler = dialogView.findViewById(R.id.recycler_icons);

		List<HabitIcon> icons = getAvailableIcons();
		List<Habit> currentHabits = adapter.getCurrentItems();

		if (position < currentHabits.size()) {
			Habit habit = currentHabits.get(position);
			input.setText(habit.name);

			// Set date
			SimpleDateFormat sdf = new SimpleDateFormat("MMM dd, yyyy");
			dateText.setText(sdf.format(habit.date));

			// Find current icon index
			final int[] selectedIconIndex = {0};
			for (int i = 0; i < icons.size(); i++) {
				if (icons.get(i).iconResId == habit.iconResId) {
					selectedIconIndex[0] = i;
					break;
				}
			}

			// Setup icon selection
			IconSelectionAdapter iconAdapter = new IconSelectionAdapter(icons, index -> {
				selectedIconIndex[0] = index;
				selectedIconView.setImageResource(icons.get(index).iconResId);
				iconNameText.setText(icons.get(index).name);
			});

			iconRecycler.setLayoutManager(new LinearLayoutManager(this, LinearLayoutManager.HORIZONTAL, false));
			iconRecycler.setAdapter(iconAdapter);
			iconAdapter.setSelectedPosition(selectedIconIndex[0]);

			// Set current icon
			selectedIconView.setImageResource(icons.get(selectedIconIndex[0]).iconResId);
			iconNameText.setText(icons.get(selectedIconIndex[0]).name);

			new AlertDialog.Builder(this)
					.setTitle("Edit Habit")
					.setView(dialogView)
					.setPositiveButton("Save", (d, w) -> {
						String name = input.getText().toString().trim();
						if (!name.isEmpty()) {
							habit.name = name;
							habit.iconResId = icons.get(selectedIconIndex[0]).iconResId;
							adapter.notifyItemChanged(position);
						}
					})
					.setNegativeButton("Cancel", null)
					.show();
		}
	}

	private List<HabitIcon> getAvailableIcons() {
		List<HabitIcon> icons = new ArrayList<>();
		icons.add(new HabitIcon(R.drawable.ic_water, "Water"));
		icons.add(new HabitIcon(R.drawable.ic_exercise, "Exercise"));
		icons.add(new HabitIcon(R.drawable.ic_meditation, "Meditation"));
		icons.add(new HabitIcon(R.drawable.ic_reading, "Reading"));
		icons.add(new HabitIcon(R.drawable.ic_sleep, "Sleep"));
		icons.add(new HabitIcon(R.drawable.ic_food, "Healthy Food"));
		icons.add(new HabitIcon(R.drawable.watern, "Hydration"));
		icons.add(new HabitIcon(R.drawable.habitn, "General Habit"));
		icons.add(new HabitIcon(R.drawable.moodn, "Mood"));
		icons.add(new HabitIcon(R.drawable.settings, "Settings"));
		return icons;
	}

 private void showDateOptionsDialog(Date date) {

 new AlertDialog.Builder(this)

 // ────────── Data classes ──────────

	private static class HabitIcon {
		int iconResId;
		String name;

		HabitIcon(int iconResId, String name) {
			this.iconResId = iconResId;
			this.name = name;
		}
	}

	private static class Habit {
		String name;
		int iconResId;
		boolean completed;
		Date date;

		Habit(String name, int iconResId, Date date) {
			this.name = name;
			this.iconResId = iconResId;
			this.completed = false;
			this.date = date;
		}
	}

	private static class DayCell {
		boolean isInvalid;
		boolean isEmpty;
		Date date;
		int dayNumber;

		static DayCell of(Date date) {
			DayCell d = new DayCell();
			d.isInvalid = false;
			d.isEmpty = false;
			d.date = date;
			java.util.Calendar c = java.util.Calendar.getInstance();
			c.setTime(date);
			d.dayNumber = c.get(java.util.Calendar.DAY_OF_MONTH);
			return d;
		}

		static DayCell empty() {
			DayCell d = new DayCell();
			d.isInvalid = true;
			d.isEmpty = true;
			d.dayNumber = 0;
			return d;
		}

		static DayCell invalid(int dayNumber) {
			DayCell d = new DayCell();
			d.isInvalid = true;
			d.isEmpty = false;
			d.dayNumber = dayNumber;
			return d;
		}
	}

	private interface DayClickListener {
		void onDayClick(DayCell dayCell);
	}

	private static class CalendarAdapter extends RecyclerView.Adapter<CalendarAdapter.DayViewHolder> {
		private final List<DayCell> cells;
		private final DayClickListener listener;
		private Map<String, String> dateToHabitCount = new HashMap<>();

		CalendarAdapter(List<DayCell> cells, DayClickListener listener) {
			this.cells = cells;
			this.listener = listener;
		}

		void submit(List<DayCell> newCells, Map<String, String> dateToHabitCount) {
			this.cells.clear();
			this.cells.addAll(newCells);
			this.dateToHabitCount = dateToHabitCount;
			notifyDataSetChanged();
		}

		void updateHabits(Map<String, String> dateToHabitCount) {
			this.dateToHabitCount = dateToHabitCount;
			notifyDataSetChanged();
		}

		@NonNull
		@Override
		public DayViewHolder onCreateViewHolder(@NonNull ViewGroup parent, int viewType) {
			View v = LayoutInflater.from(parent.getContext())
					.inflate(R.layout.item_calendar_day, parent, false);
			return new DayViewHolder(v);
		}

		@Override
		public void onBindViewHolder(@NonNull DayViewHolder holder, int position) {
			DayCell cell = cells.get(position);

			// Always set some text to make sure TextView is working
			if (cell.isEmpty) {
				holder.day.setText("");
				holder.emoji.setText("");
				holder.day.setAlpha(0.3f);
				holder.itemView.setOnClickListener(null);
			} else {
				// Show the day number - this should always work
				holder.day.setText(String.valueOf(cell.dayNumber));
				holder.day.setAlpha(1.0f);

				// Add habit count if available
				if (!cell.isInvalid && cell.date != null) {
					SimpleDateFormat keyFmt = new SimpleDateFormat("yyyy-MM-dd");
					String key = keyFmt.format(cell.date);
					holder.emoji.setText(dateToHabitCount.getOrDefault(key, ""));

					// Make it clickable
					holder.itemView.setOnClickListener(v -> {
						android.util.Log.d("CalendarAdapter", "Day clicked: " + cell.dayNumber);
						listener.onDayClick(cell);
					});

					// Highlight if selected
					try {
						String sel = keyFmt.format(((HabitsActivity) holder.itemView.getContext()).selectedDate);
						String cur = keyFmt.format(cell.date);
						if (sel.equals(cur)) {
							holder.itemView.setBackgroundColor(0xFFE0E0E0); // Light gray background
						} else {
							holder.itemView.setBackgroundColor(0xFFFFFFFF); // White background
						}
					} catch (Exception e) {
						holder.itemView.setBackgroundColor(0xFFFFFFFF);
					}
				} else {
					holder.emoji.setText("");
					holder.itemView.setOnClickListener(null);
					holder.itemView.setBackgroundColor(0xFFFFFFFF);
				}
			}

			// Debug log
			android.util.Log.d("CalendarAdapter", "Set day " + position + " to: '" + holder.day.getText() + "'");
		}

		@Override
		public int getItemCount() {
			return cells.size();
		}

		static class DayViewHolder extends RecyclerView.ViewHolder {
			TextView day;
			TextView emoji;

			DayViewHolder(@NonNull View itemView) {
				super(itemView);
				day = itemView.findViewById(R.id.text_day);
				emoji = itemView.findViewById(R.id.text_day_emoji);
			}
		}
	}

	private interface HabitListener {
		void onHabitToggled();

		void onHabitLongPressed(int position);
	}

	private static class HabitsAdapter extends RecyclerView.Adapter<HabitsAdapter.HabitViewHolder> {

		private List<Habit> habits;
		private final HabitListener listener;

		HabitsAdapter(List<Habit> habits, HabitListener listener) {
			this.habits = habits;
			this.listener = listener;
		}

		void setItems(List<Habit> newItems) {
			this.habits = newItems;
			notifyDataSetChanged();
		}

		List<Habit> getCurrentItems() {
			return habits;
		}

		@NonNull
		@Override
		public HabitViewHolder onCreateViewHolder(@NonNull ViewGroup parent, int viewType) {
			View view = LayoutInflater.from(parent.getContext()).inflate(R.layout.item_habit, parent, false);
			return new HabitViewHolder(view);
		}

		@Override
		public void onBindViewHolder(@NonNull HabitViewHolder holder, int position) {
			Habit habit = habits.get(position);
			android.util.Log.d("HabitsAdapter", "Binding habit " + position + ": " + habit.name);
			holder.name.setText(habit.name);
			holder.icon.setImageResource(habit.iconResId);
			holder.check.setChecked(habit.completed);
			holder.check.setOnCheckedChangeListener((buttonView, isChecked) -> {
				habit.completed = isChecked;
				listener.onHabitToggled();
			});
			holder.itemView.setOnLongClickListener(v -> {
				listener.onHabitLongPressed(holder.getAdapterPosition());
				return true;
			});
		}

		@Override
		public int getItemCount() {
			android.util.Log.d("HabitsAdapter", "getItemCount: " + habits.size());
			return habits.size();
		}

		static class HabitViewHolder extends RecyclerView.ViewHolder {
			TextView name;
			ImageView icon;
			android.widget.CheckBox check;

			HabitViewHolder(@NonNull View itemView) {
				super(itemView);
				name = itemView.findViewById(R.id.text_habit_name);
				icon = itemView.findViewById(R.id.image_habit_icon);
				check = itemView.findViewById(R.id.checkbox_habit);
			}
		}
	}
}

public class MoodJournalActivity extends AppCompatActivity {

	private final List<MoodEntry> entries = new ArrayList<>();
	private MoodAdapter adapter;

	private RecyclerView calendarView;
	private CalendarAdapter calendarAdapter;
	private java.util.Calendar currentMonth = java.util.Calendar.getInstance();
	private Date selectedDate = new Date();
	private CheckBox filterDayCheck;

	// Emoji selection interface and adapter
	private interface EmojiSelectionListener {
		void onEmojiSelected(int index);
	}

	private static class EmojiSelectionAdapter extends RecyclerView.Adapter<EmojiSelectionAdapter.EmojiViewHolder> {
		private final List<MoodEmoji> emojis;
		private final EmojiSelectionListener listener;
		private int selectedPosition = 0;

		EmojiSelectionAdapter(List<MoodEmoji> emojis, EmojiSelectionListener listener) {
			this.emojis = emojis;
			this.listener = listener;
		}

		@NonNull
		@Override

			return new EmojiViewHolder(view);

		@Override
		public void onBindViewHolder(@NonNull EmojiViewHolder holder, int position) {
			MoodEmoji emoji = emojis.get(position);
			holder.emojiText.setText(emoji.emoji);
			holder.emojiName.setText(emoji.name);

			// Highlight selected item
			if (position == selectedPosition) {
				holder.itemView.setBackgroundColor(0xFFE3F2FD); // Light blue
			} else {
				holder.itemView.setBackgroundColor(0xFFFFFFFF); // White
			}

			holder.itemView.setOnClickListener(v -> {
				int oldPosition = selectedPosition;
				selectedPosition = holder.getAdapterPosition();
				notifyItemChanged(oldPosition);
				notifyItemChanged(selectedPosition);
				listener.onEmojiSelected(selectedPosition);
			});
		}

		@Override
		public int getItemCount() {
			return emojis.size();
		}

		void setSelectedPosition(int position) {
			selectedPosition = position;
			notifyDataSetChanged();
		}

		static class EmojiViewHolder extends RecyclerView.ViewHolder {
			TextView emojiText;
			TextView emojiName;

			EmojiViewHolder(@NonNull View itemView) {
				super(itemView);
				emojiText = itemView.findViewById(R.id.text_emoji);
				emojiName = itemView.findViewById(R.id.text_emoji_name);
			}
		}
	}

	private static class MoodEmoji {
		String emoji;
		String name;

		MoodEmoji(String emoji, String name) {
			this.emoji = emoji;
			this.name = name;
		}
	}

	@Override
	protected void onCreate(Bundle savedInstanceState) {
		super.onCreate(savedInstanceState);
		EdgeToEdge.enable(this);
		setContentView(R.layout.activity_mood_journal);

		ViewCompat.setOnApplyWindowInsetsListener(findViewById(R.id.mood_root), (v, insets) -> {
			Insets systemBars = insets.getInsets(WindowInsetsCompat.Type.systemBars());
			v.setPadding(systemBars.left, systemBars.top, systemBars.right, systemBars.bottom);

		});

		// Mood list
		RecyclerView recyclerView = findViewById(R.id.recycler_moods);
		recyclerView.setLayoutManager(new LinearLayoutManager(this));
		adapter = new MoodAdapter(entries, new MoodListener() {
			@Override
			public void onEdit(int position) {
				showMoodDialog(position);
			}

			@Override
			public void onDelete(int position) {
				entries.remove(position);
				adapter.notifyItemRemoved(position);
				calendarAdapter.updateEmojis(mapDateToEmoji());
			}
		});
		recyclerView.setAdapter(adapter);

		// Calendar setup
		calendarView = findViewById(R.id.recycler_calendar);
		setupCalendar();

		filterDayCheck = findViewById(R.id.checkbox_filter_day);
		if (filterDayCheck != null) {
			filterDayCheck.setOnCheckedChangeListener((buttonView, isChecked) -> refreshListForFilter());
		}

		// FAB for adding moods
		FloatingActionButton fab = findViewById(R.id.fab_log_mood);

		BaseNavigation.wireTopNav(this, findViewById(R.id.top_nav_include));

	private List<MoodEmoji> getAvailableMoods() {
		List<MoodEmoji> moods = new ArrayList<>();
		moods.add(new MoodEmoji("", "Happy"));
		moods.add(new MoodEmoji("", "Love"));
		moods.add(new MoodEmoji("", "Cool"));
		moods.add(new MoodEmoji("", "Excited"));
		moods.add(new MoodEmoji("", "Calm"));
		moods.add(new MoodEmoji("", "Content"));
		moods.add(new MoodEmoji("", "Neutral"));
		moods.add(new MoodEmoji("", "Sad"));
		moods.add(new MoodEmoji("", "Worried"));
		moods.add(new MoodEmoji("", "Frustrated"));
		moods.add(new MoodEmoji("", "Tired"));
		moods.add(new MoodEmoji("", "Sick"));

	private void showMoodDialog(final int editPosition) {
		View dialogView = LayoutInflater.from(this).inflate(R.layout.dialog_mood_entry, null, false);
		TextView dateText = dialogView.findViewById(R.id.text_selected_date);
		TextView selectedEmojiView = dialogView.findViewById(R.id.text_selected_emoji);
		TextView emojiNameText = dialogView.findViewById(R.id.text_emoji_name);
		RecyclerView emojiRecycler = dialogView.findViewById(R.id.recycler_emojis);
		EditText inputNote = dialogView.findViewById(R.id.input_note);

		// Set selected date
		SimpleDateFormat sdf = new SimpleDateFormat("MMM dd, yyyy");
		dateText.setText(sdf.format(selectedDate != null ? selectedDate : new Date()));

		// Setup emoji selection
		List<MoodEmoji> emojis = getAvailableMoods();
		final int[] selectedEmojiIndex = {0}; // Use array to make it effectively final

		EmojiSelectionAdapter emojiAdapter = new EmojiSelectionAdapter(emojis, index -> {
			selectedEmojiIndex[0] = index;
			selectedEmojiView.setText(emojis.get(index).emoji);
			emojiNameText.setText(emojis.get(index).name);
		});

		emojiRecycler.setLayoutManager(new LinearLayoutManager(this, LinearLayoutManager.HORIZONTAL, false));
		emojiRecycler.setAdapter(emojiAdapter);

		// Set default emoji or existing emoji for edit
		if (editPosition >= 0) {
			MoodEntry e = entries.get(editPosition);
			inputNote.setText(e.note);

			// Find current emoji index
			for (int i = 0; i < emojis.size(); i++) {
				if (emojis.get(i).emoji.equals(e.emoji)) {
					selectedEmojiIndex[0] = i;
					emojiAdapter.setSelectedPosition(i);
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		// Set initial emoji display
		selectedEmojiView.setText(emojis.get(selectedEmojiIndex[0]).emoji);
		emojiNameText.setText(emojis.get(selectedEmojiIndex[0]).name);

		new AlertDialog.Builder(this)
				.setTitle(editPosition >= 0 ? "Edit Mood" : "Log Mood")
				.setView(dialogView)
				.setPositiveButton(editPosition >= 0 ? "Save" : "Log", (d, w) -> {
					String emoji = emojis.get(selectedEmojiIndex[0]).emoji;
					String note = inputNote.getText().toString().trim();

					if (editPosition >= 0) {
						MoodEntry e = entries.get(editPosition);
						e.emoji = emoji;
						e.note = note;
					} else {
						Date now = selectedDate != null ? selectedDate : new Date();
						entries.add(0, new MoodEntry(now, emoji, note));
					}

					refreshListForFilter();
					calendarAdapter.updateEmojis(mapDateToEmoji());
				})
				.setNegativeButton("Cancel", null)
				.show();
	}

	private void bindMonth() {
		TextView monthTitle = findViewById(R.id.text_month);
		SimpleDateFormat sdf = new SimpleDateFormat("MMMM yyyy");
		monthTitle.setText(sdf.format(currentMonth.getTime()));

		java.util.Calendar cal = (java.util.Calendar) currentMonth.clone();
		cal.set(java.util.Calendar.DAY_OF_MONTH, 1);

		// Get the day of week for the first day (Sunday = 1, Monday = 2, etc.)
		int firstDayOfWeek = cal.get(java.util.Calendar.DAY_OF_WEEK);
		int daysInMonth = cal.getActualMaximum(java.util.Calendar.DAY_OF_MONTH);

		List<DayCell> cells = new ArrayList<>();

		// Add empty cells for days before the first day of the month
		for (int i = 1; i < firstDayOfWeek; i++) {
			cells.add(DayCell.empty());
		}

		// Add all days of the month
		for (int day = 1; day <= daysInMonth; day++) {
			cal.set(java.util.Calendar.DAY_OF_MONTH, day);
			cells.add(DayCell.of(cal.getTime()));
		}

		// Add empty cells to fill the grid (6 rows × 7 columns = 42 cells total)
		while (cells.size() < 42) {
			cells.add(DayCell.empty());
		}

		calendarAdapter.submit(cells, mapDateToEmoji());
	}

	private Map<String, String> mapDateToEmoji() {
		SimpleDateFormat keyFmt = new SimpleDateFormat("yyyy-MM-dd");
		Map<String, String> map = new HashMap<>();
		for (MoodEntry e : entries) {
			map.put(keyFmt.format(e.timestamp), e.emoji);
		}
		return map;
	}

	// ✅ FIX: refreshListForFilter now lives in the Activity
	private void refreshListForFilter() {
		if (filterDayCheck != null && filterDayCheck.isChecked()) {
			SimpleDateFormat keyFmt = new SimpleDateFormat("yyyy-MM-dd");
			String selKey = keyFmt.format(selectedDate != null ? selectedDate : new Date());
			List<MoodEntry> filtered = new ArrayList<>();
			for (MoodEntry e : entries) {
				if (keyFmt.format(e.timestamp).equals(selKey)) {
					filtered.add(e);
				}
			}
			adapter.setItems(filtered);
		} else {
			adapter.setItems(new ArrayList<>(entries));
		}
	}

	private void setupCalendar() {
		calendarView.setLayoutManager(new GridLayoutManager(this, 7));
		calendarAdapter = new CalendarAdapter(new ArrayList<>(), dayCell -> {
			selectedDate = dayCell.date;
			showDateOptionsDialog(dayCell.date);
		});
		calendarView.setAdapter(calendarAdapter);

		bindMonth();
	}

	private void showDateOptionsDialog(Date date) {
		SimpleDateFormat sdf = new SimpleDateFormat("MMM dd, yyyy");
		String dateStr = sdf.format(date);

		String[] options = {"Log Mood for " + dateStr, "View Moods for " + dateStr};
		new AlertDialog.Builder(this)
				.setTitle("Date: " + dateStr)
				.setItems(options, (dialog, which) -> {
					if (which == 0) {
						showMoodDialog(-1);
					} else {
						filterDayCheck.setChecked(true);
						refreshListForFilter();
					}
				})
				.setNegativeButton("Cancel", (dialog, which) -> refreshListForFilter())
				.show();
	}

	// ────────── Data classes ──────────

	private static class MoodEntry {
		Date timestamp;
		String emoji;
		String note;

		MoodEntry(Date timestamp, String emoji, String note) {
			this.timestamp = timestamp;

		@Override

				holder.emoji.setText(dateToEmoji.getOrDefault(key, ""));

			try {
				java.text.SimpleDateFormat keyFmt = new java.text.SimpleDateFormat("yyyy-MM-dd");
				String sel = keyFmt.format(((MoodJournalActivity) holder.itemView.getContext()).selectedDate);
				String cur = cell.date != null ? keyFmt.format(cell.date) : "";
				if (!cell.isEmpty && !cell.isInvalid && sel.equals(cur)) {
					holder.day.setBackgroundResource(R.drawable.bg_day_selected);

public class HydrationActivity extends AppCompatActivity {

 private List<WaterIntake> todayIntakes = new ArrayList<>();

 super.onCreate(savedInstanceState);
 EdgeToEdge.enable(this);
 setContentView(R.layout.activity_hydration);
 ViewCompat.setOnApplyWindowInsetsListener(findViewById(R.id.hydration_root), (v, insets) -> {
 Insets systemBars = insets.getInsets(WindowInsetsCompat.Type.systemBars());
 v.setPadding(systemBars.left, systemBars.top, systemBars.right, systemBars.bottom);
 return insets;
 });

 initializeViews();
 setupSpinners();
 setupVolumeButtons();
 setupCalendar();
 setupIntakeHistory();
 loadTodayData();
 updateProgress();

 BaseNavigation.wireTopNav(this, findViewById(R.id.top_nav_include));
 setupBottomNavigation();

 calendarView = findViewById(R.id.recycler_calendar);
 intakeHistoryRecycler = findViewById(R.id.recycler_intake_history);
 }

 private void setupSpinners() {
 // Daily goal spinner
 String[] goals = {"1500 ml", "2000 ml", "2500 ml", "3000 ml", "3500 ml"};
 ArrayAdapter<String> goalAdapter = new ArrayAdapter<>(this, android.R.layout.simple_spinner_item, goals);
 goalAdapter.setDropDownViewResource(android.R.layout.simple_spinner_dropdown_item);
 dailyGoalSpinner.setAdapter(goalAdapter);
 dailyGoalSpinner.setSelection(1); // Default to 2000ml

 dailyGoalSpinner.setOnItemSelectedListener(new android.widget.AdapterView.OnItemSelectedListener() {
 @Override
 public void onItemSelected(android.widget.AdapterView<?> parent, View view, int position, long id) {
 switch (position) {
 case 0:
 dailyGoalMl = 1500;
 break;
 case 1:
 dailyGoalMl = 2000;
 break;
 case 2:
 dailyGoalMl = 2500;
 break;
 case 3:
 dailyGoalMl = 3000;
 break;
 case 4:
 dailyGoalMl = 3500;
 break;
 }
 updateProgress();
 }

 public void onNothingSelected(android.widget.AdapterView<?> parent) {
 }
 });

 private void setupVolumeButtons() {

 }

 private void setupCalendar() {
 calendarView.setLayoutManager(new GridLayoutManager(this, 7));
 calendarAdapter = new CalendarAdapter(new ArrayList<>(), dayCell -> {
 selectedDate = dayCell.date;
 loadSelectedDateData();
 });
 calendarView.setAdapter(calendarAdapter);

 bindMonth();
 }

 private void setupIntakeHistory() {
 historyAdapter = new IntakeHistoryAdapter(todayIntakes, position -> {
 // Delete intake
 if (position < todayIntakes.size()) {
 todayIntakes.remove(position);
 saveTodayData();
 historyAdapter.notifyItemRemoved(position);
 updateProgress();
 calendarAdapter.updateIntakes(mapDateToIntake());
 }
 });
 intakeHistoryRecycler.setLayoutManager(new LinearLayoutManager(this));
 intakeHistoryRecycler.setAdapter(historyAdapter);
 }

 private void addWaterIntake(int volumeMl) {
 WaterIntake intake = new WaterIntake(volumeMl, new Date());
 todayIntakes.add(0, intake);
 saveTodayData();
 historyAdapter.notifyItemInserted(0);
 updateProgress();
 calendarAdapter.updateIntakes(mapDateToIntake());
 }

 private void bindMonth() {
 TextView monthTitle = findViewById(R.id.text_month);
 SimpleDateFormat sdf = new SimpleDateFormat("MMMM yyyy");
 monthTitle.setText(sdf.format(currentMonth.getTime()));

 java.util.Calendar cal = (java.util.Calendar) currentMonth.clone();
 cal.set(java.util.Calendar.DAY_OF_MONTH, 1);

 int firstDayOfWeek = cal.get(java.util.Calendar.DAY_OF_WEEK);
 int daysInMonth = cal.getActualMaximum(java.util.Calendar.DAY_OF_MONTH);

 List<DayCell> cells = new ArrayList<>();

 // Add empty cells for proper alignment
 for (int i = 1; i < firstDayOfWeek; i++) {
 cells.add(DayCell.empty());
 }

 // Add all days of the month
 for (int day = 1; day <= daysInMonth; day++) {
 cal.set(java.util.Calendar.DAY_OF_MONTH, day);
 cells.add(DayCell.of(cal.getTime()));
 }

 // Fill to 42 cells (6 rows × 7 columns)
 while (cells.size() < 42) {
 cells.add(DayCell.empty());
 }

 calendarAdapter.submit(cells, mapDateToIntake());
 }

 private Map<String, String> mapDateToIntake() {
 SimpleDateFormat keyFmt = new SimpleDateFormat("yyyy-MM-dd");
 Map<String, String> map = new HashMap<>();

 for (String dateKey : dailyIntakes.keySet()) {
 List<WaterIntake> intakes = dailyIntakes.get(dateKey);
 if (intakes != null && !intakes.isEmpty()) {
 int totalMl = 0;
 for (WaterIntake intake : intakes) {
 totalMl += intake.volumeMl;
 }
 int percentage = (int) ((totalMl * 100f) / dailyGoalMl);
 map.put(dateKey, percentage + "%");
 }
 }

 return map;
 }

 private void loadTodayData() {
 SimpleDateFormat keyFmt = new SimpleDateFormat("yyyy-MM-dd");
 String todayKey = keyFmt.format(new Date());

 if (dailyIntakes.containsKey(todayKey)) {
 todayIntakes = dailyIntakes.get(todayKey);
 } else {
 todayIntakes = new ArrayList<>();
 dailyIntakes.put(todayKey, todayIntakes);
 }

 historyAdapter.updateItems(todayIntakes);
 }

 private void loadSelectedDateData() {
 SimpleDateFormat keyFmt = new SimpleDateFormat("yyyy-MM-dd");
 String selectedKey = keyFmt.format(selectedDate);

 List<WaterIntake> selectedIntakes = dailyIntakes.getOrDefault(selectedKey, new ArrayList<>());
 historyAdapter.updateItems(selectedIntakes);

 // Update progress for selected date
 int totalMl = 0;
 for (WaterIntake intake : selectedIntakes) {
 totalMl += intake.volumeMl;
 }

 int percentage = (int) ((totalMl * 100f) / dailyGoalMl);
 intakeAmountText.setText(totalMl + " ml / " + dailyGoalMl + " ml");
 percentageText.setText(percentage + "%");
 progressBar.setProgress(percentage);
 }

 private void saveTodayData() {
 SimpleDateFormat keyFmt = new SimpleDateFormat("yyyy-MM-dd");
 String todayKey = keyFmt.format(new Date());
 dailyIntakes.put(todayKey, new ArrayList<>(todayIntakes));
 }

 private void updateProgress() {
 int totalMl = 0;
 for (WaterIntake intake : todayIntakes) {
 totalMl += intake.volumeMl;
 }

 int percentage = Math.min(100, (int) ((totalMl * 100f) / dailyGoalMl));

 intakeAmountText.setText(totalMl + " ml / " + dailyGoalMl + " ml");
 percentageText.setText(percentage + "%");
 progressBar.setProgress(percentage);
 }

 private void loadTodaysMood() {
 SharedPreferences prefs = getSharedPreferences("mood_data", MODE_PRIVATE);
 SimpleDateFormat dateFormat = new SimpleDateFormat("yyyy-MM-dd");
 String todayKey = dateFormat.format(new Date());

 String todayMood = prefs.getString(todayKey + "_emoji", "");
 String todayMoodName = prefs.getString(todayKey + "_name", "");

 if (todayMood.isEmpty()) {
 // Show default mood if none logged today
 moodEmojiText.setText("");
 moodNameText.setText("Not set");
 } else {
 moodEmojiText.setText(todayMood);
 moodNameText.setText(todayMoodName);
 }
 }

 private void loadTodaysHydration() {
 SharedPreferences prefs = getSharedPreferences("hydration_data", MODE_PRIVATE);
 SimpleDateFormat dateFormat = new SimpleDateFormat("yyyy-MM-dd");
 String todayKey = dateFormat.format(new Date());

 int todayIntake = prefs.getInt(todayKey + "_intake", 0);
 int dailyGoal = prefs.getInt("daily_goal", 2000);

 int percentage = Math.min(100, (int) ((todayIntake * 100f) / dailyGoal));

 if (todayIntake == 0) {
 hydrationPercentageText.setText("0%");
 hydrationAmountText.setText("0 ml / " + dailyGoal + " ml");
 hydrationProgressBar.setProgress(0);
 } else {
 hydrationPercentageText.setText(percentage + "%");
 hydrationAmountText.setText(todayIntake + " ml / " + dailyGoal + " ml");
 hydrationProgressBar.setProgress(percentage);
 }
 }

 private void loadTodaysHabits() {
 SharedPreferences prefs = getSharedPreferences("habits_data", MODE_PRIVATE);
 SimpleDateFormat dateFormat = new SimpleDateFormat("yyyy-MM-dd");
 String todayKey = dateFormat.format(new Date());

 int completedHabits = prefs.getInt(todayKey + "_completed", 0);
 int totalHabits = prefs.getInt(todayKey + "_total", 0);

 int percentage = totalHabits == 0 ? 0 : (int) ((completedHabits * 100f) / totalHabits);

 if (totalHabits == 0) {
 habitsPercentageText.setText("0%");
 habitsCountText.setText("0 / 0 completed");
 habitsProgressBar.setProgress(0);
 } else {
 habitsPercentageText.setText(percentage + "%");
 habitsCountText.setText(completedHabits + " / " + totalHabits + " completed");
 habitsProgressBar.setProgress(percentage);
 }
 }

 private void updateGreeting() {
 java.util.Calendar cal = java.util.Calendar.getInstance();
 int hour = cal.get(java.util.Calendar.HOUR_OF_DAY);

 String timeGreeting;
 if (hour < 12) {
 timeGreeting = "Good morning";
 } else if (hour < 17) {
 timeGreeting = "Good afternoon";
 } else {
 timeGreeting = "Good evening";
 }

 // Get user name
 String userName = sharedPreferences.getString("current_user_name", "User");
 boolean isGuest = sharedPreferences.getBoolean("is_guest", false);

 String greeting;
 if (isGuest) {
 greeting = timeGreeting + ", Guest! ";
 } else {
 greeting = timeGreeting + ", " + userName + "! ";
 }

 greetingText.setText(greeting);
 }

 });

 findViewById(R.id.nav_settings).setOnClickListener(v -> {
 Intent intent = new Intent(MainActivity.this, WidgetSettingsActivity.class);
 startActivity(intent);
 });
 }

+ return "Stable →";

## **Custom Volume Input Feature - Complete Implementation**

### **✅ Features Added:**

#### **1. Custom Volume Input Field**
- **Input Field**: EditText for entering custom water intake volume
- **Number Input Type**: Restricted to numeric input only
- **Maximum Length**: Limited to 5 digits (max 99,999ml)
- **Clear Placeholder**: "Enter volume (ml)" hint text

#### **2. Enhanced Validation System**
- **Empty Input Check**: Prompts user to enter a volume
- **Zero/Negative Check**: Ensures volume is greater than 0ml
- **Maximum Limit**: Prevents unrealistic values (max 10,000ml)
- **Invalid Format**: Handles non-numeric input gracefully
- **Error Messages**: Clear, user-friendly error feedback

#### **3. Quick Suggestion Buttons**
- **100ml**: For small sips and medications
- **200ml**: Standard glass size
- **300ml**: Medium cup size
- **600ml**: Water bottle size
- **One-tap Addition**: Instant intake logging

#### **4. User Experience Enhancements**
- **Success Feedback**: Toast message confirming added volume
- **Auto-clear**: Input field clears after successful addition
- **Focus Management**: Proper keyboard and focus handling
- **Visual Feedback**: Error highlighting on invalid input

#### **5. Layout Improvements**
- **Organized Sections**: 
 - Preset volume buttons (250ml, 500ml, 750ml, 1000ml)
 - Custom input section with validation
 - Quick suggestion buttons for common volumes
- **Responsive Design**: Works across different screen sizes
- **Color-coded**: Purple theme for custom input features

### ** Technical Implementation:**

#### **Layout Changes (`activity_hydration.xml`):**
- Added custom volume input section
- Enhanced GridLayout to accommodate new features
- Added suggestion buttons with proper styling
- Maintained consistent design language

#### **Java Code Changes (`HydrationActivity.java`):**
- **Comprehensive validation** for user input
- **Error handling** with user-friendly messages
- **Toast notifications** for successful additions
- **Click listeners** for all suggestion buttons
- **Input field management** (clear, focus, keyboard)

### ** User Workflow:**

#### **Method 1: Custom Input**
1. User enters custom volume in input field
2. System validates the input (range: 1-10,000ml)
3. User clicks "Add" button
4. System shows success message and updates intake
5. Input field clears automatically

#### **Method 2: Quick Suggestions**
1. User clicks any suggestion button (100ml, 200ml, 300ml, 600ml)
2. Volume is instantly added to daily intake
3. Progress bar and statistics update immediately

#### **Method 3: Preset Volumes (Existing)**
1. User clicks preset buttons (250ml, 500ml, 750ml, 1000ml)
2. Standard volumes added with themed icons

### ** UI/UX Features:**

#### **Visual Design:**
- **Purple accent** for custom input elements
- **Gray suggestion** buttons for quick access
- **Consistent spacing** and margins
- **Clear visual hierarchy** with proper typography

#### **Interaction Design:**
- **Immediate feedback** on all actions
- **Error state handling** with clear messages
- **Keyboard-friendly** number input
- **Touch-friendly** button sizes

### ** Benefits:**

1. **Flexibility**: Users can log any water intake amount
2. **Convenience**: Quick suggestions for common volumes
3. **Accuracy**: Precise logging of actual consumption
4. **User-Friendly**: Intuitive interface with clear guidance
5. **Comprehensive**: Covers all use cases from small sips to large containers

The hydration section now offers **complete flexibility** for users to track their water intake with both preset options and fully customizable input! 

**Perfect for tracking:**
- Medicine doses (small volumes)

- Exact measurements

 private void loadTodaysSummary() {
 loadTodaysMood();
 loadTodaysHydration();
 loadTodaysHabits();
 }

 private void loadTodaysMood() {
 SimpleDateFormat dateFormat = new SimpleDateFormat("yyyy-MM-dd");
 String todayKey = dateFormat.format(new Date());

 String todayMood = moodPrefs.getString(todayKey + "_emoji", "");
 String todayMoodName = moodPrefs.getString(todayKey + "_name", "");

 if (todayMood.isEmpty()) {
 // Show default mood if none logged today
 moodEmojiText.setText("");
 moodNameText.setText("Not set");
 } else {
 moodEmojiText.setText(todayMood);
 moodNameText.setText(todayMoodName);
 }
 }

 private void loadTodaysHydration() {
 SimpleDateFormat dateFormat = new SimpleDateFormat("yyyy-MM-dd");
 String todayKey = dateFormat.format(new Date());

 int todayIntake = hydrationPrefs.getInt(todayKey + "_intake", 0);
 int dailyGoal = hydrationPrefs.getInt("daily_goal", 2000);

 int percentage = Math.min(100, (int) ((todayIntake * 100f) / dailyGoal));

 hydrationPercentageText.setText(percentage + "%");
 hydrationAmountText.setText(todayIntake + " ml / " + dailyGoal + " ml");
 hydrationProgressBar.setProgress(percentage);
 }

 private void loadTodaysHabits() {
 SimpleDateFormat dateFormat = new SimpleDateFormat("yyyy-MM-dd");
 String todayKey = dateFormat.format(new Date());

 int completedHabits = habitsPrefs.getInt(todayKey + "_completed", 0);
 int totalHabits = habitsPrefs.getInt(todayKey + "_total", 0);

 int percentage = totalHabits == 0 ? 0 : (int) ((completedHabits * 100f) / totalHabits);

 habitsPercentageText.setText(percentage + "%");
 habitsCountText.setText(completedHabits + " / " + totalHabits + " completed");
 habitsProgressBar.setProgress(percentage);

 // Update HabitProgressWidgetProvider for consistency
 SharedPreferences widgetPrefs = getSharedPreferences(HabitProgressWidgetProvider.PREFS_NAME, MODE_PRIVATE);
 SharedPreferences.Editor widgetEditor = widgetPrefs.edit();
 widgetEditor.putInt(HabitProgressWidgetProvider.KEY_COMPLETED, completedHabits);
 widgetEditor.putInt(HabitProgressWidgetProvider.KEY_TOTAL, totalHabits);
 widgetEditor.apply();
 HabitProgressWidgetProvider.requestUpdateAll(this);
 }

 private void updateGreeting() {
 java.util.Calendar cal = java.util.Calendar.getInstance();
 int hour = cal.get(java.util.Calendar.HOUR_OF_DAY);

 String timeGreeting;
 if (hour < 12) {
 timeGreeting = "Good morning";
 } else if (hour < 17) {
 timeGreeting = "Good afternoon";
 } else {
 timeGreeting = "Good evening";
 }

 // Get user name
 String userName = sharedPreferences.getString("current_user_name", "User");
 boolean isGuest = sharedPreferences.getBoolean("is_guest", false);

 String greeting;
 if (isGuest) {
 greeting = timeGreeting + ", Guest! ";
 } else {
 greeting = timeGreeting + ", " + userName + "! ";
 }

 greetingText.setText(greeting);
 }

 intervalAdapter.setDropDownViewResource(android.R.layout.simple_spinner_dropdown_item);
 intervalSpinner.setAdapter(intervalAdapter);
 }

 private void setupVolumeButtons() {
 btn250ml.setOnClickListener(v -> addWaterIntake(250));
 btn500ml.setOnClickListener(v -> addWaterIntake(500));
 btn750ml.setOnClickListener(v -> addWaterIntake(750));
 btn1000ml.setOnClickListener(v -> addWaterIntake(1000));
 btnSuggest100.setOnClickListener(v -> addWaterIntake(100));
 btnSuggest200.setOnClickListener(v -> addWaterIntake(200));
 btnSuggest300.setOnClickListener(v -> addWaterIntake(300));
 btnSuggest600.setOnClickListener(v -> addWaterIntake(600));
 btnAddCustom.setOnClickListener(v -> {
 String volumeText = editCustomVolume.getText().toString().trim();

 if (volumeText.isEmpty()) {
 editCustomVolume.setError("Please enter a volume");
 editCustomVolume.requestFocus();
 return;
 }

 try {
 int customVolume = Integer.parseInt(volumeText);

 if (customVolume <= 0) {
 editCustomVolume.setError("Volume must be greater than 0");
 editCustomVolume.requestFocus();
 return;
 }

 if (customVolume > 10000) {
 editCustomVolume.setError("Volume too large (max 10000ml)");
 editCustomVolume.requestFocus();
 return;
 }

 addWaterIntake(customVolume);
 editCustomVolume.setText("");
 editCustomVolume.clearFocus();

 // Show success feedback
 android.widget.Toast.makeText(this, "Added " + customVolume + "ml to your daily intake!",
 android.widget.Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show();

 } catch (NumberFormatException e) {
 editCustomVolume.setError("Please enter a valid number");
 editCustomVolume.requestFocus();
 }
 });
 }

 private void setupCalendar() {
 calendarView.setLayoutManager(new GridLayoutManager(this, 7));
 calendarAdapter = new CalendarAdapter(new ArrayList<>(), dayCell -> {
 selectedDate = dayCell.date;
 loadSelectedDateData();
 });
 calendarView.setAdapter(calendarAdapter);

 bindMonth();
 }

 private void setupIntakeHistory() {
 historyAdapter = new IntakeHistoryAdapter(todayIntakes, position -> {
 // Delete intake
 if (position < todayIntakes.size()) {
 todayIntakes.remove(position);
 saveTodayData();
 historyAdapter.notifyItemRemoved(position);
 updateProgress();
 calendarAdapter.updateIntakes(mapDateToIntake());
 }
 });
 intakeHistoryRecycler.setLayoutManager(new LinearLayoutManager(this));
 intakeHistoryRecycler.setAdapter(historyAdapter);
 }

 private void addWaterIntake(int volumeMl) {
 WaterIntake intake = new WaterIntake(volumeMl, new Date());
 todayIntakes.add(0, intake);
 saveTodayData();
 historyAdapter.notifyItemInserted(0);
 updateProgress();
 calendarAdapter.updateIntakes(mapDateToIntake());
 }

 private void bindMonth() {
 TextView monthTitle = findViewById(R.id.text_month);
 SimpleDateFormat sdf = new SimpleDateFormat("MMMM yyyy");
 monthTitle.setText(sdf.format(currentMonth.getTime()));

 java.util.Calendar cal = (java.util.Calendar) currentMonth.clone();
 cal.set(java.util.Calendar.DAY_OF_MONTH, 1);

 int firstDayOfWeek = cal.get(java.util.Calendar.DAY_OF_WEEK);
 int daysInMonth = cal.getActualMaximum(java.util.Calendar.DAY_OF_MONTH);

 List<DayCell> cells = new ArrayList<>();

 // Add empty cells for proper alignment
 for (int i = 1; i < firstDayOfWeek; i++) {
 cells.add(DayCell.empty());
 }

 // Add all days of the month
 for (int day = 1; day <= daysInMonth; day++) {
 cal.set(java.util.Calendar.DAY_OF_MONTH, day);
 cells.add(DayCell.of(cal.getTime()));
 }

 // Fill to 42 cells (6 rows × 7 columns)
 while (cells.size() < 42) {
 cells.add(DayCell.empty());
 }

 calendarAdapter.submit(cells, mapDateToIntake());
 }

 private Map<String, String> mapDateToIntake() {
 SimpleDateFormat keyFmt = new SimpleDateFormat("yyyy-MM-dd");
 Map<String, String> map = new HashMap<>();

 for (String dateKey : dailyIntakes.keySet()) {
 List<WaterIntake> intakes = dailyIntakes.get(dateKey);
 if (intakes != null && !intakes.isEmpty()) {
 int totalMl = 0;
 for (WaterIntake intake : intakes) {
 totalMl += intake.volumeMl;
 }
 int percentage = (int) ((totalMl * 100f) / dailyGoalMl);
 map.put(dateKey, percentage + "%");
 }
 }

 return map;
 }

 private void loadTodayData() {
 SimpleDateFormat keyFmt = new SimpleDateFormat("yyyy-MM-dd");
 String todayKey = keyFmt.format(new Date());

 if (dailyIntakes.containsKey(todayKey)) {
 todayIntakes = dailyIntakes.get(todayKey);
 } else {
 todayIntakes = new ArrayList<>();
 dailyIntakes.put(todayKey, todayIntakes);
 }

 historyAdapter.updateItems(todayIntakes);
 }

 private void loadSelectedDateData() {
 SimpleDateFormat keyFmt = new SimpleDateFormat("yyyy-MM-dd");
 String selectedKey = keyFmt.format(selectedDate);

 List<WaterIntake> selectedIntakes = dailyIntakes.getOrDefault(selectedKey, new ArrayList<>());
 historyAdapter.updateItems(selectedIntakes);

 // Update progress for selected date
 int totalMl = 0;
 for (WaterIntake intake : selectedIntakes) {
 totalMl += intake.volumeMl;
 }

 int percentage = (int) ((totalMl * 100f) / dailyGoalMl);
 intakeAmountText.setText(totalMl + " ml / " + dailyGoalMl + " ml");
 percentageText.setText(percentage + "%");
 progressBar.setProgress(percentage);
 }

 private void saveTodayData() {
 SimpleDateFormat keyFmt = new SimpleDateFormat("yyyy-MM-dd");
 String todayKey = keyFmt.format(new Date());
 dailyIntakes.put(todayKey, new ArrayList<>(todayIntakes));
 }

 private void updateProgress() {
 int totalMl = 0;
 for (WaterIntake intake : todayIntakes) {
 totalMl += intake.volumeMl;
 }

 int percentage = Math.min(100, (int) ((totalMl * 100f) / dailyGoalMl));

 intakeAmountText.setText(totalMl + " ml / " + dailyGoalMl + " ml");
 percentageText.setText(percentage + "%");
 progressBar.setProgress(percentage);
 }

 // Data Classes
 private static class WaterIntake {
 int volumeMl;
 Date timestamp;

 WaterIntake(int volumeMl, Date timestamp) {
 this.volumeMl = volumeMl;
 this.timestamp = timestamp;
 }
 }

 private static class DayCell {
 boolean isInvalid;
 boolean isEmpty;
 Date date;
 int dayNumber;

 static DayCell of(Date date) {
 DayCell d = new DayCell();
 d.isInvalid = false;
 d.isEmpty = false;
 d.date = date;
 java.util.Calendar c = java.util.Calendar.getInstance();
 c.setTime(date);
 d.dayNumber = c.get(java.util.Calendar.DAY_OF_MONTH);
 return d;
 }

 static DayCell empty() {
 DayCell d = new DayCell();
 d.isInvalid = false;
 d.isEmpty = true;
 d.dayNumber = 0;
 return d;
 }
 }

 // Adapters
 private interface DayClickListener {
 void onDayClick(DayCell dayCell);
 }

 private static class CalendarAdapter extends RecyclerView.Adapter<CalendarAdapter.DayViewHolder> {
 private final List<DayCell> cells;
 private final DayClickListener listener;
 private Map<String, String> dateToIntake = new HashMap<>();

 CalendarAdapter(List<DayCell> cells, DayClickListener listener) {
 this.cells = cells;
 this.listener = listener;
 }

 void submit(List<DayCell> newCells, Map<String, String> dateToIntake) {
 this.cells.clear();
 this.cells.addAll(newCells);
 this.dateToIntake = dateToIntake;
 notifyDataSetChanged();
 }

 void updateIntakes(Map<String, String> dateToIntake) {
 this.dateToIntake = dateToIntake;
 notifyDataSetChanged();
 }

 @NonNull
 @Override
 public DayViewHolder onCreateViewHolder(@NonNull ViewGroup parent, int viewType) {
 View v = LayoutInflater.from(parent.getContext()).inflate(R.layout.item_calendar_day, parent, false);
 return new DayViewHolder(v);
 }

 @Override
 public void onBindViewHolder(@NonNull DayViewHolder holder, int position) {
 DayCell cell = cells.get(position);

 if (cell.isEmpty) {
 holder.day.setText("");
 holder.emoji.setText("");
 holder.day.setAlpha(0.3f);
 holder.itemView.setOnClickListener(null);
 } else {
 holder.day.setText(String.valueOf(cell.dayNumber));
 holder.day.setAlpha(1f);

 if (!cell.isInvalid && cell.date != null) {
 SimpleDateFormat keyFmt = new SimpleDateFormat("yyyy-MM-dd");
 String key = keyFmt.format(cell.date);
 holder.emoji.setText(dateToIntake.getOrDefault(key, ""));
 holder.itemView.setOnClickListener(v -> listener.onDayClick(cell));

 // Highlight selected day
 try {
 String sel = keyFmt.format(((HydrationActivity) holder.itemView.getContext()).selectedDate);
 if (sel.equals(key)) {
 holder.itemView.setBackgroundColor(0xFFE3F2FD);
 } else {
 holder.itemView.setBackgroundColor(0xFFFFFFFF);
 }
 } catch (Exception e) {
 holder.itemView.setBackgroundColor(0xFFFFFFFF);
 }
 } else {
 holder.emoji.setText("");
 holder.itemView.setOnClickListener(null);
 holder.itemView.setBackgroundColor(0xFFFFFFFF);
 }
 }
 }

 @Override
 public int getItemCount() {
 return cells.size();
 }

import androidx.core.view.WindowInsetsCompat;
import androidx.recyclerview.widget.GridLayoutManager;
import androidx.recyclerview.widget.LinearLayoutManager;
import androidx.recyclerview.widget.RecyclerView;

import java.text.SimpleDateFormat;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Date;
import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;

public class HydrationActivity extends AppCompatActivity {

 // UI Elements
 private Spinner intervalSpinner, dailyGoalSpinner;
 private Switch notificationsSwitch;
 private ProgressBar progressBar;
 private TextView intakeAmountText, percentageText;
 private Button btn250ml, btn500ml, btn750ml, btn1000ml, btnAddCustom;
 private Button btnSuggest100, btnSuggest200, btnSuggest300, btnSuggest600;
 private EditText editCustomVolume;

 // Calendar
 private RecyclerView calendarView, intakeHistoryRecycler;
 private CalendarAdapter calendarAdapter;
 private IntakeHistoryAdapter historyAdapter;
 private java.util.Calendar currentMonth = java.util.Calendar.getInstance();
 private Date selectedDate = new Date();

 // Data
 private int dailyGoalMl = 2000;
 private Map<String, List<WaterIntake>> dailyIntakes = new HashMap<>();
 private List<WaterIntake> todayIntakes = new ArrayList<>();

 @Override
 protected void onCreate(Bundle savedInstanceState) {
 super.onCreate(savedInstanceState);
 EdgeToEdge.enable(this);
 setContentView(R.layout.activity_hydration);
 ViewCompat.setOnApplyWindowInsetsListener(findViewById(R.id.hydration_root), (v, insets) -> {
 Insets systemBars = insets.getInsets(WindowInsetsCompat.Type.systemBars());
 v.setPadding(systemBars.left, systemBars.top, systemBars.right, systemBars.bottom);
 return insets;
 });

 initializeViews();
 setupSpinners();
 setupVolumeButtons();
 setupCalendar();
 setupIntakeHistory();
 loadTodayData();
 updateProgress();

 BaseNavigation.wireTopNav(this, findViewById(R.id.top_nav_include));
 setupBottomNavigation();
 }

 private void initializeViews() {
 intervalSpinner = findViewById(R.id.spinner_interval);
 dailyGoalSpinner = findViewById(R.id.spinner_daily_goal);
 notificationsSwitch = findViewById(R.id.switch_notifications);
 progressBar = findViewById(R.id.progress_hydration);
 intakeAmountText = findViewById(R.id.text_intake_amount);
 percentageText = findViewById(R.id.text_percentage);

 btn250ml = findViewById(R.id.btn_250ml);
 btn500ml = findViewById(R.id.btn_500ml);
 btn750ml = findViewById(R.id.btn_750ml);
 btn1000ml = findViewById(R.id.btn_1000ml);
 btnSuggest100 = findViewById(R.id.btn_suggest_100);
 btnSuggest200 = findViewById(R.id.btn_suggest_200);
 btnSuggest300 = findViewById(R.id.btn_suggest_300);
 btnSuggest600 = findViewById(R.id.btn_suggest_600);
 btnAddCustom = findViewById(R.id.btn_add_custom);
 editCustomVolume = findViewById(R.id.edit_custom_volume);

 calendarView = findViewById(R.id.recycler_calendar);
 intakeHistoryRecycler = findViewById(R.id.recycler_intake_history);
 }

 private void setupSpinners() {
 // Daily goal spinner
 String[] goals = {"1500 ml", "2000 ml", "2500 ml", "3000 ml", "3500 ml"};
 ArrayAdapter<String> goalAdapter = new ArrayAdapter<>(this, android.R.layout.simple_spinner_item, goals);
 goalAdapter.setDropDownViewResource(android.R.layout.simple_spinner_dropdown_item);
 dailyGoalSpinner.setAdapter(goalAdapter);
 dailyGoalSpinner.setSelection(1); // Default to 2000ml

 dailyGoalSpinner.setOnItemSelectedListener(new android.widget.AdapterView.OnItemSelectedListener() {
 @Override
 public void onItemSelected(android.widget.AdapterView<?> parent, View view, int position, long id) {
 switch (position) {
 case 0:
 dailyGoalMl = 1500;
 break;
 case 1:
 dailyGoalMl = 2000;
 break;
 case 2:
 dailyGoalMl = 2500;
 break;
 case 3:
 dailyGoalMl = 3000;
 break;
 case 4:
 dailyGoalMl = 3500;
 break;
 }
 updateProgress();
 }

 @Override
 public void onNothingSelected(android.widget.AdapterView<?> parent) {
 }
 });

 // Interval spinner
 String[] intervals = {"30 minutes", "1 hour", "2 hours", "3 hours"};
 ArrayAdapter<String> intervalAdapter = new ArrayAdapter<>(this, android.R.layout.simple_spinner_item, intervals);
 intervalAdapter.setDropDownViewResource(android.R.layout.simple_spinner_dropdown_item);
 intervalSpinner.setAdapter(intervalAdapter);
 }

 private void setupVolumeButtons() {
 btn250ml.setOnClickListener(v -> addWaterIntake(250));
 btn500ml.setOnClickListener(v -> addWaterIntake(500));
 btn750ml.setOnClickListener(v -> addWaterIntake(750));
 btn1000ml.setOnClickListener(v -> addWaterIntake(1000));
 btnSuggest100.setOnClickListener(v -> addWaterIntake(100));
 btnSuggest200.setOnClickListener(v -> addWaterIntake(200));
 btnSuggest300.setOnClickListener(v -> addWaterIntake(300));
 btnSuggest600.setOnClickListener(v -> addWaterIntake(600));
 btnAddCustom.setOnClickListener(v -> {
 String volumeText = editCustomVolume.getText().toString().trim();

 if (volumeText.isEmpty()) {
 editCustomVolume.setError("Please enter a volume");
 editCustomVolume.requestFocus();
 return;
 }

 try {
 int customVolume = Integer.parseInt(volumeText);

 if (customVolume <= 0) {
 editCustomVolume.setError("Volume must be greater than 0");
 editCustomVolume.requestFocus();
 return;
 }

 if (customVolume > 10000) {
 editCustomVolume.setError("Volume too large (max 10000ml)");
 editCustomVolume.requestFocus();
 return;
 }

 addWaterIntake(customVolume);
 editCustomVolume.setText("");
 editCustomVolume.clearFocus();

 // Show success feedback
 android.widget.Toast.makeText(this, "Added " + customVolume + "ml to your daily intake!",
 android.widget.Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show();

 } catch (NumberFormatException e) {
 editCustomVolume.setError("Please enter a valid number");
 editCustomVolume.requestFocus();
 }
 });
 }

 private void setupCalendar() {
 calendarView.setLayoutManager(new GridLayoutManager(this, 7));
 calendarAdapter = new CalendarAdapter(new ArrayList<>(), dayCell -> {
 selectedDate = dayCell.date;
 loadSelectedDateData();
 });
 calendarView.setAdapter(calendarAdapter);

 bindMonth();
 }

 private void setupIntakeHistory() {
 historyAdapter = new IntakeHistoryAdapter(todayIntakes, position -> {
 // Delete intake
 if (position < todayIntakes.size()) {
 todayIntakes.remove(position);
 saveTodayData();
 historyAdapter.notifyItemRemoved(position);
 updateProgress();
 calendarAdapter.updateIntakes(mapDateToIntake());
 }
 });
 intakeHistoryRecycler.setLayoutManager(new LinearLayoutManager(this));
 intakeHistoryRecycler.setAdapter(historyAdapter);
 }

 private void addWaterIntake(int volumeMl) {
 WaterIntake intake = new WaterIntake(volumeMl, new Date());
 todayIntakes.add(0, intake);
 saveTodayData();
 historyAdapter.notifyItemInserted(0);
 updateProgress();
 calendarAdapter.updateIntakes(mapDateToIntake());
 }

 private void bindMonth() {
 TextView monthTitle = findViewById(R.id.text_month);
 SimpleDateFormat sdf = new SimpleDateFormat("MMMM yyyy");
 monthTitle.setText(sdf.format(currentMonth.getTime()));

 java.util.Calendar cal = (java.util.Calendar) currentMonth.clone();
 cal.set(java.util.Calendar.DAY_OF_MONTH, 1);

 int firstDayOfWeek = cal.get(java.util.Calendar.DAY_OF_WEEK);
 int daysInMonth = cal.getActualMaximum(java.util.Calendar.DAY_OF_MONTH);

 List<DayCell> cells = new ArrayList<>();

 // Add empty cells for proper alignment
 for (int i = 1; i < firstDayOfWeek; i++) {
 cells.add(DayCell.empty());
 }

 // Add all days of the month
 for (int day = 1; day <= daysInMonth; day++) {
 cal.set(java.util.Calendar.DAY_OF_MONTH, day);
 cells.add(DayCell.of(cal.getTime()));
 }

 // Fill to 42 cells (6 rows × 7 columns)
 while (cells.size() < 42) {
 cells.add(DayCell.empty());
 }

 calendarAdapter.submit(cells, mapDateToIntake());
 }

 private Map<String, String> mapDateToIntake() {
 SimpleDateFormat keyFmt = new SimpleDateFormat("yyyy-MM-dd");
 Map<String, String> map = new HashMap<>();

 for (String dateKey : dailyIntakes.keySet()) {
 List<WaterIntake> intakes = dailyIntakes.get(dateKey);
 if (intakes != null && !intakes.isEmpty()) {
 int totalMl = 0;
 for (WaterIntake intake : intakes) {
 totalMl += intake.volumeMl;
 }
 int percentage = (int) ((totalMl * 100f) / dailyGoalMl);
 map.put(dateKey, percentage + "%");
 }
 }

 return map;
 }

 private void loadTodayData() {
 SimpleDateFormat keyFmt = new SimpleDateFormat("yyyy-MM-dd");
 String todayKey = keyFmt.format(new Date());

 if (dailyIntakes.containsKey(todayKey)) {
 todayIntakes = dailyIntakes.get(todayKey);
 } else {
 todayIntakes = new ArrayList<>();
 dailyIntakes.put(todayKey, todayIntakes);
 }

 historyAdapter.updateItems(todayIntakes);
 }

 private void loadSelectedDateData() {
 SimpleDateFormat keyFmt = new SimpleDateFormat("yyyy-MM-dd");
 String selectedKey = keyFmt.format(selectedDate);

 List<WaterIntake> selectedIntakes = dailyIntakes.getOrDefault(selectedKey, new ArrayList<>());
 historyAdapter.updateItems(selectedIntakes);

 // Update progress for selected date
 int totalMl = 0;
 for (WaterIntake intake : selectedIntakes) {
 totalMl += intake.volumeMl;
 }

 int percentage = (int) ((totalMl * 100f) / dailyGoalMl);
 intakeAmountText.setText(totalMl + " ml / " + dailyGoalMl + " ml");
 percentageText.setText(percentage + "%");
 progressBar.setProgress(percentage);
 }

 private void saveTodayData() {
 SimpleDateFormat keyFmt = new SimpleDateFormat("yyyy-MM-dd");
 String todayKey = keyFmt.format(new Date());
 dailyIntakes.put(todayKey, new ArrayList<>(todayIntakes));

 // Calculate total intake for today
 int totalIntake = 0;
 for (WaterIntake intake : todayIntakes) {
 totalIntake += intake.volumeMl;
 }

 // Save to SharedPreferences for real-time updates
 android.content.SharedPreferences hydrationPrefs = getSharedPreferences("hydration_data", MODE_PRIVATE);
 android.content.SharedPreferences.Editor editor = hydrationPrefs.edit();
 editor.putInt(todayKey + "_intake", totalIntake);
 editor.putInt("daily_goal", dailyGoalMl);
 editor.apply();
 }

 private void updateProgress() {
 int totalMl = 0;
 for (WaterIntake intake : todayIntakes) {
 totalMl += intake.volumeMl;
 }

 int percentage = Math.min(100, (int) ((totalMl * 100f) / dailyGoalMl));

 intakeAmountText.setText(totalMl + " ml / " + dailyGoalMl + " ml");
 percentageText.setText(percentage + "%");
 progressBar.setProgress(percentage);
 }

 // Data Classes
 private static class WaterIntake {
 int volumeMl;
 Date timestamp;

 WaterIntake(int volumeMl, Date timestamp) {
 this.volumeMl = volumeMl;
 this.timestamp = timestamp;
 }
 }

 private static class DayCell {
 boolean isInvalid;
 boolean isEmpty;
 Date date;
 int dayNumber;

 static DayCell of(Date date) {
 DayCell d = new DayCell();
 d.isInvalid = false;
 d.isEmpty = false;
 d.date = date;
 java.util.Calendar c = java.util.Calendar.getInstance();
 c.setTime(date);
 d.dayNumber = c.get(java.util.Calendar.DAY_OF_MONTH);
 return d;
 }

 static DayCell empty() {
 DayCell d = new DayCell();
 d.isInvalid = false;
 d.isEmpty = true;
 d.dayNumber = 0;
 return d;
 }
 }

 // Adapters
 private interface DayClickListener {
 void onDayClick(DayCell dayCell);
 }

 private static class CalendarAdapter extends RecyclerView.Adapter<CalendarAdapter.DayViewHolder> {
 private final List<DayCell> cells;
 private final DayClickListener listener;
 private Map<String, String> dateToIntake = new HashMap<>();

 CalendarAdapter(List<DayCell> cells, DayClickListener listener) {
 this.cells = cells;
 this.listener = listener;
 }

 void submit(List<DayCell> newCells, Map<String, String> dateToIntake) {
 this.cells.clear();
 this.cells.addAll(newCells);
 this.dateToIntake = dateToIntake;
 notifyDataSetChanged();
 }

 void updateIntakes(Map<String, String> dateToIntake) {
 this.dateToIntake = dateToIntake;
 notifyDataSetChanged();
 }

 @NonNull
 @Override
 public DayViewHolder onCreateViewHolder(@NonNull ViewGroup parent, int viewType) {
 View v = LayoutInflater.from(parent.getContext()).inflate(R.layout.item_calendar_day, parent, false);
 return new DayViewHolder(v);
 }

 @Override
 public void onBindViewHolder(@NonNull DayViewHolder holder, int position) {
 DayCell cell = cells.get(position);

 if (cell.isEmpty) {
 holder.day.setText("");
 holder.emoji.setText("");
 holder.day.setAlpha(0.3f);
 holder.itemView.setOnClickListener(null);
 } else {
 holder.day.setText(String.valueOf(cell.dayNumber));
 holder.day.setAlpha(1f);

 if (!cell.isInvalid && cell.date != null) {
 SimpleDateFormat keyFmt = new SimpleDateFormat("yyyy-MM-dd");
 String key = keyFmt.format(cell.date);
 holder.emoji.setText(dateToIntake.getOrDefault(key, ""));
 holder.itemView.setOnClickListener(v -> listener.onDayClick(cell));

 // Highlight selected day
 try {
 String sel = keyFmt.format(((HydrationActivity) holder.itemView.getContext()).selectedDate);
 if (sel.equals(key)) {
 holder.itemView.setBackgroundColor(0xFFE3F2FD);
 } else {
 holder.itemView.setBackgroundColor(0xFFFFFFFF);
 }
 } catch (Exception e) {
 holder.itemView.setBackgroundColor(0xFFFFFFFF);
 }
 } else {
 holder.emoji.setText("");
 holder.itemView.setOnClickListener(null);
 holder.itemView.setBackgroundColor(0xFFFFFFFF);
 }
 }
 }

 @Override
 public int getItemCount() {
 return cells.size();
 }

 static class DayViewHolder extends RecyclerView.ViewHolder {
 TextView day, emoji;

 DayViewHolder(@NonNull View itemView) {
 super(itemView);
 day = itemView.findViewById(R.id.text_day);
 emoji = itemView.findViewById(R.id.text_day_emoji);
 }
 }
 }

 private interface IntakeDeleteListener {
 void onDeleteIntake(int position);
 }

 private static class IntakeHistoryAdapter extends RecyclerView.Adapter<IntakeHistoryAdapter.IntakeViewHolder> {
 private List<WaterIntake> intakes;

 IntakeHistoryAdapter(List<WaterIntake> intakes, IntakeDeleteListener listener) {
 this.intakes = intakes;
 this.listener = listener;
 }

 void updateItems(List<WaterIntake> newIntakes) {
 this.intakes = newIntakes;
 notifyDataSetChanged();
 }

 @NonNull
 @Override
 public IntakeViewHolder onCreateViewHolder(@NonNull ViewGroup parent, int viewType) {
 View view = LayoutInflater.from(parent.getContext()).inflate(R.layout.item_water_intake, parent, false);
 return new IntakeViewHolder(view);
 }

 @Override
 public void onBindViewHolder(@NonNull IntakeViewHolder holder, int position) {
 WaterIntake intake = intakes.get(position);
 holder.volumeText.setText(intake.volumeMl + " ml");

 SimpleDateFormat timeFormat = new SimpleDateFormat("hh:mm a");
 holder.timeText.setText(timeFormat.format(intake.timestamp));

 holder.deleteButton.setOnClickListener(v -> listener.onDeleteIntake(holder.getAdapterPosition()));
 }

 @Override
 public int getItemCount() {
 return intakes.size();
 }

 static class IntakeViewHolder extends RecyclerView.ViewHolder {
 TextView volumeText, timeText;
 ImageButton deleteButton;

 IntakeViewHolder(@NonNull View itemView) {
 super(itemView);
 volumeText = itemView.findViewById(R.id.text_volume);
 timeText = itemView.findViewById(R.id.text_time);
 deleteButton = itemView.findViewById(R.id.btn_delete);

 }
 }
